They find industry trends and build relationships with partners. They identify, negotiate, structure, and finalize strategic acquisitions and investments. We are seeing a Corporate Development Manager to join our team!. This Manager, reporting to GoDaddy's Head of Corporate Development, will support transaction teams. Their role is to drive growth and improve GoDaddy's market position with capital deployments and business combinations. This role plays an essential part in crafting our future growth through investments and acquisitions. It brings in new and innovative capabilities, improves existing ones, and grows our footprint and market opportunities. You will work across all aspects of inorganic growth, helping identify and build a pipeline of investment and acquisition opportunities. Support post-merger integration efforts to help ensure seamless transitions and value realization after close. Contribute to playbooks that drive repeatable process and strong execution throughout the mergers and acquisitions division. Substantive, hands-on M&A transaction experience - including buy-side and/or sell-side exposure, transaction modeling, valuation, and due diligence - with meaningful personal ownership of deal workstreams, not solely support-level involvement. Strong analytical and financial rigor, demonstrating skill in interpreting complex data and financial documents and forming an independent point of view. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and components of a transaction with growing independence, while keeping deal processes on track. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate financial and strategic complexity into clear, understandable recommendations for collaborators and deal leads. You might also have... Prior experience transitioning from investment banking into an in-house business development unit. Experience in the technology sector or other high-growth, sophisticated industries. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment with multiple partners. Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience; MBA preferred. Proficiency in AI tools, particularly as they relate to sourcing, modeling, or diligence in a corporate development context. description: Location Details: Phoenix, Arizona. At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.. . . . . . . Join our team. The Data Center Critical Environments team keeps the electrical backbone of GoDaddy's production data centers running safely, reliably, and in compliance. As the Critical Facilities Engineer - Electrical, you'll serve as the subject matter expert for UPS systems, generators, switchgear, and power distribution across the Phoenix site. You'll own safety and compliance programs, maintenance planning, contractor oversight, and operational documentation, while mentoring teammates and partnering with vendors, project teams, and local authorities. What you'll get to do…. Operate and maintain critical power infrastructure. Monitor, inspect, and troubleshoot the site's critical electrical systems serving server rooms, MDFs, IDFs, and other mission-critical spaces. Apply expert-level knowledge of commercial power distribution, equipment drawings, and one-line diagrams.. Respond to incidents and share the 24x7 on-call rotation. Lead fault discovery, root cause analysis, and recovery planning during planned and unplanned events. Support off-hours maintenance, deployments, and coverage.. Run projects and manage vendors. Drive projects from concept through commissioning and turnover, including infrastructure upgrades, capacity expansions, and tenant improvements. Oversee vendor maintenance, testing, repair, and installation work against GoDaddy safety and change management requirements.. Own operational documentation and purchasing. Write and maintain SOPs, EOPs, MOPs, risk assessments, permits, as-built drawings, and maintenance plans. Track assets, work orders, and corrective actions in JIRA and ServiceNow, and coordinate purchasing and budget input.. Lead safety, compliance, and technical mentoring. Administer hot work permitting, SDS, stormwater, SPCC, EPA, hazardous waste, and safety training programs. Mentor teammates and partner with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Networking, Business Continuity, and the Global Operations Center.. Your experience should include…. 8+ years in the electrical field, with emphasis on operating, maintaining, and supporting critical electrical infrastructure in a data center or comparable mission-critical environment.. Hands-on operation of generators, switchgear, ATSs, UPS systems, and power distribution equipment, along with expert troubleshooting, operational risk assessment, recovery planning, and emergency response.. Vendor management, maintenance coordination, technical documentation review, and oversight of work in mission-critical environments.. Organizational skills and documentation accuracy, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Project, and Visio; ServiceNow and JIRA; and BMS, electrical power monitoring, fire alarm, generator control, and battery monitoring platforms.. You might also have…. Trade school certification, apprenticeship training, military technical training, or equivalent field experience in data center critical facilities, commercial electrical systems, or mission-critical operations.. Direct experience with Liebert UPS 600 series and NXL systems, Square D electrical distribution equipment, ASCO transfer switches, and Cummins generators.. Experience creating, reviewing, or executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, risk assessments, change management documentation, and permits.. Experience supporting safety programs, environmental compliance, contractor management, purchasing, project execution, and continuous improvement initiatives.. Willingness to cross-train on HVAC, fire, BMS, and other data center infrastructure disciplines.. Proficiency with Claude, Copilot, and other AI tools for process automation and efficiency.. Systems you'll work with. Generators, switchgear, ATSs, ATOs, STSs, PDUs, UDBs, RPPs, UPS systems, BMS, electrical power monitoring systems, fire alarm systems, ATS controls, generator controls, and battery monitoring systems. Physical requirements. Moving throughout the facility to access all operational areas, including ascending and descending ladders and stairs, and moves equipment as needed to support operations, inspections, and emergency response activities. GoDaddy Commerce helps entrepreneurs sell online, in person, and across the workflows that run their businesses. We are looking for a Commerce Growth Director to accelerate adoption among higher-value brick-and-mortar businesses - including retailers, medical and professional offices, automotive businesses, and service providers operating at a power seller scale >$100K. Owning end-to-end go-to-market strategy and measurable growth outcomes for this segment - from merchant insight and positioning to offers, enablement, experimentation, launches, and demand generation. Working cross functionally you will connect customer truth to commercial execution and the product roadmap. This is a hands-on growth leadership role. You will interview our merchants, build the first narrative and proof point, train sellers, compose campaigns, inspect performance, and turn customer needs into product priorities. What you'll get to do... Understand and prioritize the merchant: Build the segment strategy. Define the most attractive use cases, verticals, jobs to be done, buying triggers, and barriers within the $100K-$1M, $1M+ segments. Turn merchant insight into action. Combine interviews, call listening, funnel analysis, competitive research, and win/loss learning into prioritized growth bets and roadmap input. Build and activate the go-to-market engine: Lead positioning and messaging. Develop benefit-led positioning and vertical stories beyond savings and free hardware, centered on simpler operations, growth, customer experience, flexibility, and confidence. Equip Sales to win by building narratives, qualification frameworks, objection handling, proof points, and seller-learning programs that improve acquisition, seller efficiency, product fit, and field confidence. Develop demand generation. Partner with Marketing to turn segment strategy into briefs, audiences, campaigns, content, and landing experiences; stay close enough to performance to refine them quickly. Build a disciplined experimentation roadmap. Develop learning agendas and tests across message, channel, offer, onboarding, and seller motion; detail what works and scale it fast. Evolve the commerce proposition: Accelerate SaaS growth. Develop the plan to materially increase SaaS adoption and attach, clarifying packaging, feature value, target personas, pitch, and the path to higher-margin recurring revenue. Improve pricing and offers. Shape and test pricing, transaction-fee structures, hardware purchase and rental models, credits, and other offers using customer response, conversion, retention, and unit economics. Create a connected commerce story. Connect in-person payments with e-commerce and omnichannel journeys and show how GoDaddy's AI-assisted and custom-build capabilities can create the workflows or vertical tools merchants need before integrating payments. Deliver end-to-end launches. Lead pricing, positioning, merchandising, purchase-path UX, seller readiness, customer guidance, and post-launch optimization for adjacent products and accessories. Operate the business: Own the growth scorecard. Define success measures across adoption, conversion, SaaS attach, product mix, retention, margin, and sales productivity; stay close to customer and seller calls to explain performance and drive rapid improvements. Strengthen planning and unit economics. Partner with Finance and Analytics on forecasts, sensitivity analyses, investment cases, and annual plans that connect near-term learning to the next phase of growth. Improve readiness and prioritization. Align Sales and self-serve journeys around a coherent offer set, make explicit tradeoffs, and protect capacity for the highest-yield initiatives. Your experience should include... 10+ years in growth, go-to-market, product marketing, commercialization, or a closely related field. Track record of taking a segment or product from insight through measurable adoption in a global organization. Deep fluency in SMB Commerce, payments, POS, commerce SaaS, Merchant vertical software or adjacent merchant solutions. Able to translate customer realities into clear market opportunities. Strong commercial judgment across pricing and packaging, offer design, funnel metrics, experimentation, retention, margin, product mix, unit economics and growth tradeoffs. Customer-led product craft including significant research instincts sharp positioning, compelling proof points, useful seller tools, launch planning, and the ability to turn merchant language into action. Executive-level communication and cross-functional leadership, with the confidence to create transparency and momentum across Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Analytics while moving between strategy, analysis, writing, training, execution, and thoughtful use of AI. description: Location Details: United States, Remote. At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. The Corporate Development team is at the forefront of driving and accelerating GoDaddy's next chapter of growth, playing a foundational role in identifying industry trends, building relationships with external partners, and identifying, negotiating, structuring, and executing strategic acquisitions and investments. Reporting into GoDaddy's Head of Corporate Development, this Director will lead transactions end-to-end and shape the recommendations that determine whether a deal is right for GoDaddy - not simply execute against a thesis someone else has already set. This is a critical role in crafting our future growth through investments and acquisitions, bringing in new and innovative capabilities, strengthening existing ones, and expanding our footprint and market opportunities. You will own the full arc of inorganic growth: sourcing and shaping the investment thesis, leading diligence and financial modeling, influencing senior executives on whether and how to proceed, and driving deals through negotiation, signing, and closing. What you'll get to do... Lead the end-to-end M&A process - sourcing, evaluating, structuring, negotiating, and closing deals - as the accountable deal lead, not just a supporting contributor. Shape and pressure-test the investment thesis behind potential transactions, including build-vs-buy, buy-vs-partner, and strategic adjacency analysis. Present investment recommendations directly to senior executives, defend the underlying assumptions, and be willing to recommend against a transaction when the economics or strategic logic don't hold up. Drive cross-functional diligence across Finance, Legal, Tax, Strategy, Product, Partnerships, and business leadership - creating momentum and alignment without direct authority over those teams. Own financial modeling, valuation, and business-case development, translating complex financial analysis into clear, defensible recommendations. Build and maintain relationships with key industry players, investment banks, and advisors to develop a proprietary, forward-looking deal pipeline. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify strategic opportunities, capability gaps, and market entry options ahead of the competition. Guide post-merger integration planning to ensure the value case underlying the deal is realized after close. Develop and refine playbooks that raise the bar for repeatable process and best-in-class execution across the team. Your experience should include... 10+ years of experience spanning investment banking and corporate development, with investment banking experience required as part of your background. Join our team. GoDaddy has been helping entrepreneurs start and grow businesses online for more than 25 years. We are the world's largest domain registrar, and the infrastructure millions of small businesses depend on to get found, get online, and get paid runs on what we have crafted. Our foundation is on connecting with entrepreneurs in their current situation. We help them get their business online no matter their location or technical skills. Today, we are making that infrastructure programmable for the AI era. Marketing now has two audiences: entrepreneurs building their businesses and the AI agents they rely on for direction. Increasingly, a business journey starts inside an AI tool, not on a website. GoDaddy's Developer Platform helps us show up in those moments as the distribution layer for the next era of business creation. GoDaddy is looking for a Director, Agent and Developer Platform Growth to own making GoDaddy more discoverable, recommendable, and trusted by the developers, agencies, domain investors, and AI agents crafting how businesses get started and run online. Our role sits at the intersection of agentic AI, developer marketing, content strategy, and platform partnerships. Reporting into Growth GTM leadership and working closely with the Developer Platform product team and central marketing functions, this person will build a new growth function from the ground up. The platform launched in 2026 and is in active growth; this Director will help define what it becomes. What you'll get to do... Define the function. Develop the operating model, and evaluation framework for how GoDaddy's Developer Platform is discovered, embraced, and recommended by developers and AI systems. You will not inherit the playbook - you will build it. Meet our customers where their journeys begin. Customers are increasingly starting inside AI tools, coding environments, and agent frameworks. Ensure GoDaddy is recommended when AI is asked to help entrepreneurs start, build, or own a business online - and that our Developer Platform makes the next step easy to take. Own AI-agent distribution and platform partnerships. Being readable by AI systems is the baseline; being reachable means GoDaddy appears where agents already look, including connector and MCP directories across Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and the tools that follow them. Identify partners that matter, establish relationships, and get GoDaddy into the default path for domains, hosting, and getting a business online. Make GoDaddy readable by AI systems and useful to developers. Collaborate with product, engineering, marketing, and site teams to ensure developer.godaddy.com is built for both machine and human consumption, with changelog infrastructure, llms.txt, markdown-native workflow documentation, business recipes, and integration guides that AI systems can reference and developers can act on. Lead agent engine optimization as a core growth workstream. Build GoDaddy's presence, citation frequency, and referral influence across AI-assisted discovery platforms, including coding assistants, agent frameworks, LLM chat environments, and emerging AI operating systems. Own developer GTM channels. Lead the engineering blog, Discord, email newsletter, developer and AI builder community outlets, GoDaddy Pros and WD&D outreach, and social amplification. Each channel should have a clear role in driving awareness, adoption, or advocacy. Evangelize and represent GoDaddy externally. Plan and lead customer engagement events to drive adoption. Attend external developer conferences and industry events and serve as a credible voice for GoDaddy in the developer and AI-native builder community. Build and own the change communications system. Every platform release, breaking change, deprecation, pricing update, and landmark needs the right message for the right audience. Invest the classification framework, set the standard for how changes are communicated, and lead the channels they run through so active integrators are never surprised. Scale the platform story. As our GoDaddy Developer Platform expands across additional product areas and use cases; grow the GTM motion with it, ensuring each expansion reaches the right audience with a clear narrative at the right time. Drive cross-functional alignment. Partner closely with Developer Platform product and engineering teams and central marketing functions to keep GTM, product, and platform delivery moving together. Our role sits at that seam on purpose. Measure what matters. The signals that show our platform-led growth is working, including agent citation rate, AI referral traffic from developer tools, businesses launched through the platform, multi-product provisioning completion, and attach and retention from platform-acquired customers. Your experience should include... 10+ years proven experience across developer marketing, technical marketing, product marketing, technical partnerships, or developer relations, ideally within a global platform, developer infrastructure, API-first, cloud, or ecosystem-led business. Shown success building cross-functional GTM programs across product, engineering, communications, partnerships, community, events, email, social, press, and core marketing teams. A track record of earning credibility with developers, technical practitioners, agencies, open-source communities, or platform ecosystems, including familiarity with how these audiences appraise platforms through documentation, GitHub, tutorials, community channels, and peer validation. Experience crafting platform partnerships and ecosystem distribution, including getting products into partner workflows, marketplaces, connector directories, coding assistants, LLM chat environments, or developer plugin experiences. Strong understanding of developer tools, AI agents, MCP integrations, agent engine optimization, LLM discovery behavior, machine-readable content, and how to translate sophisticated platform capabilities into clear narratives for developer, business, and executive audiences. Experience with legacy platforms. We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn't align perfectly with every requirement. Document specifications for self-service platforms and tools to reduce manual intervention in certificate operations. Develop automated testing scripts and define requirements for continuous compliance monitoring systems with automated remediation capabilities. Technical Collaboration & Documentation. Systems engineering background with experience in distributed systems, API design, database architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). GoDaddy's Global Storage Engineering team operates one of the largest Ceph environments in the world, delivering the object, block, and file storage platforms that power GoDaddy's hosting infrastructure, internal services, OpenStack environments, and next-generation AI/HPC workloads. If you're passionate about distributed systems, storage architecture, and solving failure scenarios at massive scale, this is an opportunity to work on infrastructure few engineers will experience in their careers. Ceph is a strategic platform at GoDaddy - not an ancillary service. Our global footprint includes 80+ production clusters, 20,000+ OSDs, 1,830 storage nodes, 300 PB of raw capacity, and 69 billion objects spanning five datacenters across three continents. The platform supports RBD, RGW (S3/Swift), and CephFS workloads through more than 1,550 pools, 574,000 placement groups, and 900+ MDS daemons, creating engineering challenges that demand deep expertise in storage architecture, data durability, performance optimization, automation, and observability. You'll design the next generation of storage clusters, lead major platform upgrades, drive capacity and hardware strategy, and establish the standards that govern how the platform scales. You'll be the engineer the team turns to for the most complex storage challenges, helping shape multi-quarter architectural direction while mentoring other engineers in advanced Ceph design and operations. This role is ideal for a seasoned storage engineer who wants to influence the future of a globally distributed storage platform serving millions of customers. What You'll Get to Do. Design and architect large-scale production Ceph clusters, including CRUSH topology, failure-domain modeling, replication and erasure-coding strategies, storage hardware selection, and data placement architecture. Lead fleet-wide capacity planning, performance modeling, and hardware qualification across 80+ production clusters comprising 20,000+ OSDs and 300 PB of raw storage. Own major platform upgrades and migration initiatives, including Ceph releases, OpenStack integrations, and large-scale storage modernization efforts. Drive resolution of the most complex cross-functional production incidents spanning storage, networking, virtualization, and compute systems. Establish automation, operational standards, and reliability practices that improve platform scalability, reduce toil, and increase engineering efficiency across the storage organization. Strong automation and software engineering skills using Python and/or Go , combined with Infrastructure-as-Code and orchestration frameworks such as Terraform, SaltStack , and Ansible. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely. This is a remote position, so you'll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands. Join our team. At GoDaddy, we're not just building tools - we're building bold, resilient leaders who can drive transformative change. Our Senior Directors are entrepreneurial, adaptable, and relentless in their pursuit of impact, operating on the frontlines of our most important and ambiguous challenges to shape the future of the business from within. We are seeking a Senior Director Corporate Strategy, who will be entrusted with GoDaddy's most strategic priorities and asked to solve our hardest, least-defined problems: Where should GoDaddy grow? What markets are most attractive? Where is competitive pressure increasing? What capabilities should we build, buy, or partner for? How should we allocate resources, and what should we prioritize? In this role, you won't be defined by function or title, but by the quality of your judgment and the outcomes you drive. What you'll get to do... Own Ambiguity End-to-End: Take an open-ended executive question and independently convert it into hypotheses, rigorous analysis, strategic options, a clear recommendation, and a path to action. Drive Strategic Impact: Lead critical, cross-functional initiatives with high visibility and material outcomes - often reported to shareholders. Advise Senior Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor to executives, bringing structured thinking to their hardest, least-defined problems and challenging assumptions when the data warrants it. Where Needed: Take on multiple roles to get the job done - whether as a governance lead, initiative owner, advisor, or subject matter expert. Build and Scale Capabilities: Deliver insights and solutions while laying the groundwork for repeatable models, systems, and processes. Lead Through Influence: Whether by setting a bold vision, working shoulder-to-shoulder, or mentoring leaders - you'll lead from the front, side, and behind. Craft and Complete: Apply a diverse toolkit that includes market sizing, competitive analysis, customer segmentation, scenario planning, financial analysis, and business-case development. When the tools are lacking, you'll build them. Accelerate Execution: Apply urgency, precision, and focus to carry a recommendation through executive decision-making into implementation and measurable business outcomes - not handing it off once the deck is done. Communicate with Clarity: Distill complex, ambiguous strategic issues into simple, credible narratives for executive audiences - what we should do, why, what evidence supports it, what alternatives exist, and what happens if we don't act. Your experience should include... 10+ years of experience in top-tier strategy consulting, corporate strategy, corporate development, private equity, or a related field, preferably within technology, with customer-first strategy development and execution. A demonstrated track record of independently owning complex, ambiguous strategic problems and shaping enterprise-level recommendations for senior leadership - not simply running analyses or managing individual strategy projects. Proven experience guiding multi-team, technology-centric initiatives from planning through implementation, including identifying and executing growth and value-creation strategies such as new business launches, market entry, partnerships, or M&A. Strong financial analysis skills and a proven ability to develop deep market, customer, and competitive analyses that uncover trends, risks, and opportunities to inform data-driven decisions. Strong executive presence and communication skills, with a track record of building consensus and driving decisions across senior, cross-functional stakeholders, even amid disagreement or competing priorities. You might also have... Training at a top-tier management consulting firm early in your career. Corporate strategy experience at a leading, high-growth technology, marketplace, or platform company. A background spanning investment banking and/or venture capital en route to a corporate strategy leadership role. Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. MBA or advanced degree. We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn't align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth. . About us.. Come join GoDaddy's Identity and Access Management team as a Senior Systems Engineer, Directory Services and play a key role in powering the systems that keep our people, platforms, and customers connected and secure!. You'll tackle complex challenges across Active Directory, Certificate Services, DNS, replication, and Linux integration while operating critical infrastructure at enterprise scale. Secure, operate, and improve enterprise Active Directory services, including domain controllers, sites and services, Group Policy, authentication flows, and directory-integrated services. Deep expertise securing and managing Microsoft Active Directory in large-scale enterprise environments, including domain controllers, Group Policy, trusts, authentication, and directory-integrated services. Strong knowledge of Active Directory hardening, authentication protocols, DNS, Kerberos, LDAP, replication, and secure configuration baselines. Experience securing and administering Windows Server environments, including DNS, Enterprise Certificate Services, certificate lifecycle management, and operational risk reduction. Proficiency integrating Linux systems with Active Directory using technologies such as SSSD, realmd, Samba, Kerberos, LDAP, and PAM. Hands-on experience with automation, scripting, and security operations using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Puppet/OpenVox, incident response processes, monitoring, change management, and privileged access controls. You might also have... Experience with hybrid identity or adjacent identity platforms, such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, privileged access management, or identity governance and administration. Experience securing Windows Enterprise Certificate Authority environments, including certificate templates, enrollment controls, lifecycle management, and certificate services risk reduction. This isn't reporting for reporting's sake: our analysis sets strategy and direction at the business-unit level. Strong data visualization and executive communication skills, including hands-on experience building business-focused dashboards (Amazon QuickSight preferred), advanced Excel models, and boardroom-ready PowerPoint presentations. Demonstrated use of AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and analytical depth, combined with exceptional analytical storytelling, sound judgment, the ability to thrive in ambiguity, and effective cross-functional collaboration to drive business outcomes.. If designated as remote, you'll be working remotely from your home and may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. They think about getting paid, covering payroll, and keeping the lights on - often in the same afternoon. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager on our Commerce team, you'll own the go-to-market for the GoDaddy products that sit right in the middle of that: capital, instant payouts, business banking and debit cards, and insurance. This is a hybrid of product marketing and go-to-market. You'll define positioning, packaging, and pricing for our financial services solutions, and you'll cross-sell them to the entrepreneurs who already run their business on GoDaddy Payments. You'll own the story, the audiences, and the campaigns that put the right offer in front of the right customer at the right moment. You'll make sure the customer's voice comes through in every value proposition, building a differentiated message that resonates with everyday entrepreneurs trying to grow. And you'll work closely with product, sales, and partner teams to launch these solutions well - delighting our customers and driving company growth. What you'll get to do... Develop and execute product marketing strategies for financial services offerings, including messaging, positioning, pricing, packaging, and content that drives customer engagement and sales enablement.. Lead customer lifecycle marketing programs, building targeted campaigns, audience segments, and ideal customer profiles that improve engagement, adoption, and cross-sell opportunities.. Design and run experiments across product surfaces to test messaging, offers, and features, using insights and performance data to optimize outcomes.. Support major product launches and independently lead go-to-market efforts for new products and features, partnering across teams to drive successful adoption.. Conduct customer, competitive, and market research, translating qualitative and quantitative insights into recommendations that inform messaging, positioning, pricing, and product strategy.. Your experience should include... 7+ years of product marketing experience, including 4+ years in SaaS and 2+ years in payments or financial services.. Shown experience in customer lifecycle marketing, including campaign launches, audience development, ideal customer profiles, and product messaging and positioning that drives engagement.. Strong understanding of small business customers, with experience conducting customer research, in-market testing, and developing insights that inform go-to-market strategies.. Experience running experiments and testing within product surfaces to support data-driven decision making across self-serve and sales-led B2B motions.. Track record of successfully launching new products and features, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments using a test-and-learn approach.. You might also have... Experience in pricing and packaging analysis. Experience marketing regulated or partner-delivered financial products. Deep customer empathy that influences both product and marketing efforts. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Security Engineer to join our advanced Security Operations team. This role is focused on leading complex incident response and forensic investigations across Windows, macOS, Linux, and AWS environments while helping modernize security operations through automation and AI-driven capabilities. The ideal candidate is a hands-on security expert with deep AWS security expertise, strong threat detection and digital forensic skills, and experience leveraging AI and machine learning technologies to improve detection, response, and operational efficiency. Strong scripting and automation skills with Python, PowerShell, and/or Bash, including building security automations using AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge; experience applying AI and ML technologies to security operations is highly desirable. Strong communication and investigative skills, including technical reporting, executive presentations, and preferred certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, OSCP, or CISSP. Experience with additional EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, or Carbon Black. Expertise building and maintaining SOAR platforms, automated response workflows, and cloud-native security operations. Experience with AI security technologies including Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Security Copilot, Google SecOps/Chronicle, or open-source LLM integrations. title: Senior NPI Product Engineer
description: Hybrid Model: 4 days in office (Monday - Thursday). Our Team:. At Semtech, the New Product Introduction (NPI) Product Engineering team is the central force behind every product we bring to market.. The team takes full ownership of new product development, guiding each program from concept through to high-volume manufacturing and end-of-life, with a focus on quality, precision, and execution.. Working across Design, Test, Validation, Quality, Reliability, Applications, and Operations, our engineers define testability requirements, drive comprehensive characterisation across PVT, ensure robust ATE-to-bench correlation, optimise yield and test cost, and enable seamless transfer into production.. As demand for high-performance optical and analog/mixed-signal IC solutions continues to grow, we are strengthening our NPI capability to ensure we consistently deliver best-in-class product performance, manufacturability, and customer value.. Job Summary. We are currently looking for a Sr. NPI Product Engineer to join our team. This role sits at the heart of new product development - engaged from product concept through end-of-life - collaborating closely with all internal cross-functional teams to drive program success. This is a unique opportunity for a passionate and driven engineer to influence key engineering and product decisions and make a meaningful impact on the cutting-edge products we deliver to our customers worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity to work within a world-class NPI development team, focused on designing and developing advanced high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductor IC products in cutting-edge CMOS and BiCMOS technologies. Our products are built with purpose and precision - operating at data rates of 25-400Gbps and beyond - delivering faster, more reliable connectivity for AI data centers, PON, and 5G wireless networks. Reporting to the Manager of NPI Product Engineering, the Sr. NPI Product Engineer will take full ownership of all NPI activities - driving and executing from product concept through final product release while maintaining the product life cycle.. Responsibilities. 1. NPI Program Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration (25%). Lead and drive all NPI activities from product concept through final product release while ensuring product conformance to specifications, and seamless transfer to full-volume manufacturing. Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Project Lead, Design, Marketing, Validation, Test Engineering, Characterization, Quality & Reliability, Applications Engineering and Operations to ensure successful product development and delivery. Actively participate in the milestone reviews of NPI program logistics, timelines, and milestones, providing regular updates to management and stakeholders. Prepare all NPI product release and OSAT related manufacturing documentations for production transfer and product maintenance. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior product engineers. 2. Design for Testability/Manufacturability (35%). Lead team to define Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Testability (DfT) requirements for NPI products and provide feedback to design for implementation to ensure comprehensive and efficient production test coverage. Support test engineers in the development, implementation, verification and optimization of ATE test programs ensuring the testability/manufacturability features are considered and implemented, and that test coverage and quality is achieved while maintaining accurate cost models. Lead product characterization, correlation and release activities, ensuring all datasheet specifications are validated and met. 3. Characterization, Data Analysis & Yield Optimization (30%). Develop comprehensive product characterization plans encompassing both wafer-level and bench characterization tests, ensuring thorough test coverage across all product specifications and operating conditions. Conduct rigorous data analysis of ATE and bench characterization results across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, including ATE-to-bench correlation studies, PCM data analysis, process capability analysis to ensure product conformance to specifications and yield modeling for new products. Plan and execute Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize product performance, drive yield analysis, test time reduction, and test optimization efforts - identifying and resolving yield limiters in close collaboration with Design, Test, Quality, and Foundry Process teams. Contribute to product validation and reliability qualification plans working closely with Test, Characterization, Validation, and Reliability Engineering teams to ensure alignment and successful execution. 4. Manufacturing Quality, Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement (10%). Work with foundry process/packaging engineering in the resolution of problems that occur during wafer fabrication, packaging, die sort and final package test processes. Drive the resolution of failure analysis, root cause and corrective actions for field returns. Monitor and maintain product life cycle, identifying opportunities for cost reduction and continuous improvement. Minimum Qualifications:. BSc in Electrical Engineering or related field and a minimum of 8 years relevant work experience. Experience in semi-conductor technology, product, test and/or design engineering. Experience with quality systems including corrective actions, 8D reports, non-conformance reports, and failure analysis reports. Knowledge and experience with statistical theory and data analysis tools (e.g. Excel, JMP, Galaxy, dataConductor) for design of experiments, yield reporting and modelling. Experience in high-speed digital ATE test platforms (e.g. Advantest, Teradyne) or equivalent rack solutions is an asset. Strong knowledge of high-speed serial digital interconnect components and test methodologies. Experience with JEDEC, and/or Mil quality requirements.. Additional Notes:. The intent of this job description is to describe the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job.. Incumbents may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically included in this description.. All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.. Drive yield modeling activities and lead DOE planning and execution to support yield analysis, test time reduction, and test optimization. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce NPI cycle time by 10-20%. Production Excellence & Scale. Expertise in analog/mixed-signal DFT techniques (BIST, scan, boundary scan). Proficiency in RF/microwave test techniques beyond 40GHz. Strong presentation skills to executive leadership and customers. Desired Qualifications:. The extra depth that sets a standout candidate apart:. Experience with SiGe BiCMOS process technology and its test challenges. Knowledge of automotive quality standards (AEC-Q100) and qualification flows. Familiarity with 93000 PS1600/PS5000 digital channels and Wave Scale RF. Experience with wafer-level testing and probe card design. Experience with test data analytics and machine learning applications. Why Join Us?. Join a team with the scale and ambition to match your expertise, not one that will under-use it. Career Growth Philosophy:. At Semtech, we believe innovation starts with people. title: Demand Planner
description: Location: Alhambra, CA (Hybrid). Job Summary :. Semtech is seeking a Demand Planner to own the demand forecast for assigned SPP product families at our Alhambra, California facility. This role sits at the center of the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) cycle - translating sales input, distributor sell-through, and statistical baselines into a single consensus demand plan that drives supply commitments, inventory targets, and quarterly revenue execution.. The role extends beyond demand. The Demand Planner is also accountable for translating the consensus demand plan into an executable supply plan - running MRP, maintaining the bill of material and planning master data that drive it, and monitoring supply coverage against inventory, lead time, and service targets across the foundry and OSAT network.. The successful candidate is analytical, comfortable defending a forecast position with data, and able to work credibly with Sales, Business Unit leadership, Operations, and Finance. This is a high-visibility role: the output of this position directly informs wafer starts, assembly and test capacity bookings, and the revenue commitments the business makes to executive leadership.. Key Responsibilities. Statistical Forecasting & S&OP. Own the baseline forecast. Build, maintain, and continuously improve statistical demand models in SAP APO for assigned SPP product families across a rolling 18-month horizon. Drive the consensus cycle. Lead the demand review step of the monthly S&OP process - prepare the pre-consensus package, reconcile Sales, BU, and statistical views, and publish the agreed demand plan on cycle. Segment and prioritize. Apply ABC/XYZ and volume-volatility segmentation so forecasting effort and model selection match the value and predictability of each part. Measure and close the loop. Track forecast accuracy (MAPE) and bias at multiple aggregation levels and lags; run root-cause analysis on major misses and drive corrective actions with the responsible stakeholders. Model demand scenarios. Quantify upside, downside, and design-win ramp scenarios; translate them into supply and inventory implications for the S&OP executive review.. Revenue Execution & Backlog Managemen t. Convert plan to revenue. Partner with Order Management, Sales, and Operations to align backlog, scheduled ship dates, and supply availability against the quarterly revenue plan. Manage supply-demand balance. Identify shortages, allocation conflicts, and excess positions early; recommend pull-ins, push-outs, substitutions, or reallocation with a clear revenue and margin rationale. Improve linearity. Monitor weekly billings pace against plan, flag back-end-loaded risk, and drive actions that smooth quarterly shipment profiles. Support the quarterly close. Provide reliable weekly revenue outlooks and gap-to-plan analysis for BU and Finance review. Own upside and risk visibility. Maintain a documented view of committed, probable, and at-risk revenue, with the assumptions behind each clearly stated.. Customer & Channel Demand. Manage channel demand signals. Analyze distributor POS and POI data, inventory-in-channel positions, and sell-through trends; incorporate them into the demand plan rather than relying on ship-in alone. Collaborate with key accounts. Work with Sales and Customer Service on direct customer forecasts, EDI/portal signals, consignment and hub programs, and forecast commitments. Monitor channel inventory health. Track weeks-of-inventory at distribution and escalate over- or under-stocked positions before they distort demand. Validate demand quality. Reconcile customer forecasts against historical consumption and design-win pipeline; challenge unsupported step changes with data.. Supply Planning & Execution. Generate the supply plan. Convert the consensus demand plan into a constrained, executable supply plan in SAP APO - running MRP/SNP, netting against on-hand, WIP, and die bank, and releasing planned orders across the foundry, assembly, and test network. Balance the multi-stage network. Plan wafer starts, die bank positions, and assembly/test builds against long lead times, ensuring front-end commitments are placed early enough to support the back-end build plan. Monitor supply targets. Track supply coverage against inventory targets, days-of-supply, safety stock, and on-time-delivery goals; identify gaps before they become shortages and drive recovery actions with Operations and the supply base. Manage exceptions. Work MRP exception messages, reschedule-in/out signals, and pegging conflicts daily; resolve or escalate with a clear impact statement on revenue and customer commitments. Own inventory health. Recommend inventory target changes based on demand variability, lead time, and service-level requirements; monitor and drive action on excess, slow-moving, and obsolete (E&O) exposure. Support capacity planning. Provide rolling capacity requirements to internal Operations and external partners, and flag where demand exceeds committed capacity in time for the S&OP supply review.. BOM & Master Data Management. Own planning master data. Maintain and validate the master data that drives planning output - material masters, MRP types, lot sizing rules, planned and GR processing times, safety stock, reorder points, and rounding values. Manage bills of material. Maintain multi-level BOMs across die, package, and finished-good stages; ensure routings, production versions, and source lists accurately reflect the qualified manufacturing flow. Control changes. Execute BOM, source, and master data changes through the engineering change (ECN/PCN) process, assessing the demand, supply, and inventory impact of each change before release. Manage product transitions. Plan build-out and build-in for new product introductions, second-source qualifications, and end-of-life transitions so that changes do not strand inventory or interrupt supply. Enforce data integrity. Run periodic master data audits, correct defects at the root cause, and maintain documentation sufficient for internal and SOX-related audit review.. Analytics, Systems & Continuous Improvement. Maintain demand and supply planning parameters in SAP APO to ensure clean, auditable planning inputs and repeatable output. Build and maintain recurring reporting and dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for forecast accuracy, backlog, supply coverage, inventory, and channel health. Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and - where appropriate - AI/ML-assisted forecasting techniques that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy. Document planning procedures and support internal and SOX-related audit requirements.. Required Qualifications. Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. 3-5 years of demand planning, supply planning, materials/production planning, or supply chain analytics experience. Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning system (SAP APO, IBP, Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder, or equivalent), including MRP execution and exception management. Working knowledge of ERP master data structures - material masters, multi-level BOMs, routings, production versions, and MRP parameters - and how they drive planning output. Understanding of inventory management fundamentals: safety stock, lot sizing, days-of-supply, and service-level trade-offs. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and large-dataset manipulation. Working knowledge of forecasting methods (moving average, exponential smoothing, seasonal and causal models) and standard accuracy metrics (MAPE, bias, WMAPE). Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Finance, and to present analysis clearly to management. Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain a forecast position and defend it with evidence. Authorized to work in the United States; able to work on-site at the Alhambra, California facility.. Preferred Qualifications. Semiconductor, electronics, or other long-lead-time manufacturing industry experience. Direct experience with SAP APO (DP module) and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC). Familiarity with distribution channel dynamics - POS/POI reporting, ship-and-debit, price protection, and stock rotation. Exposure to foundry and OSAT supply models, including cycle times, die bank strategy, and capacity booking. Experience managing engineering change (ECN/PCN), NPI ramp, second-source qualification, and end-of-life build-out plans. APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) or IBF CPF certification. Proficiency with SQL, Python, Power BI, or Tableau for advanced demand analytics. Prior participation in a formal S&OP or IBP process at a multi-business-unit company.. (10%). · Documentation & Standards: Author and maintain comprehensive packaging specifications, process control documents, design rule guidelines, and qualification reports, ensuring full traceability and compliance with internal quality systems and customer-specific requirements. (10%). . Minimum Qualifications:. Experience. · Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in semiconductor packaging engineering, with a demonstrated track record of increasing technical responsibility. · Demonstrated hands-on experience with advanced package formats relevant to discrete protection devices, including WLCSP, DFN, QFN, SOD, SOT, and flip-chip assemblies. · Direct experience working with OSAT partners in a technical capacity, including process development, design rule definition, and supplier qualification activities. · Proven experience executing JEDEC and AEC-Q101 reliability qualification programs, including test plan development, data analysis, and formal qualification reporting.. title: Senior Quality Process Development Engineer
description: Location: Burlington, Canada. Our Team:. Semtech's Product Quality Engineering team is responsible for the quality and reliability of every wafer that leaves our fabs and OSAT partners on its way to customers. Our engineers thrive on solving complex technical challenges and driving improvements that directly impact product reliability and customer satisfaction including building a new generation of statistical and data-driven tools to detect, characterize, and triage wafer-level quality issues faster and more consistently than manual review alone can achieve. You'll join a team where mentorship, technical excellence, and knowledge sharing create a culture of growth, innovation, and tangible impact.. Job Summary:. The Senior Quality Process Development Engineer will collaborate on the design, development, and validation the statistical and machine-learning systems at the core of Semtech's quality processes along with our tool software partners. This role will define the technical development specifications for quality process improvement activities; including detection and pattern-recognition capabilities that distinguish genuine product and process issues from test-induced artifacts, and that support downstream risk assessment and mitigation for production wafer lots. The engineer will work closely with our tool development partners, internal AI team, Quality Engineering, Product Engineering, and the in-house wafer assessment tool development team to integrate these capabilities into existing production systems and will build learned pattern-recognition models from engineer-confirmed labels to complement rules-based statistical detection.. Responsibilities:. Design and build statistical and algorithmic detection tools for wafer probe data - including test hardware integrity checks, software bin/yield outlier detection, parametric drift analysis, and reticle- and wafer-level spatial pattern classification - leveraging Semtech's existing statistical infrastructure (20%). Assist on the development of learned pattern-recognition models that classify wafer-level failure patterns from engineer-confirmed examples, complementing the statistical tool set and supporting multi-pattern classification with confidence indicators. Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning classification models, including training on labeled data and handling out-of-distribution/novel-category detection. Proficiency in Python (or equivalent) for data analysis and ML model development, and strong SQL or equivalent skills for working with large structured production datasets. Demonstrated ability to design structured, self-describing system outputs and to write clear technical documentation for engineering audiences. . Desired Qualifications. Experience with semiconductor test data, wafer probe, or final test engineering, including familiarity with concepts such as software binning, parametric test limits, and wafer map analysis. Direct experience with a comparable semiconductor test-data / yield-analysis platform. Experience building LLM-driven analysis or reporting systems that incorporate domain context to scope and focus model output. Familiarity with spatial/statistical process control methods (e.g., Tukey-method outlier detection, radial/angular trend analysis, spatial clustering) as applied to manufacturing data. Prior experience working in a regulated or quality-critical manufacturing environment where system outputs feed formal disposition or non-conforming material review processes. . title: Principal NPI Test Engineer
description: Our Team:. Semtech's Global Test Engineering team is a world-class organization of innovative engineers who enable the success of our entire semiconductor portfolio through cutting-edge test solutions and methodologies. We are the technical backbone that ensures every Semtech product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Our team spans multiple sites globally and serves as the center of excellence for test innovation, working closely with all business units to deliver breakthrough test capabilities. We specialize in mixed-signal, high-speed digital, and RF test development, with particular expertise in advanced SiGe BiCMOS technologies. Our engineers drive competitive advantage through innovative test architectures, methodologies, and continuous improvement initiatives that directly impact Semtech's bottom line.. Primary responsibilities:. Technical Leadership & Architecture (30%). Architect and define test strategies for complex mixed-signal SiGe products from concept through production maturity. Lead development of innovative test methodologies for high-speed SerDes, CDRs, and signal conditioning products. Drive DFT/testability requirements into IC architecture, establishing company-wide standards and best practices. Develop and implement advanced test techniques for products operating at >200Gbps data rates. Create reusable test IP, libraries, and frameworks that accelerate NPI cycles across product families. Perform technical risk assessment and mitigation strategies for test coverage and quality. Cross-functional NPI Support (30%). Serve as test engineering authority in product architecture reviews and gate meetings. Partner with IC design teams from concept phase to ensure optimal test coverage and manufacturability. Lead test readiness reviews with stakeholders, providing strategic recommendations. Collaborate with Product Engineering to define characterization strategies and correlation methodologies. Interface with customer quality teams on test specifications and coverage requirements. Architect and launch test solutions that achieve test time targets for complex mixed-signal devices. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce NPI cycle time by 10-20%. Innovation & Technology Development (20%). Research and implement next-generation ATE capabilities and measurement techniques. Develop proprietary test methods that provide competitive advantage in cost and quality. Lead evaluation and adoption of new test platforms, instrumentation, and methodologies. Pioneer implementation of AI/ML techniques for yield enhancement and test optimization. Establish Semtech as industry leader in mixed-signal test innovation. Production Excellence & Scale (10%). Ensure seamless transfer of test solutions to high-volume OSATs with >99% first-pass success. Drive test cost reduction initiatives delivering year-over-year improvements. Establish and monitor KPIs for test effectiveness, efficiency, and quality. Mentorship & Knowledge Management (10%). Mentor junior engineers, developing next generation of test leaders. Create and maintain comprehensive test methodology documentation and training materials. Build strategic relationships with test partners to influence platform development. Foster culture of innovation and continuous learning within test organization. Education and Experience. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. 12+ years of progressive experience in semiconductor test engineering. 8+ years specifically in mixed-signal/RF test development. Proven track record leading NPI programs for high-speed communication ICs. Technical Expertise:. Expert-level proficiency with Advantest V93000 platform (SmarTest 7/8). Advanced programming skills in C/C++, Python, and TCL. Deep understanding of high-speed signal integrity, jitter analysis, and BER testing. Expertise in analog/mixed-signal DFT techniques (BIST, scan, boundary scan). Proficiency in RF/microwave test techniques beyond 40GHz. Strong foundation in statistical process control and quality methodologies. Experience with PCB design tools (Cadence, Altium) and signal integrity simulation. Leadership & Business Acumen:. Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority across organizations. Track record of delivering complex projects on aggressive schedules. Strong presentation skills to executive leadership and customers. Proven ability to build and maintain strategic vendor relationships. Desired Qualifications:. Master's degree or PhD in relevant engineering discipline. 15+ years in semiconductor test with focus on SerDes/high-speed I/O. Experience with SiGe BiCMOS process technology and its test challenges. Knowledge of automotive quality standards (AEC-Q100) and qualification flows. Familiarity with 93000 PS1600/PS3600 digital channels and Wave Scale RF. Experience with wafer-level testing and probe card design. Experience with test data analytics and machine learning applications. Unique Differentiators for This Role:. Serves as company-wide test architecture authority for mixed-signal products. Builds test capabilities that enable entry into new markets and applications. Establishes Semtech's reputation as test innovation leader in high-speed communications. title: Hardware Applications Engineer - Sensing Solutions
description: Location: San Jose, CA - Hybrid (4 days in office, Friday remote). . Background. Semtech's force sensing solutions eliminate the design compromises inherent in traditional mechanical buttons and capacitive touch, delivering sealed, material-agnostic interfaces that enhance both user experience and product reliability.. In this role, you will be working closely with our mechanical, electrical, and software teams to integrate our sensing products into our customers' electronic devices. The work centers on low-voltage, sensor-based electronics in finished consumer and automotive products. You will collaborate with various OEMs on next generation products, including laptops, mobile phones, automotive steering wheels & smart surfaces, fitness trackers, and industrial display panels.. Your core responsibilities include preparing schematic designs, PCB layouts, Gerber files, bill of materials, and fabrication notes. You will debug electrical issues on fabricated test boards, modules and prototypes, while managing vendors to ensure on-time delivery of the designed boards and modules. Additionally, you will work closely with the R&D team on bench-level evaluation of new sensor products and resolve system-level issues for both internal and external customers.. Your tasks can also vary from electrical design, mechanical design, and firmware integration. You will experience the entire product lifecycle from concept design and proof-of-concept builds through mass production.. Responsibilities:. Design and Development: Propose and implement innovative solutions for customers particularly in mechanical, electrical, software integration and algorithm development; develop and build proof-of-concept demos and prototypes; perform electrical design, PCB layout & fabrication, and electrical component sourcing; conduct debugging and hardware bring-up of solutions of targeted applications; support R&D test & evaluation board design & fabrication; manage PCB vendors. Customer Support and Engagement: Manage customer evaluation kits and sensor modules design and fabrication; promote cutting-edge HMI sensor solution; provide multidisciplinary technical support (hardware, firmware and mechanical) to customers from concept to mass production. Test and Characterization: Work closely with the R&D team on sensor-level and system-level test and characterization; conduct competitor analysis and failure analysis. Technical Documentation and Training: Provide product training to customers, sales and FAEs; create technical documentation including datasheets, application notes, design guides, and white papers. Collaboration: Collect customer feedback and requests, liaise with marketing and R&D to drive continuous improvements, shape roadmaps, and develop new technologies. Industry engagement: Stay current with the latest advancements in consumer electronics and related industries. Minimum Qualifications:. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 2+ years of professional experience in board-level electronic design ( recent graduates with substantial hands-on circuit board design and microcontroller project experience will be considered). Proficiency with Altium, Cadence, or Siemens for schematic capture and PCB layout with multiple boards fabricated. Hands-on experience with board-level analog / mixed-signal circuit design. Hands-on experience with microcontroller-based designs (e.g., Arduino, STM32, or similar), including I2C/SPI communication interfaces. Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: ADCs, sensors, embedded system design, firmware development, or sensor signal post-processing. Working knowledge of low-voltage power circuitry, such as LDOs and voltage regulators. Proficiency in at least one of the following languages: C/C++, Python. Familiarity with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzer, digital analyzer, multimeter, soldering iron, etc. Experience writing technical documentation such as test reports, design specifications, bring-up notes, or application notes. Customer-centric work ethic with strong communication and presentation skills to engage with customers and collaborate efficiently with diverse stakeholders. Willing and able to travel up to 10%, domestic and international. . Desired Qualifications:. Experience in customer-facing or applications engineering work within the semiconductor industry. Experience supporting products from proof-of-concept through mass production. Experience with sensor-based products in consumer electronics, automotive or medical devices. Algorithm development experience. Experience with AI/ML tools such as Claude. title: Characterization Technician
description: Job Summary:. . The Characterization Technician is a role within Semtech's Backend Characterization Engineering team, based at our Aguascalientes, Mexico site and working in close coordination with counterparts across the UK, Canada, and the United States. Working primarily an afternoon and overnight shift (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM), with flexibility to start earlier if conditions permit, the Characterization Technician is responsible for actively monitoring and running up to 10 characterization test benches during off-hours - including changing parts, debugging, and resolving issues as they arise - to extend the laboratory's operational window and ensure continuous execution of characterization programs. The role also safeguards equipment and devices under test and supports the broader operations that keep the lab running smoothly.. Responsibilities:. . 1 Hands-on operation of measurement equipment (70%). . Bench and Equipment Operation - Hands-on operation of characterization test benches and measurement equipment across up to 10 concurrent setups, including thermo-stream and TEC temperature control systems, device-under-test (DUT) handling, and part swaps into PCB sockets. Automation Flow Management - Managing the automation flow by initiating Python-based characterization runs for new parts, monitoring ongoing measurements, capturing and validating test results, performing first-level troubleshooting - identifying equipment-level issues, resolving automation errors, and executing system restarts as needed. Bench Startup, Shutdown, and Safety - Following proper startup and shutdown procedures at the beginning and end of each shift and adhering to all laboratory safety and handling guidelines throughout. Data logging and shift handoff - Ensuring test results are properly saved and organized, and communicating bench status, incidents, and actions taken to the day-shift engineering team through a shift log or handoff summary. Overnight shifts fail without good handoff, and this is a small responsibility that has outsized impact on daytime engineering productivity. Escalation to on-call engineering - When bench issues exceed the scope of first-level troubleshooting, escalating to the appropriate engineering resource via the agreed communication channel (Teams, email, phone) and documenting the incident. Clarifies for the technician that they're not expected to solve everything alone and gives them explicit permission to escalate - which reduces stalled benches and prevents them from taking on more than their scope.. 2. Calibration support (30%). . · Calibration Preparation and Documentation - Supporting equipment preparation for calibration cycles, including photographic documentation, protective packaging, coordination of logistics paperwork, and basic quality assurance activities. · Laboratory Access Oversight - Serving as the responsible on-site presence during laboratory access by external personnel, such as cleaning staff or maintenance contractors. · Facilities Monitoring - Overseeing supporting facilities such as the machine room and compressor infrastructure, ensuring proper operating conditions are maintained throughout the shift. · Consumables and Inventory Tracking - Monitoring stock of laboratory consumables (ESD bags, cables, adapters, sockets, spare parts) and flagging replenishment needs to the responsible engineering resource. · Shipping and Receiving Support - Supporting incoming and outgoing shipments of equipment, boards, and parts during the shift, including preparation of shipping documentation and coordination with couriers.. Minimum Qualifications:. . Education - Minimum but not limited to a technical degree (TSU), technical high school certification, or equivalent in Electronics, Electromechanics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related discipline. Laboratory or Test Environment Experience - Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in an electronics laboratory, test floor, or manufacturing test environment. Device and Board Handling - Practical experience handling semiconductor devices and populated PCBs, including socket insertion and removal, ESD-safe practices, and careful management of cables, fixtures, and thermal interfaces. Troubleshooting and Judgment - Ability to diagnose and solve routine bench issues independently, combined with judgment for recognizing when an issue must be escalated to engineering. Shift Availability - Availability and willingness to work the assigned afternoon and overnight shift (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM), Monday through Friday, with occasional flexibility during critical programs. Autonomous Work - Proven ability to work independently and with minimal supervision for extended periods, maintaining discipline in following documented procedures and laboratory safety guidelines. Language - Basic to intermediate English, sufficient to read technical documentation and procedures. Computer and Documentation Skills - Basic computer proficiency and the discipline to maintain accurate shift logs, incident records, and equipment documentation. Attention to Detail - Careful, consistent execution of setup and handling procedures, where small errors can invalidate long test runs or damage devices and equipment. Ownership and Reliability - Takes responsibility for the state of the laboratory during the shift and for the continuity of running test campaigns. Clear Communication - Reports status, incidents, and open issues concisely and accurately, in a form the day-shift team can act on immediately. Learning Orientation - Willingness to cross-train on broader characterization activities and to grow technical depth in measurement, automation, and laboratory practices over time.. Desired Qualifications:. . Measurement Equipment Familiarity - Working knowledge of standard bench instrumentation such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, source measure units, signal generators, and spectrum or network analyzers, including correct connection, configuration, and safe handling. Automation Flow Operation - Ability to launch, monitor, and restart Python-based automated test sequences within an existing framework, interpret console output and error messages, and distinguish between equipment, setup, and script failures. Script development is not required for this role.. #LI-Full onsite. .

description: Data Center Market Focus. Location: Bristol, UK (Hybrid - Office: Mon-Thurs, Fridays Flexible). Travel: 35% or less. As AI workloads drive exponential bandwidth growth toward 1.6T infrastructure, interconnect is becoming the major limiting factor in data center scaling, creating an unprecedented market opportunity at the intersection of technical innovation and commercial impact.. This Principal Field Applications Engineer - High-Speed Interconnect represents a pivotal strategic hire, a technical strategist and commercial catalyst positioned to drive $100M+ in design-win revenue and establish market dominance across hyperscaler data centers.. These engagements draw on the same underlying product families and technical skill set, high-speed analog/mixed-signal ICs, signal integrity, and optical/electrical characterisation, making this a natural extension of the core mandate.. Success requires becoming a trusted technical advisor whom Tier 1 hyperscaler customers welcome into their most confidential labs, not as a vendor, but as an extension of their design teams. You'll leverage consultative discovery to uncover the situational factors, business consequences, and decision criteria that drive customer choices.. Your technical credibility will open doors; your strategic approach will close deals. This role is for someone who thrives where breakthrough technology meets strategic business impact, someone ready to shape the future of an industry being transformed by AI.. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES. Drive design wins for Semtech's portfolio of high-speed drivers, TIAs, copper redrivers, and other products, working closely with engineering teams from key data center customers. Accelerate customer design-in cycles, proactively removing technical barriers to secure immediate revenue opportunities. Create joint innovation programs and proof-of-concept projects with Tier 1 hyperscaler providers that establish Semtech as their strategic technology partner. Align Semtech product roadmap with customer technology evolution plans, ensuring our solutions arrive precisely when markets mature. PON & Mobile Transport Account Support. Support design-in activities, technical evaluations, and troubleshooting for these accounts as required. Balance and prioritise time across data center and PON/Mobile Transport engagements in line with regional business needs. Technical Excellence & Customer Support. Lead technical evaluations and drive technical differentiation in competitive situations. Provide comprehensive pre-sales and post-sales customer support for strategic design-ins. Troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues with a relentless commitment to solving problems. Guide customers on hardware design, PCB layout, signal integrity optimization, firmware integration, and system validation. Support customer qualification processes with equipment manufacturers, network operators, and cloud service providers. Create application notes, white papers, and design guides establishing thought leadership. Cross-Functional Strategic Influence. Influence product management and R&D priorities based on customer insights and market intelligence. Serve as strategic technical advisor to VPs in sales and product lines, bridging the gap between customer needs and product strategy. Partner with engineering teams to ensure customer co-development projects receive appropriate resources and priority. Drive internal alignment across product management, engineering, marketing, sales, and operations. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS. Education & Experience. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field (Master's or Ph.D. preferred). 5+ years of proven AE/FAE experience, demonstrating expert-level technical capability and strategic customer engagement, gained in data center, PON, or wireless/mobile transport environments. Technical Mastery. Expertise in signal integrity (high-speed principles, modulation schemes, channel modeling, equalization) for 800G, 1.6T, 3.2T data center, PON, or mobile transport applications. Knowledge of optical transceiver architecture, design, validation, and manufacturing. Familiarity with LPO, LRO, NPO, and CPO architectures (data center focus); familiarity with PON ONU/OLT or mobile transport optical architectures equally valued. Experience in high-speed PCB design including layout, impedance control, and signal integrity validation. Proficiency with high-speed test equipment (network analyzers, BER testers, oscilloscopes). Understanding of IEEE 802.3 and OIF standards, or ITU-T PON standards depending on background. Market & Co-Development Expertise.
