title: Account Executive, UK
description: About the role:. As an Account Executive based in Manila and supporting the UKI market, you will manage a high volume, partner led sales motion for new customer opportunities within organisations of 200-499 employees. This is primarily a reactive role: partners will bring qualified requirements and request quotations, and you will translate those needs into the appropriate AvePoint solution, licensing model, pricing and commercial structure. You will own opportunities from request through quote, commercial follow up and close, while delivering a fast, accurate and consistent partner experience. The role does not have dedicated pre sales support. You will therefore be expected to understand the standard AvePoint portfolio, share approved pre recorded demonstrations and supporting sales assets alongside quotations, and clearly explain the commercial proposition. Opportunities requiring deeper technical discovery or bespoke demonstrations must be identified early and managed through the agreed escalation process.You will work UKI aligned hours from our Manila operation and collaborate closely with UKI channel, sales operations and commercial teams. Key responsibilities:. Respond promptly to partner generated quote requests for UKI new customer opportunities within the 200-499 employee segment. Validate the customer requirement, use case, employee count, licensing scope, term and route to market before preparing a quotation. Align each requirement to the relevant AvePoint solution, packaging, pricing and approved commercial structure. Own the opportunity from initial request through quotation, partner follow up, commercial negotiation, closure and handover. Provide approved pre recorded demonstrations, product collateral and standard value messaging with quotations where relevant. Explain standard product capabilities and commercial options confidently without relying on dedicated pre-sales support. Identify non standard technical, commercial or contractual requirements and escalate them through the agreed process without delaying partner communication. Build trusted, responsive relationships with reseller partners across UKI, making AvePoint easy to transact with. Maintain accurate CRM records, including opportunity stage, value, close date, partner, customer requirement and next action. Manage a high volume of concurrent opportunities against response time, conversion, subscription ARR and forecast accuracy targets. Provide structured feedback on recurring partner needs, objections and process friction to improve enablement and commercial execution. The ideal candidate has:. Experience in indirect SaaS, software, cloud or technology sales, ideally in a account executive role. A track record of progressing and closing partner led opportunities in a fast paced, transactional environment. Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to translate customer needs into suitable licensing, term, pricing and packaging options. Confidence presenting standard product capabilities and value propositions using approved pre recorded demonstrations and sales assets. Sufficient technical curiosity to qualify requirements, recognise complexity and escalate appropriately without dedicated pre sales support. Excellent written and verbal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and credibly with UKI partners and customers. Strong organisation, attention to detail and urgency when managing multiple quote requests and follow up actions. Disciplined CRM and forecasting habits, with accountability for data quality and next-step management. Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, data protection, governance or cloud management is advantageous. Availability to work UKI aligned hours from Manila and collaborate effectively across regional teams. What's in it for me?. HMO coverage from day 1 of employment (+ 2 free dependents on your first day). Paid annual and sick leaves (convertible into cash). Paid compassionate leave (5 days). Employee Dedication Award (Years of service). Employee Referral Bonus Program. Promoting diversity and inclusion. Business Travel Opportunity (Top Performers). Hybrid Working Arrangement. Competitive compensation package, Performance bonuses/incentives. Career growth & advancement opportunities. *Terms and conditions apply. . AvePoint is proud to employ talent from many different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We believe that diversity and inclusion drive our success and is at the core of how we hire, communicate, and collaborate to deliver value and excellence. We are committed to fostering an environment where people can bring their whole selves to work and feel a sense of belonging, and we continue to work toward creating a workforce that represents the diversity of our customers and communities.. #LI-KT1. #LI-Hybrid. title: AI Engineer (Managed Services)
description: We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer specializing in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI. You will architect, build, and deploy production-grade LLM applications - from intelligent knowledge bases and RAG systems to autonomous multi-agent workflows. You will work hands-on with open-source Chinese and international LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, etc), implementing everything from model deployment and inference optimization to prompt engineering and agent orchestration. This is a builder role for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES. LLM Application Development. Design and develop enterprise LLM-powered applications: intelligent Q&A systems, enterprise knowledge base assistants, AI copilots, document analysis tools, and automated customer service agents. Architect and implement end-to-end RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems: document parsing and chunking (recursive, semantic, agentic), embedding generation (BGE, M3E, GTE), vector retrieval (dense + sparse hybrid search), reranking (bge-reranker, Cohere Rerank), and response synthesis with source attribution. Develop and optimize Prompt Engineering strategies: chain-of-thought, tree-of-thought, few-shot prompting, structured output parsing (JSON mode / Pydantic), prompt templates (LangChain/LangSmith), and prompt version management. Knowledge in harness engineering, context management in ensuring LLM interactions and or AI agents reliable and deterministic.. . AI Agent & Multi-Agent Systems. Design and build AI Agent systems using ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflection, and multi-agent collaboration patterns. Implement Function Calling and tool-use capabilities, enabling agents to interact with external APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. Develop multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, and other agent frameworks to solve complex enterprise tasks through agent collaboration. Design MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations for standardized LLM tool interoperability. Open-Source LLM Deployment & Optimization. Deploy and optimize latest version of open-source Chinese LLMs: DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi for on-premise and private cloud environments. Implement model inference optimization: quantization (GGUF/llama.cpp, GPTQ, AWQ, AutoAWQ, FP8/INT8), KV Cache optimization, continuous batching (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, SGLang), speculative decoding, and tensor parallelism for high-throughput serving. Build and maintain model serving infrastructure using vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Text Generation Inference (TGI), Ollama, Xinference, and SGLang; configure GPU resource scheduling with Kubernetes + GPU operators. AI gateway tools for routing, model tracking and load balancing such as TrueFoundry, Kubeflow, LiteLLM or Ray for heavy deep learning. Model Fine-Tuning & Customization. Implement efficient fine-tuning pipelines using LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA, and full-parameter fine-tuning on proprietary domain-specific datasets. Prepare and curate instruction-following datasets, RLHF/RLAIF datasets, and evaluation benchmarks for domain adaptation. Evaluate fine-tuned models using automated benchmarks and LLM-as-a-Judge methodologies. Evaluation & Production Operations. Build and maintain LLM evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-Judge, RAGAS, DeepEval, ARES, and custom task-specific metrics for continuous quality monitoring. Implement production monitoring for LLM systems: output quality tracking, latency/throughput metrics, cost monitoring, drift detection, and guardrail compliance. Design A/B testing frameworks for model comparison and prompt iteration. Implement LLM security guardrails: input/output filtering, PII detection, prompt injection defense, content moderation, and safety alignment. Research & Technical Leadership. Track frontier AI research and evaluate emerging technologies (new model architectures, training techniques, inference methods) for enterprise adoption. Contribute to internal knowledge sharing: tech talks, documentation, and best-practice guides on LLM development. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related technical field. Master's or PhD in AI/ML preferred. 2+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering with demonstrated production deployment of LLM-based systems at scale. Deep understanding of Transformer architecture, attention mechanisms (MHA, GQA, MQA), and LLM pre-training / fine-tuning / inference paradigms. Expert proficiency in LLM application frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent production-grade tools. Hands-on experience with RAG system development: vector databases (Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, pgvector), embedding models (BGE, M3E, GTE, OpenAI, Cohere), reranking (bge-reranker, Cohere Rerank, cross-encoders), and advanced retrieval techniques (hybrid search, query expansion, HyDE). Practical experience deploying and tuning open-source Chinese LLMs: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi , or international models (Llama 3.x, Mistral, Mixtral, Gemma, Phi). Strong experience with model deployment and serving infrastructure: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, Ollama, Xinference, SGLang; GPU resource scheduling (Kubernetes + GPU operators). Proficiency in model quantization and inference optimization: GGUF (llama.cpp), GPTQ, AWQ, AutoAWQ, FP8/INT8; knowledge of KV Cache optimization and memory-efficient attention (FlashAttention, FlashInfer, PageAttention). Solid programming skills in Python; experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX; familiarity with FastAPI/Flask for building LLM API services. Experience with LLM evaluation methodologies, A/B testing frameworks, and production monitoring of AI systems. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS. Experience with agent frameworks: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Assistants API, and multi-agent orchestration patterns. Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), OpenAI API specification, and multi-modal LLM capabilities (vision, audio). Experience with prompt optimization tools: DSPy, PromptLayer, LangSmith for systematic prompt engineering. Knowledge of model distillation and efficient transfer learning from large teacher models to smaller student models. Contributions to open-source AI projects or publications in NLP/LLM research venues. Experience with cloud GPU providers and cost optimization for LLM inference at scale. Access to high-performance GPU computing resources for model development and experimentation. Required Experience. 5-10 years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience. Proven success in hunting, acquiring, and growing enterprise accounts. Strong understanding of cloud technologies, SaaS platforms, cybersecurity, data governance, digital workplace solutions, or enterprise applications. Ability to quickly understand and communicate complex technology solutions and business value. Enterprise Sales Expertise. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Strong prospecting and account planning capabilities. Experience engaging CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Heads of IT, Digital Transformation leaders, and business executives. Communication & Negotiation Skills. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills. Strong negotiation, objection-handling, and stakeholder management abilities. Market Knowledge. Solid understanding of the Malaysian enterprise business landscape. Established network within enterprise, government, GLC, financial services, telecommunications, manufacturing, or other key industries is advantageous. Personal Attributes. Self-motivated, proactive, and highly competitive. Strong business acumen and customer-first mindset. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment. High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability. Why Join AvePoint?. Join a globally recognized software company with a strong market presence. title: Chief Data and Analytics Officer
description: The Company:. AvePoint is the Microsoft Cloud expert. Over 15,000 companies and 5 million cloud users trust AvePoint to accelerate the migration, management, and protection of their Office 365 and SharePoint data. AvePoint's integrated cloud, hybrid, and on-premises software solutions are enhanced by 24/7 support and award-winning services. Organizations across six continents and all industries rely on AvePoint to ease transition to the Microsoft Cloud, increase IT administrator productivity, and satisfy governance and compliance objectives. A three-time Microsoft Partner of the Year, AvePoint has been named to the Inc. 500|5000 six times and the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ five times. AvePoint is a Microsoft Global ISV Partner, a Microsoft Gold Partner in Application Development, Cloud Platform, Cloud Productivity, and Collaboration and Content, and a US Government GSA provider via strategic partnerships. Founded in 2001, AvePoint is privately held and headquartered in Jersey City, NJ. Overview. Reporting to the AvePoint CFO, the Chief Data and Analytics Officer is responsible for defining and executing AvePoint's enterprise data strategy, turning trusted, unified data into a competitive advantage. This leader will modernize the company's data architecture, establish enterprise governance, and build a scalable data foundation that supports product-led growth, customer intelligence, AI initiatives, operational excellence, and executive decision making. The CDO will serve as the enterprise executive responsible for transforming AvePoint's data into a governed, reusable, AI-ready business asset. The role owns enterprise data strategy, governance, data quality, analytics enablement, data products, and product telemetry standards, while establishing the operating model required to deliver trusted, consistent decision-making across the business. As AvePoint continues evolving into a product-led organization, the CDO will unify disparate data sources into a trusted enterprise data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, customer insights, product intelligence, and data-driven innovation. Working across Product, Engineering, GTM, Customer Success, Finance, People, IT, Security, and Compliance, this leader will ensure data functions as a strategic enterprise capability rather than a collection of disconnected systems. The successful candidate combines strategic vision with deep technical expertise in modern data platforms and has a track record of building a culture where decisions are consistently informed by trusted, accessible data. Key Responsibilities. Define and execute AvePoint's enterprise data strategy, aligning data investments with business growth, product-led growth, AI, and customer-centric decision-making. Define and lead AvePoint's enterprise data operating model, establishing clear accountability across centralized data capabilities, embedded domain analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, data owners, data stewards, and executive governance forums. Lead the modernization of AvePoint's data architecture, platforms, and ecosystem to create a scalable, reliable, governed, and accessible enterprise data foundation. Establish enterprise data product management practices, including domain data products, certified semantic models, reusable metrics, documented lineage, business glossaries, data catalogs, quality standards, and lifecycle ownership. Build and operationalize the data capabilities required to measure product adoption, customer health, retention, expansion, monetization, and overall customer value. Partner with Product and Engineering to define product telemetry standards, event schemas, taxonomy, experimentation datasets, usage metrics, and product-commercial data contracts that connect adoption, retention, expansion, customer value, and product roadmap decisions. Partner with ELT to establish enterprise-wide data priorities, governance, quality, privacy, security, stewardship, and KPI standards that enable trusted and consistent business decision-making. Deliver trusted self-service analytics, executive reporting, business intelligence, and data product capabilities that improve data-driven decision-making across the organization. Lead the data foundation for AI, advanced analytics, automation, copilots, and agentic experiences by ensuring governed, traceable, secure, high-quality, and context-rich data is available across the enterprise. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team while fostering strong cross-functional partnerships across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, People, Security, Compliance, and IT. Serve as the executive sponsor for enterprise data initiatives, managing strategic investments, vendor relationships, and communication with executive leadership and the Board. . Qualifications. 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in data, analytics, engineering, or information management. 7+ years leading enterprise data organizations. Proven experience modernizing enterprise data architecture. Experience implementing cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent. Demonstrated success building enterprise data governance programs. Experience partnering closely with Product organizations and using product analytics to drive growth. Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong preference given to candidates who possess:. Product-led growth business model experience. AI/ML data platform experience. Customer analytics and digital product telemetry expertise. Experience leading enterprise transformation initiatives. . Benefits we offer:. Competitive market-based compensation (salary + commission). Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Unlimited PTO. . title: Corporate Account Executive
description: Overview. As a Corporate Account Executive, you will own new-logo ARR growth across private-sector organisations with 2,000-7,499 employees in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. This is a pure acquisition and self-sourcing role with no inherited customer base or ongoing account-management responsibility. While you will have access to BDR, Solution Engineering, Partner Account Management and Marketing support, you remain personally accountable for building sufficient pipeline, creating your own qualified opportunities and achieving the ARR target. Once fully ramped, the role will carry an annual net-new ARR quota in the region of US $900,000. What will you be doing?. You will build, own and execute a territory and pipeline-generation plan that creates sustainable pipeline and converts opportunities into net-new ARR. The territory is not verticalized, so you will use available account intelligence, SKU performance, industry growth and market data to determine where to focus. You will personally self-source qualified opportunities while using internal and partner resources to extend your reach and accelerate results. You will manage the full sales cycle, from account prioritisation and prospecting through discovery, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close. Your responsibilities will include:. Building, owning and executing a data-led territory and pipeline-generation plan that explains how you will achieve your net-new ARR quota, where you will focus, how you will personally create qualified opportunities and which resources you will engage. Generating business exclusively through new-logo acquisition across the defined private-sector segment; the role will not inherit existing customers. Using account, industry, SKU-growth and market data to prioritise opportunities and continually refine your territory strategy. Personally self-sourcing qualified opportunities through disciplined prospecting and account development, while effectively using BDR, Marketing and partner resources to complement-not replace-your own pipeline creation. Building pipeline through a balanced combination of self-sourced activity, BDR support, marketing programmes and partner-led engagement. Working closely with the Partner Account Manager to identify the right partners, develop joint account plans, create pipeline and progress opportunities. As a channel-first organisation, effective partner engagement is fundamental to success in this role. Leading consultative, value-based sales cycles across business, technical and executive stakeholders, positioning a platform outcome rather than relying on a single-product sale. Partnering with Solution Engineering to shape discovery, demonstrate relevant capabilities and build credible business and technical solutions. Planning and delivering compelling presentations, proposals and business cases that connect customer challenges to measurable outcomes, value and return on investment. title: CStack Security Engineer (GovTech)
description: We are seeking a skilled and passionate Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the security, compliance, and resilience of our infrastructure and applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to monitor, respond to, and remediate security incidents across our cloud-native ecosystem. Responsibilities:. Security Monitoring & Incident Response. • Oversee and respond to alerts from AWS GuardDuty, ensuring timely investigation and remediation of incidents. • Execute security playbooks to handle alerts, and enhance them based on evolving threats and operational insights. Vulnerability & Patch Management. • Coordinate the identification and application of security patches across GitLab, AWS, and Kubernetes components. • Ensure that our infrastructure remains resilient to new vulnerabilities through regular patch cycles and proactive risk assessments. Log Analysis & SIEM Management. • Conduct weekly SIEM reviews to analyze security logs, detect anomalies, and escalate issues as necessary. • Collaborate with the SecOps team to refine monitoring strategies and alerting thresholds. Reporting & Documentation. • Prepare monthly SecOps reports summarizing incident trends, response actions, and areas for improvement. • Maintain and update documentation related to security processes, incident response, and playbooks. title: Data Architect  (Managed Services)
description: ROLE OVERVIEW. We are looking for a seasoned Data Architect with deep expertise in enterprise data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipeline development, and business intelligence. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design and implementation of our data architecture - from data ingestion and cleansing to dimensional modeling, warehouse construction, and BI dashboard delivery. You will also establish robust data governance frameworks including data catalogs, lineage tracking, and security audit systems. This role requires strong hands-on capability combined with architectural vision, and prior experience in complex industries such as finance, international trade, or manufacturing is highly valued. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES. Data Acquisition, Cleansing & Integration. Design and implement enterprise-wide data collection strategies across heterogeneous source systems (ETRM, ERP, CRM, external APIs, flat files, and databases). Develop robust data cleansing and standardization pipelines to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across all data sources. Build data integration frameworks to consolidate data from disparate systems into a unified enterprise data warehouse, handling schema evolution and data drift. Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms and incremental data loading strategies to ensure near real-time data freshness. Data Warehouse Architecture & Modeling. Lead the design and construction of the enterprise data warehouse (EDW) using industry-proven methodologies (Inmon, Kimball, or Data Vault). Apply dimensional modeling expertise to design star schemas, snowflake schemas, and constellation models optimized for analytical query performance. architect data marts for specific business domains (finance, sales, supply chain, operations) with clear separation of concerns. Select and implement appropriate data warehouse technologies based on workload characteristics: batch analytics (Hive, Spark SQL), real-time analytics (ClickHouse, Apache Doris, StarRocks), or MPP databases (Greenplum, Vertica). Design layered data architectures (ODS → DWD → DWS → ADS / Bronze → Silver → Gold) with clear data flow and transformation logic at each layer. ETL/ELT Pipeline Development. Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark, Flink, Hive, MapReduce, or proprietary ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, Kettle). Implement workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow, DolphinScheduler, Azkaban, or Oozie to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines. Establish data quality frameworks: automated validation rules, anomaly detection, data profiling, and quality scorecards to ensure pipeline reliability and data trustworthiness. Build comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems for pipeline health, data freshness, and SLA compliance. Optimize pipeline performance through partitioning, bucketing, indexing, and query tuning strategies. Business Intelligence & Reporting. Develop enterprise BI reporting systems and interactive dashboards using tools such as Apache Superset, FineBI, Tableau, Power BI, or Quick BI. Design executive dashboards, operational reports, and self-service analytics interfaces tailored to business stakeholders across finance, trading, operations, and management. Implement metrics frameworks (KPIs, OKRs) and ensure data definitions are standardized, documented, and consistently applied across all reports. Work directly with business units to understand analytical requirements and translate them into effective data models and visualizations. Data Governance & Standards. Design and implement enterprise data governance frameworks from the ground up, including data ownership policies, stewardship roles, and governance workflows. Build a centralized data catalog (using Apache Atlas, DataHub, Amundsen, or similar) documenting all data assets, business glossaries, and metadata. Implement data lineage analysis systems to track data flow from source to consumption, enabling impact analysis and root cause diagnosis. Establish data security and audit frameworks: access control (RBAC/ABAC), data masking, encryption policies, sensitive data discovery, and compliance audit trails. Define and enforce data standards: naming conventions, data dictionaries, master data management (MDM) rules, and data quality SLAs. Ensure regulatory compliance with data protection laws (GDPR, PIPL, industry-specific regulations) through governance controls and documentation. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or related technical field. 3+ years of professional experience in data development, data engineering, or data architecture roles, with a proven track record of building production data warehouse systems. Expert-level proficiency in SQL (complex queries, window functions, CTEs, query optimization) and Python for data processing and pipeline development. Mastery of data warehouse modeling theories and methodologies: dimensional modeling (Kimball), normalized modeling (Inmon), and Data Vault 2.0. Demonstrated experience designing star schemas, snowflake schemas, and aggregate tables for complex business domains. Deep domain experience in at least one complex industry: financial services (banking, securities, insurance), international trade (import/export, supply chain, logistics), or manufacturing (production planning, quality control, industrial IoT). Understanding of industry-specific data entities, business processes, and analytical requirements. Strong hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools and frameworks: Apache Spark (batch and streaming), Apache Flink, Hive, MapReduce, Sqoop, DataX, SeaTunnel, or commercial ETL platforms (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, IBM DataStage). Proficiency in workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow, DolphinScheduler, Azkaban, Oozie, or equivalent scheduling and monitoring platforms. Production experience with at least one major data warehouse/analytics database: ClickHouse, Apache Doris, StarRocks, Hive, Greenplum, Vertica, Teradata, or Snowflake. Strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools: Apache Superset, FineBI, Tableau, Power BI, Quick BI, or similar enterprise BI platforms. Deep expertise in Data Governance with demonstrated ability to build governance systems from scratch: data catalog implementation, metadata management, automated lineage tracking (using OpenLineage, Marquez, or similar), data quality monitoring, and security audit frameworks. Solid understanding of relational and analytical databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Greenplum - including performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimization. Experience with big data ecosystem components: HDFS, YARN, ZooKeeper, Kafka, and Hadoop distributions (CDH, HDP, Apache). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS. Experience with master data management (MDM) platforms and methodologies. Familiarity with data mesh or data fabric architectural patterns for large-scale decentralized data environments. Experience with data versioning and time-travel capabilities in modern data warehouses. Domain knowledge on Energy Trading, Market Risk Management. Professional certifications: CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), DAMA-DMBOK, or vendor-specific data platform certifications.. title: Director, Business Intelligence
description: Overview. AvePoint is seeking a Director, Business Intelligence to lead the global production BI operating model and turn governed enterprise data products into trusted, scalable reporting experiences. This role is accountable for how certified semantic models, Power BI solutions, controlled reporting, and production support are industrialized across the business - with clear standards for quality, release management, lifecycle ownership, and service delivery. The Director, Business Intelligence will partner closely with Analytics and Data Engineering, which own business partnership, enterprise metric governance, Gold data products, advanced insights, and the underlying data platform. BI will consume those governed foundations and make them production-ready for leaders and teams across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, People, and Operations. The ideal leader combines strong technical BI judgment with disciplined people management, global delivery leadership, and the ability to build a high-leverage operating model that scales through standards, reusable models, domain alignment, and AI-ready consumption. Key Responsibilities:. Own the global BI strategy, operating model, service catalog, roadmap, and delivery standards for production reporting and semantic model deployment. Lead BI intake, prioritization, assignment, capacity planning, and delivery coordination; group demand into business themes and provide transparent status, dependencies, and business value to Analytics and executive stakeholders. Establish clear handoff criteria from Analytics prototypes and governed data products into BI production, including certification, QA, documentation, regression testing, release management, support, and retirement. Own production Power BI and semantic model engineering standards, including model performance, Direct Lake patterns, security, RLS, refresh reliability, QA, release controls, monitoring, SOX/controlled reporting requirements, and production support. Partner with Analytics to consume approved enterprise metrics and Gold data products without recreating or redefining business logic inside reports; escalate gaps in definitions, lineage, source quality, or data contracts. Build a domain-aligned BI delivery model across priority AvePoint 360 domains, with dedicated or clearly aligned BI engineering capacity for Customer/Sales/Partner, Commercial Growth, Product, and People data products as demand matures. Design and lead a global resourcing model that effectively uses existing teams and locations, including shared delivery partnerships, follow-the-sun support, and selective hiring where additional capacity or business proximity is required. Develop BI engineers and emerging leaders through coaching, technical standards, clear ownership, and rotational domain assignments that broaden business context while reducing key-person dependency. Drive report and semantic model rationalization by maintaining production inventory, eliminating duplicate logic, retiring legacy assets after validated migration, improving reuse, and tracking operating measures such as ownership clarity, incidents, cycle time, adoption, and recovered Analytics capacity. Partner with Analytics on AI and self-service readiness by ensuring production semantic models, metadata, security, documentation, and reporting outputs are trustworthy and reusable by both people and Data Agents. . Qualifications:. Significant experience leading Business Intelligence, enterprise reporting, semantic modeling, analytics engineering, or a closely related function in a complex organization. Proven people leadership experience managing and developing technical BI teams; experience leading across regions, time zones, or distributed delivery models strongly preferred. Deep expertise with Microsoft Power BI and modern semantic model architecture; experience with Microsoft Fabric, Direct Lake, OneLake, deployment pipelines, AI-enabled analytics, or comparable cloud data platforms strongly preferred. Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, DAX, SQL, performance optimization, RLS/security, report architecture, governed self-service, and production support practices. Experience establishing BI engineering standards, QA and regression testing, CI/CD or release management, monitoring, documentation, and report lifecycle governance. Ability to distinguish enterprise metric governance and data-product ownership from BI production responsibilities, and to partner effectively with Analytics and Data Engineering without duplicating accountability. Demonstrated success managing intake, prioritization, workload balancing, stakeholder expectations, and a portfolio of production BI assets based on business value and capacity. Experience rationalizing legacy reports or semantic models and migrating users toward governed, reusable enterprise data products while maintaining business continuity. Experience with controlled or audit-sensitive reporting, including SOX-related processes, data quality controls, ownership documentation, or similar governance requirements preferred. Strong communication, technical judgment, and change-management skills, with the ability to review architecture, coach engineers, explain tradeoffs, lead through influence, and build durable partnerships across Analytics, Engineering, Finance, RevOps, Product, and other business functions. . Benefits we offer:. Competitive market-based compensation. Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Unlimited PTO. title: Director of Revenue Operations, GTM Performance
description: The Director of Revenue Operations, GTM Performance is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for architecting how our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization measures success and rewards performance. This role owns two critical pillars: the design and administration of AvePoint's global incentive compensation strategy, and the governance of all GTM performance data standards. You will act as the crucial bridge between GTM Leadership, Finance, and Analytics/Data Engineering-ensuring that our compensation plans drive the right seller behaviors and that our analytics teams have a flawless, standardized blueprint (the "Data Dictionary") to build their reporting infrastructure. Key Responsibilities. Global Incentive Compensation Management: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and administration of global sales compensation plans, quotas, and SPIFFs. Ensure plans are financially responsible, aligned with corporate revenue targets, and designed to drive specific strategic behaviors. GTM Data Standardization & Governance: Own the GTM "Data Dictionary." Define the strict business logic and standardized formulas for all critical performance metrics (e.g., Pipeline Coverage, Win Rates, CAC, NRR, Ramp Time). Analytics Blueprinting: Serve as the primary business stakeholder for Analytics/Data Engineering. Provide clear, documented metric definitions and requirements so they can build and operate the backend data pipelines and executive dashboards (e.g., in Power BI and consumed by AI agents). Sales Performance Technology Ownership: Oversee the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of our Sales Performance Management and commission tracking software in partnership with the RevOps GTM Systems team. Performance & Payout Analytics: Lead quarterly reviews of compensation effectiveness. Analyze quota attainment distributions, payout ratios, and plan ROI, providing actionable insights and recommendations to the CRO and CFO. Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner with HR, Finance, and Legal to ensure compliance, dispute resolution, and seamless communication of compensation plans to the global sales force. Key Skills. Compensation Design & Financial Modeling: Advanced ability to model complex compensation scenarios, forecast commission expenses, and perform stress tests on quota capacity and territory designs. Data Governance & Architecture: Deep understanding of data structures, taxonomy, and governance. The ability to translate complex sales motions into clean, logical data definitions that technical teams can easily interpret. Systems & Sales Performance Expertise: Strong technical fluency with specialized incentive compensation platforms and a solid understanding of how CRM data (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics 365) flows into performance metrics. Executive Communication & Influence: Exceptional ability to navigate difficult conversations around compensation, manage change, and align competing priorities between Sales Leadership and Finance. Analytical Storytelling: The ability to look at attainment data and identify macro trends, diagnosing whether a miss is a pipeline issue, a coaching issue, or a compensation design issue. Qualifications. Experience: 8-10+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation, Sales Operations, or GTM Strategy within a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise environment. Leadership: 3-5+ years of direct people management experience, with a track record of building cross-functional teams and managing complex, global projects. Compensation Track Record: Proven experience designing, rolling out, and managing multi-tiered incentive plans across different GTM motions (e.g., Account Executives, SDRs, Customer Success, and Channel Partners). Data Partnership: Demonstrable experience working directly with Data Engineering, BI, or IT teams to establish single-source-of-truth reporting and data governance frameworks. Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with modern SPM/ICM tools (e.g., Everstage, Spiff, CaptivateIQ, Xactly), CRM systems, and a strong foundational understanding of BI visualization tools. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). The Salary Range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
description: . About AvePoint. AvePoint is the global leader in data protection, unifying data security, governance, and resilience to provide a trusted foundation for AI. More than 28,000 customers rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to secure, govern, and rapidly recover data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other cloud environments. With a single platform for lifecycle control, multicloud governance, and rapid recovery paired with clear ownership across the business, we prevent overexposure and sprawl, modernize legacy and fragmented data, and minimize data loss and interruption. Our global partner ecosystem includes approximately 6,000 MSPs, VARs, and SIs, and our solutions are available in over 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit www.avepoint.com .. About the Role. Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it - and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner. You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end. This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.. What you'll do. Advise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape - agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence. Scope and shape AI build projects. Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes - architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign. Build and deliver. Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go. Own the relationship through delivery. Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client. What we're looking for. title: Head of Brand
description: Position overview. The Head of Brand is an executive leader accountable for defining, governing, and evolving AvePoint's brand to drive differentiation, trust, and preference as the company scales toward $1B ARR. You will own brand positioning, narrative, and visual identity; serve as the final decision-maker for all brand expressions; build and lead a high-performing brand organization; own the brand budget and agency ecosystem; and advise the executive leadership team (ELT) on brand strategy, tradeoffs, and long-term equity. This is a role for a leader who can transform brand from a support function into a measurable engine of commercial growth. Core Functions. Brand Strategy & Identity Leadership: Own and set AvePoint's enterprise brand positioning, story, and visual identity system. Brand Governance & Decision Rights: Serve as the final decision-maker and guardian for all major brand expressions, campaigns, and guidelines. Brand Campaign Strategy & Activation: Translate strategy into high-ambition brand platforms, moments, and experiential activations. Brand Reputation & Advocacy Programs: Drive awareness, sentiment, preference, and customer advocacy programs (e.g., third-party review leadership). Brand Measurement & Business Impact: Own brand health tracking and the progressive KPI framework, connecting brand to commercial outcomes. . Organization & Budget Leadership: Build, scale, and lead the brand organization and manage the brand budget and agency ecosystem. Key Responsibilities. Brand Strategy & Identity. Set, define, and continually refine AvePoint's brand positioning, narrative framework (messaging pillars, tagline, value propositions), and visual identity so it resonates with enterprise and mid-market audiences. Act as chief brand architect, ensuring the brand conveys AvePoint's unique value (unified data security, resilience, and AI governance) in an authentic, differentiated way. Own brand architecture across the master brand, product suites, sub-brands (e.g., Elements, Torsion), and campaign brands. Governance & Decision Rights. Serve as the final decision-maker and guardian for all brand expressions, with authority to approve, veto, or revise major brand assets and campaigns - from global campaign themes to product naming. Own and enforce brand guidelines, partnering with design and content leads to guide corrections, and set brand guardrails, decision rights, and approval workflows that balance speed with consistency. Campaign & Activation. Lead flagship, high-ambition brand platforms (e.g., the "mission control for data protection" platform) and experiential activations at key industry events that create category conversation. Identify and own signature "brand moments" annually - major research studies, cultural partnerships, and sponsorships - to amplify the company's profile. Content & Creative Oversight. Guide the creation of brand-level content - thought leadership, annual reports, vision videos - ensuring a consistent voice that engages CXO audiences while aligning to business goals. Partner closely with content marketing leads and creative directors to produce standout, differentiated brand storytelling. Organization, Budget & Agencies. Build, scale, and lead a high-performing brand organization (managers, strategists, and operations), inspiring and developing the team. Own the brand budget and direct the agency/partner ecosystem (creative, digital, media, sponsorships), including agency reviews and scope negotiations. Reputation, Advocacy & Measurement. Monitor and influence brand health metrics (awareness, sentiment, preference) and drive customer advocacy initiatives, including leadership in third-party reviews. Own the progressive KPI framework - evolving from awareness and share of voice (SOV) to preference, consideration, and commercial impact - and be accountable for brand's contribution to preference, pipeline, and revenue. Advise and align the ELT and CRO/CMO on brand direction, tradeoffs, and long-term equity, communicating ROI credibly to the board and executive leadership. Qualifications & Experience. Required. 12-15+ years of experience in brand and/or marketing leadership, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. Proven experience building, scaling, and leading a brand function and inspiring high-performing teams. Track record of creating and executing successful integrated, multi-channel brand campaigns that moved awareness, preference, and business results. Executive-level narrative and influence: demonstrated ability to advise, challenge, and align executives around brand direction, tradeoffs, and long-term equity building. Strong commercial and financial acumen - connecting brand health to business outcomes and communicating ROI credibly to leadership and the board. Experience directing multiple agency relationships and managing significant budgets effectively. Deep expertise in brand strategy, category positioning, narrative frameworks, and brand governance in a competitive market. Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field required. Preferred. MBA or advanced degree. Experience in data security, resilience, governance, or AI-adjacent categories. Prior experience taking a brand through a repositioning or rebrand at a high-growth or publicly traded company. Key Skills & Capabilities. Brand strategy and category leadership: define, evolve, and defend a differentiated brand and category narrative. Executive-level narrative and influence across the ELT and board. Cross-functional governance and decision-making - strong judgment in setting brand guardrails and approvals. Campaign and brand activation leadership - translating strategy into high-impact brand moments and platforms. Brand measurement and business acumen - connecting brand health to commercial outcomes. Organizational leadership - building, scaling, and developing teams and agency ecosystems. Key Stakeholders. Executive Leadership Team (CEO, CRO/CMO) • Content & Editorial leadership • Communications & PR leadership • Growth & Demand Generation leadership • Product Marketing • Creative & Design • Agency & partner ecosystem. Why This Role Exists. Creates single, accountable executive ownership of the brand. Drives differentiation in a crowded category. Establishes brand as a growth lever - not a support function. Enables scale without dilution through governance and decision rights. Builds a measurable path from brand → preference → pipeline → revenue. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $265,000 - $329,000. In addition, this role is eligible for a performance bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions-apply even if your expectations fall outside the range. Scripting & API: Use PowerShell , Bash , and Python to automate repetitive tasks and interact with the Microsoft Graph API for custom reporting. End-User Enablement: Create comprehensive documentation, self-service guides, and conduct training sessions for end-users to drive the effective adoption of collaboration tools. Manage day-to-day delivery and support of application infrastructure services and collaborate with other government agencies and central services teams to facilitate and deliver government-wide services. Leadership & Strategic Alignment. End-to-End Delivery: Lead the deployment and service design for large-scale rollouts of new collaboration features and productivity software. Policy Development: Develop organization policies, governance standards, and standard operating procedures for M365 tools, collaborating with security teams to meet regulatory needs. Project Ownership: Take full ownership of broad, ambiguously-scoped rollouts, ensuring successful outcomes, proactive risk mitigation, and seamless change management for end-users. Mentorship & Improvement: Mentor junior team members, synthesize usage data into clear recommendations for leadership, and constructively challenge existing processes to drive continuous improvement. Team player with strong organization and people handling skills. Agility, passion and teamwork set us up to do our best work and foster a culture where you are empowered to craft your career, make an impact, and own (y)our future. Unleash the power of you!. About the position. We are looking for a hands-on cloud infrastructure practitioner who can lead product. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for AvePoint's IaaS and PaaS data protection portfolio across Azure, AWS, and GCP: compute and virtual machines, managed and self-managed databases, object and file storage, Kubernetes, and infrastructure configuration. This is a highly technical product leadership role connecting cloud architecture, backup and disaster recovery, cyber resilience, and SaaS business outcomes. Cloud Infrastructure is one of AvePoint's highest-priority investment areas. You will work closely with principal architects and engineers, customers, partners, and field teams to turn real operational challenges into differentiated capabilities and business growth-not simply manage a backlog. What makes this role different. Your first-hand infrastructure experience should enable you to challenge designs, identify recovery gaps, and reason through reliability, security, performance, and cost. Daily production coding is not required, but meaningful participation in architectural decisions is. Bring depth in one hyperscaler and transferable knowledge of the others; equal expertise across all three is not expected. Traditional data-center or enterprise-backup experience is valuable, but does not substitute for recent production-cloud and SaaS experience. What you will do. Lead technical product decisions. Work directly with Architecture and Engineering on cloud APIs, snapshots and incremental change mechanisms, crash versus application consistency, IAM and service identities, private networking, encryption, and customer-managed keys. Review designs for missing requirements, operational risks, and recovery gaps. Own strategy and workload expansion. Set the roadmap and coverage sequence across Azure, AWS, and GCP. Balance depth versus breadth and define complete protection for each service: backup, restore granularity, regional and account recovery, security, performance, and cost. Shape the SaaS architecture. Partner on control-plane and data-plane responsibilities, AvePoint-hosted versus customer-hosted components, data movement and storage placement, tiering, deduplication and compression, and the economics of scaling a reliable protection service. Drive cyber resilience. Define product direction for immutability and WORM, logically isolated copies, ransomware and anomaly detection, recovery validation, and clean or isolated recovery environments. Make provable recoverability part of what the product delivers. What you will do (continued). Own competitive direction. Evaluate third-party protection products and hyperscaler -native capabilities. Turn evidence about customer needs, competitive gaps, and native-platform limitations into clear investment and positioning decisions. Connect discovery to delivery. Work with cloud architects, platform and security teams, partners, MSPs, and internal field teams. Translate the problems behind their requests into requirements, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized backlog informed by telemetry, support data, and technical risk. Measure technical and business outcomes. Track workload coverage, backup reliability, recovery success and time, storage efficiency, cost per protected TB, adoption, ARR growth, and competitive win/loss outcomes. Use these measures to guide investment and improve customer and product economics. Lead with technical credibility. Support strategic deals, proofs of concept, and customer architecture discussions. Lead without authority across functions and communicate priorities, risks, and technical and business trade-offs clearly to engineers, executives, customers, and partners. Bring capabilities to market. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on launches, positioning, packaging, pricing guidance, technical enablement, marketplaces, co-sell, and MSP programs. title: Maintenance Project Manager
description: Overview. As a Customer Service Manager, you will be responsible for managing post-implementation support and maintenance activities for IT systems and applications. You will work closely with support teams, cross-functional teams, external vendors, and customers to ensure the smooth operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of systems after go-live. The role requires strong coordination, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills to deliver quality service and customer satisfaction. What You Will Be Doing. Coordinate and manage Change Requests (CRs), including scope confirmation, effort estimation, prioritization, and implementation planning. Track maintenance activities, project timelines, and deliverables to ensure timely completion of support and enhancement initiatives. Maintain and update project and support documentation, including CR plans, Customer Issued (CI) / System Defect hotfix arrangement, incident reports, status reports, and meeting minutes. Liaise with internal teams, external vendors, and customers to facilitate effective communication and issue resolution. Organize and facilitate maintenance-related meetings, including weekly operational meetings, monthly service review meetings, and ad-hoc discussions. Monitor service performance and follow up on incidents, defects, and enhancement requests to ensure timely resolution and customer satisfaction. Identify potential risks and issues proactively and coordinate mitigation actions with relevant stakeholders. Prepare service reports and provide regular updates on maintenance activities, project progress, and key issues. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and operational efficiency. Perform other ad-hoc duties and responsibilities as assigned. What You Need to Succeed. Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related discipline. 1-3 years of experience in IT project coordination, service delivery, application maintenance, or customer service management. Experience supporting application and projects will be an advantage. Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management skills and a customer-centric mindset. Proficiency in collaboration and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Trello, or similar platforms. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams. Basic understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), system implementation, and application support processes is preferred.. title: Marketing Manager, Account-Based Experience — ANZ
description: . About the Role. We are seeking a Manager, Account-Based Experience - ANZ to serve as the primary marketing partner to the ANZ Sales organization. This role will work closely with Sales leadership and account teams to understand regional priorities, identify where marketing can have the greatest impact, and develop programs that strengthen account engagement, accelerate pipeline, and support revenue growth. This person will lead the regional Account-Based Experience strategy and serve as the bridge between Sales and the broader Marketing organization. They will communicate marketing plans to Sales, bring regional and account-level priorities back to Marketing, and coordinate support across demand generation, events, digital, partner marketing, customer marketing, content, and other teams. The ideal candidate is a commercially minded, data-driven marketer who builds credibility with Sales, translates business needs into meaningful marketing programs, and is comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution. Key Responsibilities. Sales Partnership: Serve as the primary marketing partner to ANZ Sales leadership and account teams, building a strong understanding of regional goals, territory priorities, account plans, and pipeline needs. Sales and Marketing Alignment: Act as the bridge between ANZ Sales and the broader Marketing organization by communicating plans, gathering regional feedback, and coordinating support across teams. Regional ABX Strategy: Develop and execute the ANZ ABX strategy across priority accounts, active opportunities, and strategic customer relationships. Account Planning: Participate in account planning, pipeline reviews, QBRs, and regional sales meetings to identify where marketing can best support engagement and growth. Regional Programs and Account Experiences: Lead regional programs, including trade shows, conferences, executive experiences, and tailored account activations, while maintaining a clear focus on engaging priority accounts and supporting pipeline goals. Demand Generation Partnership: Partner with the global Demand Generation team to connect campaigns with ANZ sales priorities, target accounts, and pipeline needs, while ensuring Sales understands available programs and how to engage. Account Insights and Personalization: Use intent data, account engagement, market intelligence, and seller feedback to identify opportunities and inform program strategy, messaging, and personalization. Cross-Functional Coordination: Work across Demand Generation, Digital, Events, Content, Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and RevOps to deliver coordinated support for direct and partner-led growth, including identifying opportunities for customer stories, video content, webinars, and other regional programs. Performance Measurement: Measure account engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, opportunity progression, and program ROI using platforms such as Power BI, 6sense, Marketo, and Dynamics. Translate results into clear recommendations and next steps. Team Leadership: Manage and mentor at least one direct report, providing clear direction, supporting professional development, and ensuring high-quality execution. What You Will Bring to the Team. We look for colleagues who value agility, passion, and teamwork-people who bring fresh ideas, take ownership, and want the opportunity to learn, grow, and make a measurable contribution. 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally within enterprise technology or SaaS. Proven experience partnering with Sales leadership and account teams to support regional and account-level revenue priorities. Experience developing and executing ABM or ABX programs, including account selection, personalization, multi-channel activation, and engagement measurement. Demonstrated ability to create integrated marketing programs that contribute to account engagement, pipeline creation, and opportunity acceleration. Strong understanding of the ANZ enterprise technology market, regional buyer behavior, and partner ecosystem. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to translate sales priorities into clear marketing strategies and programs. Experience using ABM, marketing automation, analytics, and CRM platforms such as 6sense, Marketo, Power BI, and Dynamics. Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and clearly present recommendations and results. Experience working cross-functionally within a global, matrixed marketing organization. Previous experience managing and developing at least one direct report. Benefits We Offer. Competitive market-based compensation. Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Work-life balance through a hybrid working model of three days per week in the office. Generous PTO allowance, including specific AvePoint holidays such as Birthday Day, Family Day, Holiday Half Day, and Community Outreach Half Day. Private health insurance. Mobile phone plan reimbursement. Tuition reimbursement. Dedication Awards. Employee Referral Program. Novated leasing. And much more!. title: OneStream Lead
description: Overview:. AvePoint is excited to provide the opportunity for an experienced OneStream Lead who is passionate about supporting and enhancing a state-of-the-art finance operating system at a fast-growing software company. . This role is ideal for an experienced OneStream administrator who can effectively support and maintain a production OneStream environment while partnering closely with Finance, Analytics, and external implementation resources. The ideal candidate has prior experience administering OneStream in a live business environment and brings a strong understanding of financial planning processes, system administration, and troubleshooting. This individual will help support enhancements, resolve issues, and contribute to the continued evolution of the platform. . What your day-to-day will look like:. Administer and maintain the OneStream platform, including user access, security roles, and system configurations. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring data accuracy, consolidation integrity, and timely reporting. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and implementation partners to support ongoing enhancements and optimization of the OneStream platform. Manage and support data integrations, including data loads, between OneStream and source systems such as NetSuite, Power BI Cube, Dynamics CRM, MyHR, Greenhouse, and Concur. Troubleshoot and resolve application and data-related issues. Develop and maintain business rules, dashboards, reports, and Cube Views to support operational and financial reporting needs. Partner with Finance, Human Resources, and Analytics teams to gather business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. Support system upgrades, patches, enhancements, and release activities, including testing and validation. Ensure data integrity through routine validation, reconciliation, and quality checks. Create and maintain system documentation, including configurations, process flows, and user guides. What you will bring to our team:. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. 3+ years of hands-on OneStream administration experience supporting a production environment. Strong understanding of core OneStream functionality, including workflows, metadata management, security, data integrations, reporting, Cube Views, dashboards, and Data Management processes. Understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, people cost planning, and reporting processes. Experience supporting data loads, integrations, and troubleshooting data or application issues within a production environment. Experience with business rules and system configurations, including troubleshooting and maintaining existing functionality. Ability to analyze business requirements and contribute to system enhancements and process improvements. Experience supporting testing, upgrades, releases, and implementation activities. Ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external implementation partners to achieve business objectives. Experience with NetSuite or other financial systems is strongly preferred. Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and communication skills. Consultative, solution-oriented mindset with curiosity and a passion for continuous process improvement. Strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Benefits we offer:. Competitive market-based compensation, including salary and yearly bonus. Work-life balance through remote working model. Unlimited PTO. The Salary Range for this role is $100,000 - $130,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions-apply even if your expectations fall outside the range. Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice. . .

title: OpenStack Engineer
description: Key Responsibilities:. • Design and implement OpenStack-based cloud solutions tailored to client requirements. • Install, configure, and maintain OpenStack components (e.g., Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Swift). • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to OpenStack deployments. • Optimise OpenStack performance, scalability, and reliability. • Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with industry standards. • Automate OpenStack deployment and management processes. • Collaborate with networking and storage teams to integrate OpenStack with existing infrastructure. • Provide technical guidance and support to clients and internal teams. • Stay current with OpenStack developments and contribute to the open-source community. • Participate in on-call rotations for critical support. Qualifications:. • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. • 2+ years of experience working with OpenStack in production environments. • Experience with OpenStack deployment tools (e.g., Ansible). • Proficiency in Linux system administration. • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash). • Strong understanding of networking concepts (VLANs, SDN, load balancing). • Familiarity with containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). • Knowledge of storage systems and protocols (e.g., Ceph, iSCSI, NFS). • Preferred Skills:. o OpenStack certification (e.g., COA - Certified OpenStack Administrator). o Experience with other cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP). o Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. o Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana). o Experience with database administration (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL). description: As an Operations Support Analyst, you will:. Provide technical support to end users on various technical issues and problems relating to hardware and software. Responds, documents, resolves or escalates incidents, change request or service tickets in a timely manner in accordance to Service Level Agreements. Uphold the service level requirements and strives for continuous service improvement by providing quality technical support to end users. Able to identify interdependencies when analysing problems and developing creative solutions with supervision. Displays a sound judgement when making decisions and demonstrates initiative when situation calls for action. EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS NEEDED. Diploma from a recognized polytechnic (preferable IT related). Prior experience in technical support and usage of ticketing systems. Excellent interpersonal and communication (verbal and written) skills with demonstrated customer service mind-set and ability to engage multiple stakeholders. Basic salesforce administration experience. A team player. Resourceful, adaptable and able to work with minimal supervision. Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to focus on priorities and deliver in a fast-paced environment. Internet-savvy and proficient in using MS Office, especially Outlook, Word, Power Point and Excel. title: Operator

title: OutSystems Developer
description: Beyond Secure. AvePoint is the global leader in data security, governance, and resilience, going beyond traditional solutions to ensure a robust data foundation and enable organizations everywhere to collaborate with confidence. Over 25,000 customers worldwide rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to prepare, secure, and optimize their critical data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, OutSystems and other collaboration environments. AvePoint's global channel partner program includes approximately 5,000 managed service providers, value-added resellers, and systems integrators, with our solutions available in more than 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit www.avepoint.com . Overview. We are seeking a passionate OutSystems Developer to join our team and drive digital transformation for enterprise and government clients. In this role, you will design and deliver innovative low-code applications on the OutSystems platform, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and analysts to translate requirements into effective solutions, integrate with external systems, and continuously enhance the platform to maximize business value. If you are eager to innovate with low-code, solve complex challenges, and make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Experience & Skills Required. Key Responsibilities:. Collaborate with business stakeholders and analysts to understand requirements and deliver effective technical solutions. Design, develop, and maintain applications using the OutSystems platform. Utilize .NET, SQL, and JavaScript to create robust and scalable solutions. Build integrations with external systems using REST APIs, SOAP services, and other middleware. Monitor platform performance and proactively identify areas for improvement. Support end-users by providing training, documentation, and troubleshooting while serving as the primary representative for project-specific customer technical inquiries. Take ownership of issues through resolution, ensuring adherence to SLAs for response and resolution times, and perform thorough troubleshooting and root cause analysis of technical problems. Ensure application performance, scalability, and security by following OutSystems best practices and clients' policies. Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies. Prepare statistical reports and present them effectively during weekly and monthly progress meetings with clients. Stay updated with the latest OutSystems features, low-code trends, and emerging technologies. Requirements:. Minimum Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering. 3+ years of experience in software development with OutSystems, including OutSystems 11 and ODC. Proficiency in OutSystems Service Studio, Integration Studio, and Lifetime, ODC Studio and ODC Portal. Certification as an OutSystems Associate Developer or Traditional Web Developer certification is a plus. Strong understanding of software development principles, methodologies, and practices. Strong knowledge of web technologies, such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design, and RESTful APIs. Familiarity with relational databases, SQL, and database design principles. Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex business requirements and design scalable solutions. A highly energetic and motivated team player with strong communication skills, comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactively customer-focused, and confident in engaging directly with clients and vendors, able to perform effectively under tight timelines and pressure while contributing to the digital transformation journey. Experience supporting end-user training, adoption, and platform governance. Understanding of OutSystems application security, user roles, and permission models. Proficient in communicating with clients in English, both verbally and in writing. Education: Bachelor's degree or above. Certifications:. Will be a Plus with certification: OutSystems Associate Developer or Associate Traditional Web Developer. Preferred: Tech Lead, Architecture Specialist, or any specialist-level certifications. Preferred Qualifications:. Experience in public sector or compliance-driven environments. Experienced in working on projects using the Agile methodology and leveraging CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of .NET programming language. Experience with database management systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL. Previous experience in a leadership or senior developer role, leading the design and development of complex software projects. Experience in system integration and migration. Experience with workflow automation and integration hubs; knowledge of RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) is an advantage. If you are looking for an opportunity to grow your career while working on meaningful projects, we would love to hear from you!. title: Partner Account Manager
description: Partner Account Manager. . Barcelona, Spain. Overview. The Partner Account Manager is responsible for developing and scaling AvePoint's partner ecosystem across Spain, driving structured partner engagement and executing go-to-market strategies in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. You will focus on building strong, long-term partnerships that generate pipeline, accelerate deal cycles, and expand AvePoint's presence in the Spanish market. . What your day-to-day will look like. Identify and develop high-impact partner relationships across Spain, prioritising those with strong Microsoft alignment. Drive partner-led pipeline generation and sourced revenue growth. Enable and support co-selling activities between partners and AvePoint's sales organisation. Manage and track partner pipeline, ensuring visibility and accountability across deals. Build trusted relationships with partner stakeholders, acting as a key day-to-day contact. Deliver ongoing partner enablement to improve commercial and technical positioning of AvePoint solutions. Leverage Microsoft and broader ecosystem relationships to accelerate joint business opportunities. Support partners in expanding their offerings to include AvePoint-related services and solutions. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure strong execution and partner success. . What you will bring. We are looking for individuals who combine commercial drive with strong relationship management skills , and who can navigate a partner-led market environment. 5+ years of experience in partner/channel management or enterprise sales. Proven ability to generate pipeline and achieve or exceed business targets. Experience working with Microsoft partners, system integrators, or resellers. Proactive and self-driven. Collaborative across teams and functions. High accountability and execution focus. . #LI-SW1. #LI-REMOTE.
