title: Partner Account Manager
description: About the position:. As the Partner Account Manager, you will be responsible driving partner enablement programs along with the development of partner business development plans. He/she will continue to support and nurture existing partnerships including working active opportunities with them, managing the pipeline and leveraging the partner's customer base for AvePoint's products, solutions and services. This role will be measured primarily on the amount of sourced pipeline and sourced bookings from the partner eco-system along with achieving the overall booking goals of the regional business unit. The targeted types of partners in the desired eco-system include: system integrators and managed service providers who are either solely dedicated to the Microsoft technology stack or have a significant portion of their business that is driven by it, and will provide either complementary services and contracting vehicles to accelerate the deal cycles. We operate in a co-sell environment currently with these partners. In addition, the Microsoft partnership is the most significant partnership that needs to be developed and focused on as it can drive the highest growth trajectory for AvePoint. In addition we do want to broaden our partnership relationships where they can deliver deployment services around our products outside the basic migration offerings and increase the technical enablement of their consultants. Key responsibilities:. Identifying and prioritizing the relationships with Partners that will ultimately drive increased sourced pipeline and bookings for AvePoint. Ensuring effective and timely co-selling motions with our direct sales force and the partner eco-system. Establishing yourself as the point person for day to day account management inquiries and performance concerns. Be present and available to Partners to continually build customer loyalty and ensuring ongoing enablement of our solutions and value propositions. Modelling exceptional partner account management that delivers sales and service excellence. Driving the growth and development of mutually beneficial working relationships with account team and key internal partners, and leverage work from and collaborate with other teams. What you will bring to our team:. 5+ years of proven track record in building alliance partner programs within enterprise software markets, preferably infrastructure. Must be fluent in both German and English, including excellent written skills. Successful track record of exceeding, business development and booking goals. Experience in personally managing end to end partner enablement plans, both business development and technical product training/knowledge transfer. Experience working collaboratively with internal direct sales & services team in successful closing of deals. Ability to develop with partners a quantifiable business case that will both establish and drive a strong mutually beneficial partnership that drives the partner's investment of both time and money. Ability to build strong relationships with senior executives and owners within partner community. Exceptional listener, highly empathetic to partner needs and perspectives. Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize accordingly. AvePoint is proud to employ talent from many different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We believe that diversity and inclusion drives our success and is at the core of how we hire, communicate, and collaborate to deliver value and excellence. We are committed to fostering an environment where people can bring their whole selves to work and feel a sense of belonging, and we continue to work toward creating a workforce that represents the diversity of our customers and communities.. #LI-SW1. #LI-HYBRID. title: Partner Activation Manager
description: AvePoint is seeking a Partner Activation Manager to join our Global Channel Marketing team. In this role, you will design and scale the programs, campaigns, and digital experiences that help new partners successfully onboard, engage with AvePoint, and become productive members of our partner ecosystem. Working across regional channel teams, partner operations, enablement, and marketing, you will create scalable activation programs that accelerate partner readiness, drive engagement with enablement resources, and improve partner time-to-value. This role offers the opportunity to shape how partners engage, learn, and become productive across a global ecosystem. You will have meaningful ownership of the partner activation experience and work with teams across the business to build programs that scale. With a focus on but not limited to:. Partner Activation & Onboarding. Own partner activation campaigns across the recruit-to-activate journey. Design and manage onboarding journeys that help new partners become productive more quickly. Coordinate global activation campaigns and onboarding programs from planning through execution. Partner with regional teams to adapt and deliver activation programs for local needs. Build scalable onboarding frameworks, playbooks, and campaign journeys that support partner activation across multiple partner types and regions. Partner with operations teams to optimize activation workflows, automate engagement programs, and improve the overall partner onboarding experience. Online Partner Enablement. Own the digital partner enablement experience, ensuring partners can easily access the training, resources, programs, and tools needed to become successful. Build and maintain scalable, self-service enablement resources. Drive partner engagement with enablement content, learning pathways, and certifications. Collaborate with Product Marketing and Content teams to keep partner-facing assets current and relevant. Measurement & Optimization. Define and track activation metrics including onboarding engagement, enablement adoption, partner activation rates and time-to-productivity metrics. Test and refine activation campaigns, onboarding journeys, and digital experiences based on performance insights. Share clear performance reporting, recommendations, and areas of opportunity with leadership. Use data and partner feedback to identify friction points and continuously improve activation experiences. Develop, maintain, and continuously improve partner activation dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness, partner engagement, onboarding progression, and business impact. Analyze partner lifecycle data to identify trends, opportunities, bottlenecks, and optimization recommendations that improve activation performance and time-to-value. Cross-Functional Collaboration. Align with Partner Program Operations on the workflows that support partner activation. Work across Channel, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, and regional teams to deliver a consistent partner experience. Serve as the central coordinator for global partner activation initiatives, aligning stakeholders across channel marketing, partner operations, enablement, product marketing, and regional teams. Partner closely with Operations and Business Intelligence teams to leverage Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI, and other reporting tools to measure partner activation performance, track KPIs, and support data-driven decision making.. How Success Will Be Measured. Success in this role will be measured through improvements in partner activation, faster time-to-productivity, increased onboarding completion, greater adoption of enablement resources and certifications, and consistent delivery of high-quality activation campaigns. The ideal candidate will help build scalable programs that enable partners to engage more quickly, access the right resources, and achieve value faster. Qualifications:. 5-8+ years of experience in channel marketing, partner programs, partner enablement, lifecycle marketing, customer onboarding, or a related field. Demonstrated success owning campaigns, onboarding programs, or enablement initiatives from concept through execution. Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and stakeholders. Experience developing digital or self-service content that drives adoption and engagement. Strong analytical skills with experience building, interpreting, and presenting performance dashboards and business insights. Experience working with CRM, business intelligence, and reporting platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI, Salesforce, Tableau, or similar tools. Ability to translate data into actionable recommendations that improve partner engagement, activation, and program performance. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams. Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly execution-oriented in a fast-paced, global environment. Preferred Experience. Experience supporting partner, alliance, or channel ecosystems within a B2B technology or SaaS organization. Familiarity with partner enablement platforms, learning management systems, partner relationship management platforms, or marketing automation tools. Experience building global programs that can be adapted for regional execution. Understanding of partner engagement, activation, adoption, and lifecycle marketing principles. Experience leveraging Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI, and related Microsoft ecosystem tools to analyze partner, marketing, or business performance metrics. Experience designing KPI frameworks, executive reporting, and operational dashboards for channel, partner, or lifecycle programs.. The Salary Range for this role is $120,000 - $170,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions-apply even if your expectations fall outside the range. title: Partner Development Manager, Germany
description: AvePoint is excited to provide the opportunity for an experienced and dynamic Partner Development Manager (PDM) who will be responsible for identifying, recruiting, and creating AvePoint partner sourced revenue via Managed Service Providers. You will sell to, support and onboard new MSP's as well as nurture existing MSP partnerships that drive new revenue with upsell and cross sell strategies. The PDM will be measured primarily on partner sourced revenue and new partner recruitment. Key Responsibilities:. Identifying and recruiting partners that will drive partner sourced pipeline and revenue for AvePoint. Ensure certification and effective enablement of MSPs. Help operationalize unique partner models and GTM strategies. Exceptional partner account management that delivers sales and service excellence. Evangelize within your partner ecosystem and territory to drive mindshare for AvePoint. What your day to day will look like:. Build and manage a pipeline of potential MSP partners, actively engaging in recruiting and onboarding activities to drive new partner relationships. Conduct regular partner enablement sessions, ensuring partners are certified and fully trained on AvePoint products and services. Collaborate with internal teams, including Sales and Product, to tailor GTM strategies for partner success. title: Partner Marketing Manager
description: Partner Marketing Manager, North America. About the role:. Are you a strategic, hands-on marketer who enjoys building programs with partners and bringing campaigns to life? As the Partner Marketing Manager for North America, you will own the strategy and execution of marketing programs for a named group of strategic partners. Reporting to the Director, Global Channel Marketing, you will help prioritize investments, develop joint go-to-market plans, and deliver campaigns that support partner engagement and business growth. What will you be doing?. In this role, you will serve as the primary marketing contact for your assigned partners and work cross-functionally with Channel Sales, Campaigns, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Creative, Content, and the ABX team. You will balance strategic planning with hands-on execution to ensure partner programs are prioritized, launched effectively, and aligned to business goals. Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:. Develop joint go-to-market plans and recommend the right campaigns, programs, and investments for each partner. Recommend market development fund (MDF) allocation and track investments against defined outcomes in partnership with the Director. Build and deliver through-partner demand generation programs, including email, digital, paid media, webinars, nurture campaigns, workshops, roundtables, and sales enablement. Create, format, and adapt campaign assets for web, social, events, email, paid media, and partner sales support. Prepare landing pages, email schedules, digital assets, and launch materials while ensuring all deliverables are accurate, on brand, and completed on time. Coordinate partner enablement sessions, bootcamps, and other programs that support partner readiness and engagement. Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for assigned partners and coordinate internally with cross-functional teams and external vendors. Track program execution, partner engagement, MDF utilization, and campaign results across the region. Report performance, risks, resource needs, and opportunities to the Director, Global Channel Marketing and regional sales leadership. What you will bring to our team:. We look for people who value agility, passion, and teamwork; those who can bring fresh ideas to the table and want the opportunity to learn, grow, and expand their careers. You are comfortable setting strategy, making informed recommendations, and rolling up your sleeves to execute the work. Other qualities you will need to be a fit for this role include:. Experience developing and executing partner, channel, demand generation, or B2B marketing programs. Demonstrated ability to manage both strategic planning and hands-on campaign execution. Experience creating and adapting marketing assets across email, web, social, paid media, events, and sales enablement channels. Understanding of partner go-to-market motions and the ability to align programs to partner and business objectives. Experience managing MDF or other partner marketing investments is preferred. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple partners, priorities, and deadlines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working directly with partners and senior stakeholders. Strong analytical skills with the ability to track performance, identify risks, and recommend next steps. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global and cross-functional teams. A proactive, detail-oriented approach and willingness to adapt in a fast-paced environment. title: Partner Program Operations Manager
location: London, United Kingdom; Munich, Germany; Paris, France; The Hague, Netherlands
description: . Role Summary. We are hiring a Partner Program Operations Manager to own the end-to-end operational execution of the partner program across systems, processes, and data. This role acts as the operational backbone of the partner ecosystem, ensuring that program design is translated into scalable, efficient, and auditable execution within the Partner Portal (PRM), CRM, and integrated platforms. You partner closely with program leadership, CRM administration, product teams, and external vendors to drive system integrity, process consistency, and operational excellence. This is an experienced individual contributor role. You serve as the primary expert for partner systems, workflows, and data governance. You do not manage people or own program strategy. You own how the partner program runs inside the systems that power it. . What This Role Is vs. Is Not. This Role IS. . This Role IS NOT. . The operational backbone of the partner program across PRM, CRM, and integrations. . A program strategy designer or partner program owner (that's channel leadership). . The primary expert and go-to owner for the Partner Portal (PRM). . A CRM administrator (you partner with CRM admins, you are not one). . The translator of business requirements into workflows and system configurations. . A software developer (you define requirements developers build against). . The owner of data integrity and governance between CRM and PRM. . A dashboard or reporting analyst. . An experienced individual contributor and project manager for partner systems. . A people manager or team lead. . . Core Responsibilities. Partner Portal & PRM Operations (40% of Role). You own the day-to-day operation, governance, and evolution of the Partner Portal and PRM. Own daily operation and governance of the Partner Portal: lifecycle, user experience, and audit readiness. Coordinate and own the release of new content on the Partner Portal. Support Partner Program changes through clear operational guidance. Act as the go-to expert for anything related to the Partner Portal or PRM. This is a critical regional role that bridges Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership with Global Revenue Operations to drive scalable growth, operational excellence, and full‑funnel alignment across strategy, execution, and planning. Based in Singapore, this role is ideal for an experienced leader with a strong mix of strategic thinking, technical systems depth, and analytical horsepower who can operate cross‑functionally in a complex, fast‑paced, global organization. You will own the operational heartbeat of the APAC go‑to‑market motion - from pipeline generation through renewal.. 🔑 Key Responsibilities. Lead APAC RevOps strategy and partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders.. Lead and oversee the regional delivery of day‑to‑day operational support to GTM teams, including deal structuring, CRM support, and pipeline inspection, through regional RevOps staff, owning escalations and cross‑functional resolution.. Ensure tight alignment between global and regional priorities, proactively advocating for APAC‑specific market dynamics, customer segments, and competitive nuances.. Serve as the regional leader for the RevOps tech stack - ensuring systems support local workflows throughout the revenue cycle.. Collaborate with global RevOps service owners to ensure technology and data accuracy.. Drive adoption and optimization of GTM tools across the region.. Design and maintain territory and account segmentation models reflecting APAC market dynamics.. Partner with global RevOps and regional sales leadership on quota setting, allocation, and capacity modeling.. Monitor coverage models and recommend adjustments based on performance trends and headcount planning.. Own the APAC forecasting process, including weekly forecast calls, pipeline health reviews, and call accuracy tracking.. Deliver accurate, actionable reporting on pipeline health, revenue attainment, productivity, and funnel conversion metrics.. Provide data‑driven insights and recommendations to GTM leaders to identify risks, accelerate deals, and improve win rates.. Ensure timely and reliable executive reporting for QBRs, board prep, and regional planning reviews.. Lead, coach, and develop a team of direct reports, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and fostering a high‑performance culture.. . 🎯 Qualifications. 8-10+ years of experience in Sales, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM strategy roles in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.. Expertise in CRM and BI tools (Microsoft Dynamics and Power BI preferred; Salesforce also valued).. Proven experience in sales performance, planning, forecasting, territory design, and capacity modeling.. Strong analytical skills with Excel/Sheets and data visualization tools.. Experience supporting large, distributed APAC sales organizations (Japan, Singapore, Australia, NZ strongly preferred).. Ability to influence and partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Enablement, and Product.. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting complex data and recommendations to executive leadership.. Highly organized, self‑directed, and proactive - thrives in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments.. . title: Sales Director, MSP
description: About the role:. . We're looking for a proven leader with a track record of building and scaling MSP, channel or partner businesses in high-growth environments. If you've successfully built and scaled a high-growth MSP, channel or partner business and are seeking the defining challenge of your career, we should talk. As AvePoint continues its journey from US$500M to US$1B+ in revenue, we're betting heavily on our MSP business as a key growth engine for the company and are hiring a Director to lead the next phase of growth across ANZ. This is not a turnaround role, it's a scale-up opportunity. AvePoint already works with more than 600 MSP partners across Australia and New Zealand and has established itself as a market leader in data protection, governance, resilience and AI readiness for the Microsoft ecosystem. Your mandate is to build on these foundations and accelerate growth by 40-60% annually over the next three years. You'll lead the strategy, growth and execution of our MSP business, supported by local Solution Engineering, Partner Success and Marketing teams, as well as significant global investment. You'll lead and expand a growing team of Partner and Distribution Business Managers, with the autonomy to shape strategy, hire top talent and deepen relationships with the region's largest and most successful MSPs. The opportunity is significant. As organisations navigate AI adoption, cyber resilience, compliance and data governance, MSPs must drive customer outcomes. AvePoint is uniquely positioned to help them succeed with market-leading technology designed for the channel. For the right person, this is a genuinely career-defining opportunity to lead one of AvePoint's most strategic growth initiatives and play a key role in our journey to US$1B and beyond.. What you'll do:. Develop and operationalise the MSP channel sales strategy, translating broader GTM priorities into a clear territory plan. Lead, coach and develop a team of PDMs to deliver the MSP channel strategy. Build executive relationships with MSP partners to drive retention, growth and a strong partner experience. Generate pipeline and close opportunities across new and upsell ACV while expanding existing ARR. Maintain strong territory management discipline (account planning, pipeline generation, campaign execution and CRM hygiene). Partner closely with Marketing and Solution Engineering to execute joint campaigns and solution motions. Provide accurate weekly reporting and forecasting, including pipeline health and risk. Act as an escalation point for large strategic MSPs and help remove blockers to close. . What you'll bring:. Proven success in B2B sales leadership within a channel, partner or MSP ecosystem. Experience managing and coaching sales or partner managers (hands-on player/coach style). Strong pipeline generation and forecasting discipline, with confident CRM hygiene. Commercial acumen and experience closing subscription/SaaS outcomes (ARR/ACV preferred). Excellent stakeholder management across partners and internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Solution Engineering). Ability to present to and influence senior decision-makers. Curiosity and learning mindset across industry trends and the Microsoft ecosystem. . Benefits we offer:. Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Work life balance through hybrid working model of 3 days a week in office. Enhanced PTO allowance with specific AvePoint Holidays (Birthday Day, Family Day, Holiday Half Day, Community Outreach Half Day!). Private Health Insurance. Mobile Phone Plan Reimbursement. Tuition Reimbursement. Dedication Awards. Employee Referral Program. ...and much more!. AvePoint is proud to employ talent from many different backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We believe that diversity and inclusion drives our success and is at the core of how we hire, communicate, and collaborate to deliver value and excellence. We are committed to fostering an environment where people can bring their whole selves to work and feel a sense of belonging, and we continue to work toward creating a workforce that represents the diversity of our customers and communities. #LI-HR1. . . Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice. . .

title: Salesforce Administrator
description: About AvePoint:. Beyond Secure. AvePoint is the global leader in data security, governance, and resilience, going beyond traditional solutions to ensure a robust data foundation and enable organizations everywhere to collaborate with confidence. Over 25,000 customers worldwide rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to prepare, secure, and optimize their critical data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other collaboration environments. AvePoint's global channel partner program includes approximately 5,000 managed service providers, value-added resellers, and systems integrators, with our solutions available in more than 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit www.avepoint.com. . At AvePoint, we are committed to investing in our people. Agility, passion and teamwork set us up to do our best work and foster a culture where you are empowered to craft your career, make an impact, and own (y)our future. Unleash the power of you!. Job Summary. We are looking for a Salesforce Administrator to configure, maintain, support, and continuously improve our Salesforce platform for enterprise and government clients. The successful candidate will serve as the first line of support for Salesforce-related issues, assisting users, troubleshooting system errors, and ensuring smooth daily operations. They will also work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, configure the Salesforce environment accordingly, and deliver enhancements that maximize business value. Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to Salesforce. Configure standard and custom Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, record types, workflows, approval processes, and validation rules. Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to support business operations and decision-making. Administer user access, roles, profiles, permission sets, and data visibility. Manage sandbox environments, support data imports/exports, and assist with data quality initiatives. Monitor platform performance and proactively identify areas for improvement. Support end-users by providing training, documentation, and troubleshooting while serving as the primary representative for project-specific customer technical inquiries. Take ownership of issues through to resolution, ensuring adherence to SLAs for response and resolution times, and perform thorough troubleshooting and root cause analysis of technical problems. Collaborate with developers and external vendors to support integration and enhancement efforts, while managing and tracking change requests, bug fixes, system update deployments, and related documentation. Ensure configurations and changes align with best practices and comply with governance policies. Prepare statistical reports and present them effectively during weekly and monthly progress meetings with clients. Requirements:. Minimum Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering. Preferably more than 1 year of experience in the IT industry managing large-scale application support, and a strong technical development background with experience across the full project lifecycle. 3+ years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator. Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201) certification required. Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud). Experience creating workflows, validation rules, process builder flows, and automation tools. Ability to create meaningful reports and dashboards for various business functions. A highly energetic and motivated team player with strong communication skills, comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactively customer-focused, and confident in engaging directly with clients and vendors, able to perform effectively under tight timelines and pressure while contributing to the digital transformation journey. Experience supporting end-user training, adoption, and platform governance. Familiarity with data management tools such as Data Loader or Data Import Wizard. Understanding of platform security and sharing models. Proficient in communicating with English both verbally and in writing. Proficiency in Mandarin is a plus . Certifications:. Required: Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201). Preferred: Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or any Consultant-level certifications. Preferred Qualifications:. Experience in public sector or compliance-driven environments. Experienced in working on projects using the Agile methodology and leveraging CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of declarative tools such as Flow, Assignment Rules, and Omni-Channel Routing. Basic understanding of Apex, SOQL, and Salesforce integration principles. Experience with change management, release planning, or DevOps tools for Salesforce. Experience in Software Development and Microsoft SQL Server will be an advantage. Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice. . .

title: Salesforce Administrator
description: . Role Overview. The Salesforce Administrator is responsible for the end-to-end administration, maintenance, and optimization of the Salesforce platform. This role ensures system stability, supports business users, assesses technical feasibility for enhancement requests, and drives continuous improvement in CRM processes and data management. Key Responsibilities. Platform Administration & Operations. Ensure system availability, performance, and data integrity within Salesforce. Manage users, roles, profiles, permission sets, and access controls. Perform routine system maintenance, including data quality checks, backups, and updates. Monitor and troubleshoot system issues, including integrations, workflows, and automation errors. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for system enhancements, patches, and issue resolution. User Support & Enablement. Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for Salesforce functionalities and best practices. Provide day-to-day support to business users, including issue resolution and request handling. Conduct user training and onboarding sessions on Salesforce usage and features. Translate business requirements into system configurations and solutions. Configuration & Customization. Configure and maintain objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, flows, and page layouts. Support process automation using tools such as Flow and Process Builder. Manage reports and dashboards to support business insights and decision-making. Feasibility Assessment & Solution Advisory. Assess enhancement requests for technical feasibility within Salesforce. Provide solution recommendations, effort estimation, and highlight potential constraints. Collaborate with developers or architects for more complex customizations and integrations. Data Management & Governance. Maintain data quality, consistency, and security standards. Support data migration, cleansing, and deduplication activities. Ensure compliance with internal policies and data governance practices. Documentation & Continuous Improvement. Maintain documentation of system configurations, processes, and changes. Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and reduce manual processes. Stay updated on Salesforce releases and recommend new features where applicable. Required Skills & Experience. Proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator. Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration (objects, fields, workflows, flows, security model). Experience in user management, reporting, and dashboard creation. Knowledge of integrations and data management best practices. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Good stakeholder communication and ability to translate business needs into system solutions. Desirable Attributes. Salesforce Administrator certification (preferred). Experience working in cross-functional teams. Proactive mindset with a focus on process improvement. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. title: Senior Director, Digital Marketing
description: The Opportunity. Digital marketing has been fundamentally restructured by AI - and we need a leader who doesn't just understand that shift, but is actively shaping it. This is not a role for someone catching up; it's for someone who's already operating in the new paradigm. As Senior Director of Digital Marketing, you will own AvePoint's end-to-end digital presence and performance - from how we're discovered by AI answer engines to how we convert pipeline on the website. You'll lead SEO/GEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, and web conversion strategy, building a fully AI-powered digital org that stays ahead of the curve on every front. What You'll Own. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & GEO. Define and lead AvePoint's strategy for AI-driven search visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, and emerging LLM platforms. Build AEO accountability frameworks: benchmark tracking, citation monitoring, share-of-voice in AI-generated answers, and input/output OKRs across contributing teams. Partner with Brand, Demand Gen, and AR teams on content and structural approaches that increase AvePoint's citation frequency in AI answer surfaces. Stay 6-12 months ahead of platform changes - from structured data to semantic search to agent-based browsing - and translate emerging signals into actionable strategy. SEO Strategy & Organic Performance. Own organic search strategy across the full funnel - from brand and category terms to long-tail buying-stage content - with direct ownership of Ahrefs (Brand Radar) and GA4 reporting. Lead technical SEO: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, schema markup, and content velocity programs. Build AI-assisted content workflows that accelerate topical authority without sacrificing quality signals or E-E-A-T. Establish and track SEO/GEO channel benchmarks across impressions, clicks, and campaign members as part of the full marketing funnel measurement model. Paid Media & Performance Marketing. Oversee paid media investment across Google, LinkedIn, display, and programmatic - with direct accountability for MQL volume, cost per MQL (benchmark: $4K), and SAL conversion rates. Deploy AI-native campaign management: automated bidding, creative testing at scale, predictive audience modeling, and intent signal integration from 6sense and Clearbit Reveal. Partner with RevOps and Analytics to connect paid spend to pipeline attribution as the attribution model matures (Dreamdata evaluation in progress). Manage paid media budgets with rigor - optimizing channel mix across regions (AMER, EMEA, ANZ) and product categories (AI Governance, Resilience). Website & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO). Own the AvePoint website as a revenue-generating asset: information architecture, UX, messaging alignment, and conversion performance across all campaign and product landing pages. Lead CRO programs - A/B testing, personalization (in partnership with 6sense and Clearbit), and conversion path optimization - with GA4 and pipeline as the primary success metrics. Collaborate with Product Marketing on solution and persona-based web journeys; with Brand on design system consistency; and with Demand Gen on campaign landing page performance. Evaluate and integrate AI tools for dynamic content, intelligent chat, and web personalization to improve engagement and self-service pipeline creation. Building an AI-Powered Digital Org. Model and enforce AI proficiency standards across the Digital Marketing team - targeting L4 proficiency (The Neuron's 5-Level Framework) by year-end, with at least one L5 agent deployed. Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools across every digital function: content generation, keyword research, ad creative testing, reporting automation, and audience intelligence. Create a culture of continuous learning and experimentation - running fast, documenting what works, and distributing knowledge across the broader growth marketing org. Serve as the internal subject matter expert on AI-driven digital marketing, educating the ELT and cross-functional stakeholders on implications and opportunities. How We'll Measure Success. You'll be accountable to AvePoint's full marketing funnel - from impressions to pipeline - with digital owning specific stages:. Metric. . Channel. . Your Accountability. . Impressions & Clicks. . Paid Ads, SEO, AEO. . Primary owner. . Campaign Members. . Website, Paid, Search. . Primary owner. . Cost per MQL. . All digital channels. . Primary owner. . SAL Conversion Rate. . MQL quality indicators. . Contributing owner. . Pipeline Contribution. . Digital-sourced leads. . Contributing owner. . AEO Citation Share. . AI answer engines. . Primary owner. . . Who You Are. 8+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role owning paid media, SEO, and web. Demonstrated expertise in AEO and GEO - you've been tracking and optimizing for AI-generated answer surfaces, not just reading about them. Deep hands-on experience with GA4, paid search/social platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn), SEO tooling (Ahrefs, SEMrush), and marketing automation (Marketo preferred). Proven ability to connect digital spend to pipeline outcomes - you understand attribution, work well with RevOps, and don't hide behind vanity metrics. Experience scaling AI tooling across a team - not just using AI yourself, but building processes, workflows, and capability frameworks for others. Strong analytical instincts: you read data, form hypotheses, test them, and ship results. Executive-ready communication - you can translate digital performance into business impact for ELT and board audiences. Strongly Preferred. Experience in B2B SaaS, security, or data governance - familiarity with complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. Experience with ABM platforms like 6sense or intent data tools (Bombora, Clearbit Reveal). Exposure to Dynamics 365 and Marketo in a pipeline-reporting context. Comfort operating in a global org with regional go-to-market nuance (AMER, EMEA, ANZ). Active participant in digital marketing communities, newsletters, or public thought leadership on AI-driven marketing. The Signal We're Looking For. The right person for this role doesn't wait for the industry to settle before making a move. They're already running experiments in AEO. They've replaced manual reporting workflows with AI agents. They have a point of view on where search is going in 18 months - and they're building for it now. They hold themselves accountable to pipeline, not just impressions. The Salary Range for this role is $200,000 - $270,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). description: The Opportunity. Digital marketing has been fundamentally restructured by AI - and we need a leader who doesn't just understand that shift, but is actively shaping it. This is not a role for someone catching up; it's for someone who's already operating in the new paradigm. As Senior Director of Digital Marketing, you will own AvePoint's end-to-end digital presence and performance - from how we're discovered by AI answer engines to how we convert pipeline on the website. You'll lead SEO/GEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, and web conversion strategy, building a fully AI-powered digital org that stays ahead of the curve on every front. What You'll Own. Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & GEO. Define and lead AvePoint's strategy for AI-driven search visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, and emerging LLM platforms. Build AEO accountability frameworks: benchmark tracking, citation monitoring, share-of-voice in AI-generated answers, and input/output OKRs across contributing teams. Partner with Brand, Demand Gen, and AR teams on content and structural approaches that increase AvePoint's citation frequency in AI answer surfaces. Stay 6-12 months ahead of platform changes - from structured data to semantic search to agent-based browsing - and translate emerging signals into actionable strategy. SEO Strategy & Organic Performance. Own organic search strategy across the full funnel - from brand and category terms to long-tail buying-stage content - with direct ownership of Ahrefs (Brand Radar) and GA4 reporting. Lead technical SEO: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, schema markup, and content velocity programs. Build AI-assisted content workflows that accelerate topical authority without sacrificing quality signals or E-E-A-T. Establish and track SEO/GEO channel benchmarks across impressions, clicks, and campaign members as part of the full marketing funnel measurement model. Paid Media & Performance Marketing. Oversee paid media investment across Google, LinkedIn, display, and programmatic - with direct accountability for MQL volume, cost per MQL (benchmark: $4K), and SAL conversion rates. Deploy AI-native campaign management: automated bidding, creative testing at scale, predictive audience modeling, and intent signal integration from 6sense and Clearbit Reveal. Partner with RevOps and Analytics to connect paid spend to pipeline attribution as the attribution model matures (Dreamdata evaluation in progress). Manage paid media budgets with rigor - optimizing channel mix across regions (AMER, EMEA, ANZ) and product categories (AI Governance, Resilience). Website & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO). Own the AvePoint website as a revenue-generating asset: information architecture, UX, messaging alignment, and conversion performance across all campaign and product landing pages. Lead CRO programs - A/B testing, personalization (in partnership with 6sense and Clearbit), and conversion path optimization - with GA4 and pipeline as the primary success metrics. Collaborate with Product Marketing on solution and persona-based web journeys; with Brand on design system consistency; and with Demand Gen on campaign landing page performance. Evaluate and integrate AI tools for dynamic content, intelligent chat, and web personalization to improve engagement and self-service pipeline creation. Building an AI-Powered Digital Org. Model and enforce AI proficiency standards across the Digital Marketing team - targeting L4 proficiency (The Neuron's 5-Level Framework) by year-end, with at least one L5 agent deployed. Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools across every digital function: content generation, keyword research, ad creative testing, reporting automation, and audience intelligence. Create a culture of continuous learning and experimentation - running fast, documenting what works, and distributing knowledge across the broader growth marketing org. Serve as the internal subject matter expert on AI-driven digital marketing, educating the ELT and cross-functional stakeholders on implications and opportunities. How We'll Measure Success. You'll be accountable to AvePoint's full marketing funnel - from impressions to pipeline - with digital owning specific stages:. Metric. . Channel. . Your Accountability. . Impressions & Clicks. . Paid Ads, SEO, AEO. . Primary owner. . Campaign Members. . Website, Paid, Search. . Primary owner. . Cost per MQL. . All digital channels. . Primary owner. . SAL Conversion Rate. . MQL quality indicators. . Contributing owner. . Pipeline Contribution. . Digital-sourced leads. . Contributing owner. . AEO Citation Share. . AI answer engines. . Primary owner. . . Who You Are. 8+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role owning paid media, SEO, and web. Demonstrated expertise in AEO and GEO - you've been tracking and optimizing for AI-generated answer surfaces, not just reading about them. Deep hands-on experience with GA4, paid search/social platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn), SEO tooling (Ahrefs, SEMrush), and marketing automation (Marketo preferred). Proven ability to connect digital spend to pipeline outcomes - you understand attribution, work well with RevOps, and don't hide behind vanity metrics. Experience scaling AI tooling across a team - not just using AI yourself, but building processes, workflows, and capability frameworks for others. Strong analytical instincts: you read data, form hypotheses, test them, and ship results. Executive-ready communication - you can translate digital performance into business impact for ELT and board audiences. Strongly Preferred. Experience in B2B SaaS, security, or data governance - familiarity with complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. Experience with ABM platforms like 6sense or intent data tools (Bombora, Clearbit Reveal). Exposure to Dynamics 365 and Marketo in a pipeline-reporting context. Comfort operating in a global org with regional go-to-market nuance (AMER, EMEA, ANZ). Active participant in digital marketing communities, newsletters, or public thought leadership on AI-driven marketing. The Signal We're Looking For. The right person for this role doesn't wait for the industry to settle before making a move. They're already running experiments in AEO. They've replaced manual reporting workflows with AI agents. They have a point of view on where search is going in 18 months - and they're building for it now. They hold themselves accountable to pipeline, not just impressions. title: Senior Engineer, Website & GTM Systems
description: About the Role. AvePoint is looking for a technical, hands-on Senior Engineer to join Business Operations and serve as a lead developer within the GTM Engineering function. Approximately 30% of this role's time is dedicated to hands-on coding, scripting, integration development, and technical troubleshooting. The remaining 70% is dedicated to strategic technology planning, architecture ownership, and delivery execution across the GTM tech stack. This person will act as a trusted technical advisor to Marketing Operations & Technology leadership, translating business objectives into a prioritized technical roadmap while remaining close enough to the code and systems to build, debug, and validate solutions directly when needed. The role requires strong engineering judgment, hands-on technical depth, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic planning and direct execution across three mission-critical areas: website architecture, GTM infrastructure and data foundation. Key Responsibilities. Hands-On Engineering (~30% of Time). Build, test, and maintain integrations, scripts, and automations across the GTM tech stack. Debug frontend tracking, tagging, and consent implementations directly in code and using browser developer tools. Contribute code and technical fixes for website infrastructure, CMS integrations, and API-driven workflows. Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, and integration development. Validate technical designs through direct implementation and prototyping before handoff or scale-up. Strategic Technology Planning and Delivery (~70% of Time). Own GTM technical roadmap. Translate business objectives and innovation priorities into a multi-quarter technical roadmap across the tech stack and web platform. Maintain AvePoint's GTM architecture and integration strategy that improves scalability, measurement, and governance. Support web front-end and back-end infrastructure. Maintain the health, performance, availability, and security of global web properties supporting the GTM stack across CDN, cloud, and application infrastructure. Partner with Engineering and DevOps to improve observability, deployment reliability, uptime, and performance optimization across marketing web platforms. Develop and maintain custom Craft CMS modules and plugins to extend content workflows, integrations, and site functionality beyond out-of-the-box capabilities. Oversee incident response processes and operational readiness for deployments, DNS, SSL/TLS, caching, CDN routing, and platform availability. Own technical planning and delivery. Provide technical delivery guidance and draft technical requirements as senior technical contributor. Implement SCRUM practices to increase delivery speed and predictability. Support data infrastructure and measurement foundations. Own strategy and governance for marketing and GTM data platforms, pipelines, event collection, and identity alignment across systems, from first touch to lifecycle. Support compliance, privacy, and security by design. Architect global consent logic and privacy orchestration, including cookie compliance platforms such as Osano, while protecting measurement and data integrity. Job Requirements. Engineering Delivery. Proven experience as a senior technical contributor owning delivery outcomes, including roadmap planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment. Strong operational execution with SCRUM-based delivery, sprint planning, and measurable throughput improvements. Comfortable operating as both a technical business partner able to direct technical strategy and personally execute hands-on engineering work. Cloud, Infrastructure, and Web Platform. Familiarity with modern website infrastructure and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, including CDN, networking, Kubernetes, DNS, and web application delivery concepts. Solid grounding in cloud architecture and web delivery (CDN, DNS, SSL/TLS, caching) plus event-driven, serverless, and API integration patterns. Proven track record designing and delivering large-scale web applications with a focus on reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. Application & Languages. Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Python. GTM Applications and Platforms: Craft CMS, React, Astro, Node.js, REST APIs, CRM, Marketing Automation, GraphQL, Redis, Microsoft Azure, GitHub/GitLab, Osano, Google Tag Manager, GA4, Postman, Zapier/Make, Segment, BigQuery. Headless CMS and Modern Frontend Architecture. Experience supporting headless CMS and modern frontend architectures such as Craft CMS, Astro, GraphQL APIs, SSR/ISR rendering models, and API-driven content delivery. DevOps, CI/CD, and Deployment. Working knowledge of CI/CD workflows, Git-based development practices, and deployment tooling using platforms such as GitLab or GitHub. Caching, Automation, and Performance. Understanding of caching strategies, webhook-driven automation, CDN cache invalidation, and Redis-based application caching. Website Cookie Compliance. Privacy orchestration experience with the ability to architect global consent for website cookie compliance software such as Osano, TrustArc, or OneTrust. AI-Assisted Development. Ability to use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Google AI Studio to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, automation, and integration development. Foundational Technical Literacy. Web fundamentals: understands what HTML, CSS, and DOM elements are, enough to guide an AI tool to scrape or modify them. API logic: understands REST APIs and JSON structures, and how to use tools such as Postman, Zapier, or Make. Data literacy: basic SQL knowledge to query data in tools such as Segment or BigQuery. . Produce clear architecture diagrams, API specifications and technical findings; provide technical guidance and share knowledge with developers and project stakeholders. An OutSystems 11 developer certification: Associate Developer (O11), an earlier Associate Reactive Developer (OutSystems 11) certification, or a higher-level O11 developer certification. Practical experience developing, deploying and supporting applications in OutSystems 11 on-premises environments. Strong OutSystems 11 skills in Reactive Web development, modular architecture, entities, application logic, reusable components and role-based access control. Experience with Service Studio, Service Center and LifeTime for development, troubleshooting and deployment. Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, with a working understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and API gateway integration. Strong relational database and SQL skills, including data modelling, query optimisation and investigation of data-related issues. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to distinguish symptoms from root causes and support recommendations with evidence. Strong consulting and communication skills, including active listening, stakeholder engagement and the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences. Web and backend development skills in C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React or comparable technologies. Observability Engineering and Governance. Architect and maintain enterprise SIEM solutions aligned with operational resilience mandates (e.g., MAS TRM, DORA, APRA CPS 230). Lead deployment, configuration, and optimization of Splunk for full-stack visibility across infrastructure, applications, networks, and user experience. Define and enforce telemetry data governance standards-metrics, logs, and traces-ensuring consistency, retention compliance, and security. Act as the SIEM/Splunk subject matter expert (SME) for architecture reviews, platform upgrades, and performance tuning. Reliability Engineering and Automation. Collaborate with Application, Infrastructure, and Cyber teams to embed reliability principles into the delivery lifecycle. Conduct resilience, chaos, and capacity testing aligned with business continuity and disaster recovery standards. Define and track error budgets, reliability scorecards, and service health indicators for production workloads. Cloud & Platform Integration. Engineer SIEM for cloud-native workloads in AWS and Azure, ensuring visibility across compute, storage, and network layers. Integrate Splunk and cloud observability tools into CI/CD pipelines and landing zones to ensure continuous compliance. Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) models using Terraform and Ansible for consistent, auditable provisioning. Collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, and Security teams to ensure telemetry aligns with audit, compliance, and operational risk requirements. Operational Excellence and Collaboration. Drive reduction in incident recurrence, MTTR, and manual intervention through observability-led automation. Partner with Service Delivery, Cyber, and Application teams to enable predictive incident prevention and root cause transparency. Develop and maintain executive dashboards and reports showcasing availability, reliability KPIs, and operational risk indicators. Provide technical leadership during major incidents, post-incident reviews, and audits, ensuring lessons learned are codified into automation and process improvements. Skillset (Must have). Possess a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Minimum 8 years of experience in Infrastructure, Cloud, or Site Reliability Engineering related roles, with at least 5 years of experience specializing in SIEM/Splunk engineering or observability in financial or regulated environments. Proven hands-on expertise in the following technical areas:. SIEM Platforms: Splunk (must), EL/Elastic. Automation/IaC, Terraform, Ansible, Python, CI/CD tools. Cloud and other platforms and integrations: AWS (CloudWatch, X-Ray, CloudTrail), Azure (Monitor, Log Analytics, App Insights), Datadog, ServiceNow Deep understanding of SRE principles, service health modelling, error budgets, and auto-remediation design. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to perform deep-dive investigations and develop long-term preventive solutions. Familiarity with financial sector operational resilience frameworks, regulatory compliance, and incident governance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact with diverse stakeholders. Agile, fast learner and able to adapt to changes. . Skillset (Good to have). Preferred Certifications:. description: RESPONSIBILITY. The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software reliability, test automation, and continuous quality improvement across the software development lifecycle. title: Solution Engineer, MSP & Cloud Marketplace
description: About AvePoint:. Beyond Secure. AvePoint is the global leader in data security, governance, and resilience, going beyond traditional solutions to ensure a robust data foundation and enable organizations everywhere to collaborate with confidence. Over 25,000 customers worldwide rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to prepare, secure, and optimize their critical data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other collaboration environments. AvePoint's global channel partner program includes approximately 5,000 managed service providers, value-added resellers, and systems integrators, with our solutions available in more than 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit www.avepoint.com. . At AvePoint, we are committed to investing in our people. Agility, passion and teamwork set us up to do our best work and foster a culture where you are empowered to craft your career, make an impact, and own (y)our future. Unleash the power of you!. . About the role. The Solutions Engineer is the technical lead for AvePoint's Elements MSP business. Working alongside Partner Development Managers, distribution teams and strategic MSP partners, you will turn AvePoint technology into repeatable, scalable managed services that partners can take to market through cloud marketplaces. This is not a traditional product demonstration role. You will combine technical expertise, commercial awareness and partner enablement to help MSPs validate the opportunity, design their service, secure their first customers and build the capability to sell, demonstrate and deliver independently. Your success will be measured by technically activated partners, marketplace ARR influenced, opportunity conversion and the speed at which partners become self-sufficient. MISSION: Build technically capable MSP partners that can create, transact and scale repeatable AvePoint managed services through cloud marketplaces. What you will be doing. Partner solution design and service creation. Lead technical discovery with prospective and existing MSP partners to understand their service strategy, technical estate, customer needs and routes to market. Help partners design, package and launch repeatable managed services using AvePoint Elements, including the technical architecture, service scope, operating model and customer value proposition. Create standardised demonstration, proof-of-concept, deployment and onboarding patterns that partners can reuse across customers. Advise partners on how AvePoint capabilities can help their customers reduce cost, strengthen security and governance, improve resilience and increase business agility. Technical pre-sales and opportunity conversion. Act as the technical lead across qualified Elements opportunities, from discovery and solution validation through evaluation and technical closure. Deliver compelling solution overviews, demonstrations, technical deep dives, workshops and proofs of concept for partners and, where strategically appropriate, their customers. Translate business and technical requirements into a clear solution recommendation, success criteria and mutual technical action plan. Identify and resolve technical risks early, while maintaining momentum and clear ownership through the evaluation process. Contribute to proposals and responses to RFIs and RFPs, clearly connecting AvePoint technology to measurable customer and partner outcomes. Partner activation and self-sufficiency. Build structured enablement plans that move partners from initial training to independent selling, demonstrating, onboarding and delivery. Coach partner sales and technical teams through their first opportunities, then progressively transfer capability to the partner. Create practical technical assets, playbooks and reusable content that shorten time to first transaction and reduce dependency on AvePoint resources. Assess partner technical readiness, identify capability gaps and agree clear actions with the Partner Development Manager. Distribution and marketplace scale. Work with the Distribution Business Manager and distributor technical teams to create scalable partner recruitment, onboarding and enablement programmes. Support technical readiness for cloud marketplace transactions and help partners understand the technical requirements of the marketplace-led service model. Enable distributor technical resources to support repeatable partner activation and reduce the need for direct AvePoint involvement in every opportunity. Share feedback on recurring technical blockers, partner needs and marketplace friction to improve the overall Elements operating model. Cross-functional collaboration and market insight. Partner closely with Partner Development Managers to qualify where technical investment will have the greatest commercial impact. Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Services and Support to provide a consistent partner journey and ensure clean handovers. Support selected workshops, webinars, trade shows and partner events where there is a clear recruitment, activation, pipeline or ARR outcome. Capture and communicate partner feedback, competitive insight, customer requirements and emerging market trends to relevant internal teams. H ow success will be measured. Performance will be assessed through a balanced set of commercial, conversion and partner-capability outcomes. Measures may include:. Marketplace ARR and qualified pipeline technically influenced. Number of MSP partners reaching agreed technical activation milestones. Time from qualified partner recruitment to technical readiness, first opportunity and first transaction. Technical win rate and proof-of-concept to close conversion. Number of repeatable managed services successfully designed and launched with partners. Partner self-sufficiency, including the ability to demonstrate, scope, onboard and deliver without routine AvePoint intervention. Quality and reuse of technical assets, enablement content and deployment patterns. Partner and internal stakeholder feedback on technical leadership, responsiveness and commercial impact. Role boundaries and ways of working. The role works across the partner lifecycle, but ownership remains clear:. Role. . Primary accountability. . Partner Development Manager. . Partner recruitment, qualification, commercial development, pipeline ownership and partner growth plan. . Solutions Engineer. . Technical qualification, solution design, service creation, technical validation, opportunity progression and partner technical self-sufficiency. . Distribution Business Manager. . Strategic distributor relationship, joint business plan, prioritisation and scaled execution through distribution. . Partner Success. . Post-activation adoption, ongoing partner engagement, service growth and partner performance. . Services and Support. . Implementation services and post-sale technical support, according to the agreed engagement and support model. . Operating principle: Direct end-customer support should be prioritised where it helps activate a strategic partner, establish a repeatable service or reference, or progress a material marketplace opportunity. The role is not intended to become an unlimited technical resource for every partner-led transaction. What we're looking for. Experience in a solutions engineering, technical pre-sales, partner engineering, cloud consulting or similar customer-facing technical role. Strong understanding of the MSP operating model and how ISVs work with MSPs, distributors, CSPs, VARs and systems integrators. Ability to connect technical capability to a partner business model, customer outcome and recurring revenue opportunity. Confident and engaging presentation, discovery, facilitation and demonstration skills across business and technical audiences. Commercial awareness and the judgement to prioritise technical effort against qualified opportunities and partner potential. Ability to simplify complex requirements and build repeatable services, technical patterns and enablement content. Strong stakeholder management, written communication and collaboration skills. A self-motivated, adaptable approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-changing, partner-led environment. BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Technical experience. Practical experience with Microsoft 365 administration, security, governance, backup, migration or compliance solutions. Understanding of multi-tenant cloud service delivery and the operational requirements of MSPs. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint Online and Microsoft Purview. Familiarity with cloud marketplaces, Microsoft CSP motions and SaaS subscription models. Experience building demonstration, proof-of-concept and onboarding environments. Understanding of APIs, automation, integrations and repeatable deployment approaches. Broader knowledge of AWS, Google Cloud, Google Workspace, Windows Server, SQL Server, networking and hybrid environments is advantageous. What good looks like. You are technically credible, commercially curious and comfortable operating through partners. You do not simply deliver a strong demonstration; you help an MSP turn the technology into a service it can repeatedly sell and deliver. You know when to go deep, when to standardise and when to transfer ownership to the partner. You focus your time where it can create measurable pipeline, conversion, partner capability and marketplace ARR. Why join AvePoint?. You will have the opportunity to shape how AvePoint scales its Elements MSP business, working across technology, partner strategy and commercial execution. You will help partners build valuable cloud services, develop your expertise across a broad technology portfolio and play a visible role in a growing marketplace-led business. . You will be responsible for designing, presenting, and demonstrating solutions that address our customers' business challenges and objectives. You will also provide technical guidance and support throughout the sales cycle, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey. Responsibilities. Engage with customers, prospects, and channel partners to understand their business needs and pain points and propose solutions that leverage AvePoint's solutions centered around AvePoint's go-to-market initiatives. Lead new and renewal opportunities as the Strategic Lead while working with appropriate departments to support meeting objectives and customer goals. Create and deliver compelling presentations, demos, and proposals that display the value and benefits of our solutions. Collaborate with sales teams, delivery resources, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and coordination of sales activities and deliverables. Provide technical leadership and guidance to customers and internal teams on best practices, architecture, design, and implementation of our solutions. Support marketing initiatives and events remote or in person that will drive customer growth opportunities. Partner with sales enablement teams to ensure that those that impact the customer lifecycle journey can hold consistent conversations while influencing outcomes. Support internal product vision initiatives where Power Platform is a focus. Externally you will be a solution evangelist, yet internally at AvePoint you will focus on becoming a product expert. . Measures of Success. Customer Engagement : Measure the number of customer interactions, and the quality of feedback received. This metric aligns with the responsibility of engaging with customers and understanding their needs. Presentation Impact : Track the number of presentations delivered, audience engagement, and follow-up actions taken by prospects. This is related to the responsibility of creating and delivering compelling presentations. Sales Collaboration : Evaluate the effectiveness of collaboration with sales teams by measuring the alignment of sales activities and the success rate of coordinated efforts. Technical Leadership : Assess the impact of technical guidance provided to customers and internal teams through success stories, case studies, and customer satisfaction surveys. Knowledge Sharing : Monitor the frequency and reach of insights shared about industry trends and updating supporting teams. title: Sr. Director, Analyst Relations
description: Overview. AvePoint is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Director of Analyst Relations to lead and evolve our global analyst relations program. This role will define and execute a multi-year strategy that strengths AvePoint's position with leading industry analysts, advances our presence in flagship research such as Gartner Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves, and Omdia -Canalys Leadership Matrices, and translates analyst insights into meaningful business impact. Working closely with executive leadership, Product, Marketing, Sales, and Communications, the Senior Director will build trusted analyst relationships, shape market perception, influence category positioning, and ensure analyst validation is leveraged across go-to-market initiatives to support brand growth, customer confidence, and revenue outcomes. . Key Responsibilities :. Analyst Strategy & Program Leadership. Define and execute AvePoint's multi-year analyst relations strategy and roadmap, prioritizing engagements based on category importance, revenue impact, and competitive positioning. Build and manage a structured AR program architecture - including tiered analyst segmentation, engagement cadences, briefing frameworks, and annual planning cycles aligned to product launches, earnings, and GTM priorities. Set clear AR goals and KPIs that connect analyst engagement to business outcomes: category positioning improvement, research inclusion, analyst sentiment shifts, and GTM activation metrics. Partner with the VP, Content & Communications on AR's role in the broader Content & Communications strategy, ensuring AR intelligence informs content narrative, PR messaging, and brand positioning. Manage the AR budget including analyst firm subscriptions, advisory services, event sponsorships, and research investments. . Mar quee Research Advancement. Lead AvePoint's strategy and execution for marquee analyst evaluations - Gartner Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves, IDC MarketScapes , and equivalent - across priority categories including data protection, data resilience, data governance, and AI-driven platforms. Personally own high-stakes evaluation submissions, coordinating cross-functional teams on positioning strategy, customer references, product demonstrations, and analyst Q&A preparation. Develop long-cycle advancement plans for each priority evaluation, identifying the specific capability gaps, messaging shifts, and analyst relationship investments needed to improve AvePoint's position over 2- 3 year evaluation cycles. Coordinate with Product Management and Product Marketing to ensure analyst feedback is translated into roadmap priorities and competitive positioning adjustments. Ensure evaluation submissions reflect AvePoint's evolving platform narrative - particularly the shift from point product to unified Confidence Platform positioning. . Analyst Relationship Building & Advocacy. Build durable, trust-based relationships with top-tier analysts at Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Canalys, Omdia , and influential boutique firms - becoming the analyst community's primary point of contact at AvePoint. Develop analyst champions who reference AvePoint proactively in research, inquiry responses, conference presentations, and client advisory sessions. Execute a structured engagement cadence including regular briefings, strategy days, advisory sessions, inquiry calls, and informal relationship-building touchpoints. Host and coordinate analyst events, advisory days, and executive roundtables that deepen analyst understanding of AvePoint's strategy, roadmap, and market traction. Ensure AvePoint's executive team is prepared and confident for analyst interactions through structured briefing prep, talking point development, and post-engagement follow-up. . Measurement, Impact & GTM Enablement. Track and report AR KPIs including: research mentions and positioning, inquiry volume and sentiment, analyst champion development, evaluation advancement, and GTM activation metrics. Produce executive-ready AR reporting that connects analyst engagement to business outcomes - not activity volume. Activate analyst validation across demand generation, sales enablement, content, and PR - including reprints, gated assets, quote integration, and campaign amplification. Partner with Sales Enablement to ensure analyst insights and research are integrated into sales motions, competitive battle cards, and customer-facing materials. Coordinate with PR and Social Media on analyst-related earned media amplification - press releases, social coverage, and event promotion tied to research milestones. . Cross-Functional Leadership & Executive Readiness. Serve as the voice of the analyst community internally - synthesizing analyst feedback and market intelligence into actionable recommendations for Product, Marketing, and Executive Leadership. Partner directly with the CEO, CTO, CPO, CMO, and CRO on executive briefing preparation, spokesperson readiness, and strategic narrative alignment for analyst interactions. Build and manage the AR team as it scales: setting standards, coaching team members, and ensuring execution quality. Collaborate with Content and Thought Leadership on research-driven content that reinforces analyst narratives - original research, executive bylines, and category POV content. Coordinate with Brand on category positioning and naming conventions that align with how analysts define and segment the market. . Required Skills & Capabilities. Analyst relations strategy leadership - proven ability to build, lead, and scale a global AR program from foundational to mature, with clear strategic planning, tiered analyst segmentation, and measurable outcomes tied to business impact. Marquee research expertise - deep, hands-on experience managing Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, and equivalent evaluation cycles - including multi-year advancement strategies, submission orchestration, and positioning under competitive pressure. Senior analyst relationship management - established , trust-based relationships with analysts at Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and adjacent firms, with a reputation for credibility, responsiveness, and strategic engagement. Executive communication and briefing - comfort preparing and advising C-level executives for high-stakes analyst interactions, with the ability to push back constructively and maintain quality standards. Cross-functional influence - proven ability to partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and executive leadership without direct authority, driving alignment through clarity, credibility, and shared outcomes. Long-cycle strategic discipline - patience and rigor to execute 2- 3 year evaluation advancement plans while delivering short-term engagement wins that maintain organizational confidence in the AR investment. People leadership - experience building, managing, and developing an AR team, setting standards, and coaching team members through complex research cycles and stakeholder dynamics. Market and competitive intelligence - deep understanding of the data protection, data governance, resilience, and AI-driven platform landscape - including competitor positioning, analyst firm dynamics, and category evolution. . Qualifications. 10-12+ years of experience in analyst relations, product marketing, or competitive intelligence - with at least 5 years in a dedicated AR leadership role. Direct, hands-on experience leading Gartner MQ, Forrester Wave, or equivalent evaluation cycles from strategy through submission and post-evaluation advancement planning. Established relationships with analysts at Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Canalys, and/or Omdia in relevant categories (data protection, backup/recovery, data governance, information security, SaaS management). Experience managing or building an AR team of 2-4 professionals. Strong executive-facing communication skills with experience preparing C-level leaders for analyst interactions. Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, data management, cybersecurity, or adjacent technology categories. Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience; MBA or advanced degree is a plus. . Benefits we offer:. Competitive market-based compensation (salary + yearly bonus). Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Unlimited PTO. . The Salary Range for this role is $220,000 - $290,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions-apply even if your expectations fall outside the range. Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice. . .
