title: Sr. Legal Counsel (Commercial)
description: About AvePoint:. Beyond Secure. AvePoint is the global leader in data security, governance, and resilience, going beyond traditional solutions to ensure a robust data foundation and enable organizations everywhere to collaborate with confidence. Over 25,000 customers worldwide rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to prepare, secure, and optimize their critical data across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other collaboration environments. AvePoint's global channel partner program includes approximately 5,000 managed service providers, value-added resellers, and systems integrators, with our solutions available in more than 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit www.avepoint.com. . At AvePoint, we are committed to investing in our people. Agility, passion and teamwork set us up to do our best work and foster a culture where you are empowered to craft your career, make an impact, and own (y)our future. Unleash the power of you!. . About the role. We're looking for a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing EMEA Legal team, based in the Netherlands. In this role, you'll be the trusted legal partner to our Sales organisation across the BeNeNord region, helping the business navigate complex deals, manage risk pragmatically, and support growth. You'll spend much of your time advising on commercial contracts and negotiations, while also providing guidance on employment-related matters in close partnership with our People team. This is a highly visible role where you'll work closely with Sales leaders and stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, Privacy, Product, Marketing and People. We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, finding practical solutions, and helping a business move forward rather than simply identifying risks. If you thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and want to be part of a collaborative team that values initiative and fresh thinking, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll be doing. Become a trusted advisor to our Sales teams, helping them structure, negotiate and close commercial agreements across the BeNeNord region. Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of customer, partner and technology agreements, including SaaS, cloud services, professional services, reseller agreements, NDAs and data processing addendums. Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Security, Privacy, Product and Delivery to move deals efficiently while balancing commercial objectives and legal risk. Provide practical, solution-oriented advice on commercial, regulatory, privacy and employment law matters. Support the People team on employee-related issues including employment documentation, investigations, performance matters, reorganisations and terminations. Help improve contracting processes, playbooks, templates and guidance that enable the business to scale effectively. Contribute to regional and global legal initiatives and collaborate closely with colleagues across the wider EMEA Legal team. What we're looking for. We're interested in speaking with lawyers who combine strong technical foundations with commercial judgement and a genuine desire to partner with the business. You'll likely bring:. 5+ years of legal experience gained in-house, at a law firm, or a combination of both. Strong experience drafting and negotiating commercial technology and SaaS agreements. Knowledge of Dutch employment law and experience supporting employee-related matters. The ability to understand business objectives, assess risk, and offer pragmatic solutions. Experience building strong relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. A proactive, collaborative and action-oriented approach. Excellent communication skills in English; Dutch language skills would be advantageous. Experience working in a technology, SaaS or international business environment. What will make you successful. You lead with confidence, influence effectively, and challenge constructively. You see yourself as a business enabler rather than the "department of no". You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. You enjoy working closely with commercial teams and helping them achieve their goals. You combine sound legal judgement with common sense and practicality. You're curious, eager to learn, and bring fresh ideas to the table. Benefits & Perks. Our Netherlands benefits package includes 30 days' annual leave, a 15% employer pension contribution, ESPP participation, additional paid wellbeing days, flexible public holidays, professional development support, home office reimbursement and discounted gym membership. . Strong consultative selling skills. Fast learner with ability to simplify complex technical concepts. Enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. title: Systems Business Analyst
description: About the Role. . As Systems Business Analyst, you will translate business needs into clear requirements, maintain system documentation and platform inventory, support UAT, and produce operational reporting that improves reliability and adoption. You will sit between business stakeholders and technical implementers, partnering closely with Marketing Operations, CRM, Analytics, Engineering, and GTM stakeholders. Success in this role requires strong business analysis skills, technical curiosity, systems thinking, and the ability to turn complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how systems work, asking questions, defining requirements, and ensuring projects are built correctly before they are released. . Key Responsibilities:. Gather and document business requirements, functional specifications, workflow maps, business processes, and success metrics. Maintain platform inventory, ownership maps, integration documentation, and data architecture documentation. Define and run UAT processes, including testing plans, acceptance criteria, defect documentation, stakeholder validation, and release readiness. Support reporting requests and operational dashboards (health, SLA, adoption, and business process performance). Partner with engineering resources on delivery planning, dependency tracking, and solution design. Collaborate with CRM, Analytics, Marketing Operations, and Development teams to ensure data structures and system workflows support business objectives. Support AI and technology initiatives through requirements gathering, process design, testing, and documentation. . Required Qualifications:. 3+ years in Systems Business Analyst, Operations Analyst, Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or related roles supporting SaaS platforms. Experience working within a mid-market or enterprise B2B SaaS organization. Strong research and documentation skills and comfort mapping workflows, business processes, system integrations, and data flows. Strong SQL skills and comfort with data validation, testing, troubleshooting, and reporting support. Advanced Excel proficiency for data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting validation. Experience coordinating UAT and stakeholder sign-off. Experience working with CRM platforms, integrated technology ecosystems, and business data models. Strong communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. . Preferred Qualifications:. Experience with MAP/CRM ecosystems. Experience supporting Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations functions. Experience documenting data architecture, integrations, and system ownership frameworks. Experience with agile delivery environments. Exposure to AI, automation, or business transformation initiatives. . Benefits we offer:. Competitive market-based compensation (salary, yearly bonus + equity). . Career progression and internal mobility opportunities across our global footprint in North America, EMEA, and APAC. . Unlimited PTO. The Salary Range for this role is $110,000 - $130,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions-apply even if your expectations fall outside the range. Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience. . Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities. . Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems. . Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis. . Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks. . . Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization. . . What Success Looks Like. . The Opportunity. PTC is at an inflection point. We're kicking off one of the most significant transformation initiatives in the company's history: a full-scale rationalization of our technology vendor and sourcing ecosystem. This isn't a "nice to have" project buried in procurement - it has direct sponsorship from our executive leadership team, who are actively clearing the path across the business to make it happen.. We're looking for a Vice President, Global Procurement who has done this before - not supported it, not advised on it, led it. Someone who has sat in the driver's seat of an enterprise-wide technology and vendor consolidation, negotiated the big, complex, multi-year tech agreements (think Microsoft, Oracle, Workday-scale), and knows how to navigate the shift from legacy licensing to consumption-based commercial models. If you've delivered this kind of transformation elsewhere and are ready for a new one, this is the seat.. What You'll Do. Develop and execute a global sourcing and procurement strategy aligned to corporate objectives, including a multi-year roadmap for vendor and technology rationalization that drives significant, measurable cost savings. Lead executive-level negotiations on high-value contracts and critical vendor agreements, building escalation strategies that get results. Build out a formal RFP strategy and process for large-spend negotiations. Lead, develop, and help shape the structure of a high-performing global procurement team spanning the US, India, Romania, Brazil, and Europe. title: Cloud Governance Engineer
description: . Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. . This is a governance role, not a build-and-operate role. You will spend your time defining the rules our cloud estate runs by, making those rules enforceable in code, and proving they are working. You will write standards that other engineering teams have to follow, and you will be the person who explains to Finance, Security, and Product leadership why a given risk matters and what it will cost to fix or ignore. If what you want is to build and run infrastructure, this is not the right seat. If you want to own how a multi-cloud estate is governed, it is.. About our estate: roughly 70% Google Cloud, with AWS and Azure in scope as secondary platforms. GCP is where the majority of the work sits, so hands-on GCP experience is a hard requirement rather than a preference.. Key Responsibilities. Define, document, and maintain cloud governance policies and standards across GCP, AWS, and Azure, and turn them into enforceable technical controls using GCP Organization Policy, AWS SCPs and Config, and Azure Policy. Own the exception and waiver process end to end: intake, risk assessment, time-bound approval, expiry, and follow-up. Partner with Security to enforce Identity and Access Management and network security standards across the organization, and review access models for least privilege. Build and maintain dashboards that track governance metrics: security posture, key and credential rotation, policy violations, configuration drift, and time to remediation. Own resource labeling and tagging standards and enforce them, so that cost, ownership, and environment can be attributed reliably. Drive cost governance: spend visibility and showback, anomaly detection, commitment and discount coverage reviews, and surfacing waste to the teams that own it. Collaborate with IT, Finance, Security, DevOps, Cloud Architects, and Product Engineering to keep governance controls consistent across all environments, and translate technical risk into language those stakeholders can act on. Work with stakeholders to define service level objectives, key performance indicators, and metrics for operational efficiency. Support the review of new third-party cloud services before they enter the estate. Requirements. 4+ years working in public cloud environments, including at least 2 years hands-on with GCP. Hands-on experience implementing preventative guardrails in at least one hyperscaler (GCP Organization Policy, AWS SCPs or Config, Azure Policy). You should be able to walk us through a policy you rolled out, what it broke, and how you handled the fallout. Experience authoring a cloud policy or standard that other teams were required to follow, not only implementing one written elsewhere. Experience running or contributing to an exception or waiver process for cloud controls. Working knowledge of cloud IAM, network security, encryption, and key and secret management. Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, and comfort extending it to policy-as-code. Python for automation, enforcement, and reporting. Demonstrated ability to explain a technical risk to a non-technical audience and drive a decision. This is a core part of the job and we will test it during the interview process. Preferred Qualifications. Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification. Policy-as-code tooling: OPA, Conftest, Sentinel. Cloud cost tooling: GCP billing exports and BigQuery, AWS Cost Explorer, or a third-party platform such as Cloudability or Apptio. Familiarity with the control frameworks our platform is audited against (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR). You will not own audits in this role, but context helps you prioritize. Kubernetes governance and policy enforcement. Okta integration, Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another relevant technical field. Result oriented, self-starter. Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside outside Porto, Maia, Matosinhos, Gondomar, Valongo e Vila Nova de Gaia. Candidates who reside within those municipalities would be required to work in-office 3 days a week. . Benefits:. Five9 Equity Programs. Bonus Scheme. 10% Flex Benefit. Meal Allowance. Medical Insurance. Life Insurance. 25 day Annual Leave + Public Holidays. Establish the operating rhythm with the Partner organization - joint planning, regular business reviews, and a shared view of what is and is not creating incremental value. Build, develop, and lead the global partner marketing team - and the cross-functional relationships the role depends on across the regional Demand Generation teams, the Events team, Product Marketing, and the Partner organization. Demonstrated experience across more than one partner type - channel (SIs and resellers), technology partners (ISVs), and strategic alliances or hyperscalers. Manage paid search channels (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), working closely with agency partners to optimize programs, improve cost efficiency, and generate quality pipeline. Partner with campaign and creative teams to develop and test ad copy and creative that's engaging, conversion-focused, and resonates with our ideal customer profile (ICP). Manage relationships with external agencies and vendors, setting clear goals, reviewing performance, and holding partners accountable to results. Use AI tools to automate reporting, campaign builds, and testing analysis, freeing the team to spend more time on strategy and experimentation. Partner closely with ABM and sales development to align paid programs with target account strategies, accelerate lead-to-opportunity conversion, and hit shared pipeline goals. Analyze full-funnel paid media and test performance - from clicks and leads to sales opportunities and pipeline - turning results into a prioritized testing and optimization backlog. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results.. Role Overview. To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. In this role you will:. Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics. Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design. Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale. Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments. Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers. Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues. Key Responsibilities. Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure. Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash. Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico. Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia). Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes. Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment. Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e.g., NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization. Qualifications & Skills. 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC). Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM). Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico. Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale. Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet). Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS). Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing. CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays. Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes. Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics. Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives. Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results.. Role Overview. To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting. In this role you will:. Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics. Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design. Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale. Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments. Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers. Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues. Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure. Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash. Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico. Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia). Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes. Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment. Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e.g., NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization. Qualifications & Skills. 5+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC). Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM). Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico. Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale. Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet). Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS). Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing. CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays. Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes. Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics. description: . Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide.. Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.. We are seeking a Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer to join our Business Technology team. This role leads the design, implementation, and administration of Ironclad as Five9's contract lifecycle management platform and serves as the technical lead for replacing DocuSign CLM with Ironclad. You will architect the target-state solution, build and maintain the Workflow Designer workflows, templates, and clause libraries used to generate, route, negotiate, and execute Five9's customer agreements, and guide the migration of existing templates, workflows, and executed agreements from DocuSign CLM.. The ideal candidate is a senior business systems professional with seven or more years of experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years configuring Ironclad in production. The candidate holds the Ironclad Core Administration Certification and, ideally, has completed Ironclad's Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation), with prior experience leading a CLM migration or platform replacement strongly preferred.. The position is a hybrid role combining in-office and work-from-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.. Key Responsibilities. Lead the solution design and implementation of Ironclad CLM, defining the target-state architecture for contract intake, generation, review, negotiation, approval, signature, repository, and reporting, and serving as the subject matter expert for Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance. Own the replacement of DocuSign CLM with Ironclad, including migration strategy and roadmap, template and workflow inventory and rationalization, repository and metadata migration of executed agreements, parallel run, cutover, in-flight agreement handling, and decommissioning of legacy DocuSign CLM components. Design, build, and maintain Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, signature routing, and exception handling. Create and maintain commercial document templates and clause libraries - including Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, and renewals - using legal language and clauses approved by the Legal team, with conditional content based on product, pricing, transaction type, and geography. Administer and configure the Ironclad platform, including users, groups, roles and permissions, SSO and provisioning, repository structure, metadata and record types, and environment and release management. Design and maintain the integrations between Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, including Workflow Sync and Record Sync, field mappings, and generation of service orders from CPQ quotes and quote lines, ensuring contract status and executed agreements are accurately returned to Salesforce. Define the electronic signature approach for the future state, including Ironclad Signature and any external eSignature provider retained during or after the transition, and manage the related configuration and signature coordination. Use the Ironclad API and webhooks to build custom integrations, automations, and data migration tooling with other Five9 systems as required. Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT to translate business and legal requirements into scalable solutions, and lead change management, documentation, user training, and adoption. Troubleshoot workflow, document generation, data mapping, integration, and signature issues, and drive them to resolution. Establish administration standards, governance, and best practices, and mentor team members and partner consultants on Ironclad configuration and design. Identify opportunities to simplify contract processes, reduce manual effort, and accelerate contract execution, and track outcomes through Ironclad reporting and analytics. Key Requirements. Required Qualifications:. Seven or more years of business systems experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years of hands-on Ironclad configuration in production. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ironclad Core Administration Certification required. Completion of the Ironclad Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation) strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience leading a CLM implementation or migration, ideally replacing DocuSign CLM or a comparable platform, including template and workflow rationalization, repository and metadata migration, and cutover planning. Advanced hands-on experience designing and building Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, and exception handling. Experience building and maintaining commercial document templates (e.g., Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, renewals) and clause libraries using legal language approved by the Legal team. Experience designing and supporting Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ integrations with a CLM platform, including generating documents from quotes and quote lines and syncing contract data and status back to Salesforce (Account, Opportunity, Quote, Quote Line, Product, Contract). Experience with the Ironclad API, webhooks, and integration patterns, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, basic JavaScript, and SQL. Working knowledge of electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign eSignature and Ironclad Signature, covering templates, recipients, signing order, and authentication. Basic Salesforce administrator-level knowledge (objects, fields, relationships, and permission sets) and familiarity with the Salesforce CPQ data model and document generation process. Proficiency with Microsoft Word template formatting, including tables, styles, sections, headers, and conditional content. Strong solution design, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to lead initiatives independently, influence stakeholders across Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT, and work across a distributed, global team. Preferred Qualifications:. Salesforce Certified Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification is a plus. Prior experience with DocuSign CLM and DocuSign eSignature administration, which helps with migration scoping, is a plus. Experience with project delivery methodologies, enterprise change management, and mentoring or leading consultants is a plus. Why You'll Love This Role:. You will lead the move to Ironclad and play a central role in shaping how Five9 generates, negotiates, and executes customer contracts at scale. You will partner closely with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance, gaining broad visibility into the commercial contracting process. You will work at the intersection of Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, solving practical, cross-system problems that directly impact deal velocity. If you enjoy simplifying complex processes, setting technical direction, and building reliable, well-documented systems, this role offers a strong opportunity to grow as a CLM architect. Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week. title: Vice President, Data Science
description: . Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. As Vice President of Data Science, you will lead and grow our in-house data science team. This team is responsible for research, experimentation, data collection and curation, and data analysis that contributes to the performance of Five9's AI products. Tasks include evaluation of and selection of AI agent architectural frameworks, evaluation and comparison of LLM models across commercial and open source choices, model fine-tuning for dedicated tasks, prompt engineering, prompt structure and design, and composite model definitions and evaluations. The scale of Five9 provides a wealth of data that data science team has access to. The data science team is very much applied - their work directly makes its way into real products providing direct customer benefit. As lead of this team, you will take complete ownership of the technical and operational direction of the organization, including growing to team to meet increased demand for its capabilities. Key Responsibilities:. Technical Direction Setting: As an expert in the leading edge of AI and data science, you will direct the team on the methodologies, practices, algorithms, experiments and processes they perfo rm. Hands On: You are expected to also be hands on, not just a manger, and be directly responsible for some amount of the technical work in addition to directing the team. Organizational Growth: You will be tasked with growing the team, and ensuring we have the right talent to accomplish our goals. Collaborator and Spokesperson: You will act as an internal and external spokesperson for data science, and collaborate with stakeholders across the company. Internally, you will be expected to meet with product managers, executives and estaff, and be able to converse effectively with them. You will also occasionally meet with customers to understand how Five9 products, and the data science behind them, impacts the customers. You are expected to participate in industry activities, including publication of blog posts and papers, along with participation in AI conferences. Technical Expertise:. 12+ years experience in data science or AI applied research, ideally at a best-in-class applied research organization. Deep Expertise in Modern AI/ML. Extensive hands-on experience with LLMs, agentic architectures, retrieval-augmented systems, transformers, and composite model pipelines. Strong understanding of commercial and open-source model ecosystems (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral), including evaluation, benchmarking, and tradeoff analysis. Model Development & Optimization. Proven ability to perform fine-tuning, supervised/unsupervised training, prompt engineering, prompt optimization, and model orchestration for real-world use cases. Experience designing evaluation frameworks, experiment methodologies, and robust model comparison workflows. Data Engineering & Curation. Expertise in large-scale data collection, labeling, cleaning, and curation pipelines, preferably with conversational or unstructured text data. Familiarity with tools and techniques for data quality assessment, dataset versioning, and data governance. Applied Data Science & Analytics. Strong proficiency in statistical analysis, A/B experimentation, causal inference, and performance measurement. Demonstrated success turning data insights into product improvements that drive measurable business outcomes. Software Development & Systems Thinking. Ability to work with engineering teams using modern software practices (Python, data platforms, cloud-native environments, APIs, ML Ops tooling). Understanding of production ML systems, deployment patterns, monitoring, and safety/guardrail design. People & Collaboration Skills:. Cross-Functional Partnering. Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, engineering leaders, UX, and GTM teams to translate business needs into data science strategies. Adept at explaining complex technical concepts to executives, customers, and non-technical stakeholders. Communication & Storytelling. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including ability to publish thought leadership (papers, blog posts) and present at conferences. Team Development & Mentorship. Passion for mentoring senior and junior data scientists, fostering technical excellence, and building a culture of experimentation and rigorous thinking. Customer Empathy. Experience engaging directly with customers to understand their needs, gather feedback, and translate insights into product or model improvements. Leadership & Strategic Skills:. Vision Setting & Direction. Ability to define the data science strategy for AI Agents and customer experience products, aligning with corporate priorities and market opportunities. title: VP, Demand Generation
description: . Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. . Growth at Five9 depends on a demand engine that works across regions, segments, partners, and the installed base - and on a marketing organization willing to own the outcome all the way through to a qualified conversation with a buyer, not just the click that started it. That is where this role comes in.. . Position. We are looking for a Vice President of Demand Generation to build and run the pipeline engine for Five9. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this leader owns global campaign strategy, account-based marketing, partner marketing, customer marketing, the full events portfolio, and the sales development organization that converts the demand those programs create. The role is measured on the whole path: response, qualification, opportunity, and pipeline that Sales is willing to forecast. This leader will partner with the Chief Sales Officer, the regional and segment sales leaders, the Partner organization, and the teams they lead. The right candidate is not a channel specialist who has spent a career optimizing paid media, and not a program manager who runs the calendar while someone else carries the number. This is closer to a general manager of demand - a leader who can set global strategy, run several teams with different rhythms and different definitions of success, and stand behind a pipeline commitment to the Sales organization every quarter. Five9 sells AI for customer experience, and we hold ourselves to the same standard we set for our customers. We expect this leader to apply AI across the demand engine - audience selection and prioritization, creative production and localization, campaign operations, sales development research and outreach, and the measurement loop that connects spend to pipeline to bookings. Key Responsibilities. Campaign Strategy and Integrated Demand. Own the global campaign strategy - the themes, the calendar, the channel mix, and the offer architecture that carry buyers from first awareness to a sales conversation. Set and deliver pipeline targets by region, segment, and industry , building the plans and the budget allocation that make those targets credible before the quarter starts. Build for international markets on their own terms - regional channel mix, language, local buying behavior, and the sales motions that follow. Own the demand budget end to end , with the discipline to move it toward the programs producing pipeline. Account-Based Marketing. Build and run the ABM motion for strategic and named enterprise accounts - account selection and tiering, buying-group mapping, orchestration, and creative built for a specific account. Pair ABM programs with matched sales development coverage so account engagement is followed by a human within the window it matters. Apply intent, engagement, and firmographic signal to prioritize where the team spends its time and where Sales spends theirs. Measure ABM on account progression and opportunity creation , using the metrics Sales recognizes. Sales Development. Lead inbound and outbound sales development globally , including coverage models, capacity planning, territory alignment, and quota setting in partnership with Sales and Finance. Own speed to lead and qualification standards jointly with Sales leadership , including a shared definition of a qualified opportunity. Keep campaign messaging and outbound sequences in lockstep so what a buyer reads and what a rep says are the same argument. Make sales development a talent pipeline for Five9 , with a development path into sales, marketing, and customer-facing roles. Partner and Customer Marketing. Own partner marketing across the ecosystem - resellers, distributors, systems integrators, and technology alliances - in partnership with the Partner organization and the leaders who run it. Build co-marketing programs that produce partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline , managing MDF and joint investment with discipline. Drive expansion demand into the installed base , in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Marketing. Build the advocacy and reference engine - customer stories, references, speakers, and communities that carry more weight with buyers than anything Five9 says about itself. Events. Own the global events portfolio - company events, industry tradeshows, partner events, executive roundtables, and regional field programs. Treat every event as a campaign - pre-show targeting, on-site engagement, and follow-up that is staffed and sequenced before the event opens. Set the selection criteria for the event calendar with input from the Sales organization , and measure each investment on pipeline and cost per opportunity. Team and Organizational Leadership. Lead a global organization across several teams , and build the shared cadence, forecast discipline, and reporting that hold them together. Hire, develop, and retain leaders , and create a function that strong marketers and sales development professionals want to join and stay in. Partner across Marketing - Product Marketing, Brand and Communications, Marketing Operations, and Analytics - so campaigns are built on the right positioning and measured on the right data. Represent the demand engine to the executive team with a clear account of what is working and what changes next. Candidate Requirements and Experience. 15+ years of marketing experience, with at least 8 years leading demand generation in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. Experience running demand across both Americas and international markets, with a working understanding of how buying behavior, channel mix, and sales motions differ by region. Experience leading a sales development organization, or running demand in close partnership with one where SDR performance was part of the marketing number. Proven experience designing and scaling ABM programs for enterprise accounts in close partnership with Sales. Partner or channel marketing experience is highly recommended, including co-marketing programs and MDF management. Experience owning an events portfolio at scale, including at least one large owned customer or user conference. Customer marketing or installed-base demand experience is highly recommended. Expert command of funnel metrics, attribution, campaign ROI, and budget allocation - and the credibility to defend those numbers in front of Sales and Finance. Strong hands-on familiarity with the modern demand stack: CRM, marketing automation, ABM and intent platforms, sales engagement tooling, and BI reporting. Hands-on proficiency with modern AI tools and a clear point of view on how they apply to demand generation - campaign creation, audience selection, localization, outbound research, and team productivity. Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred. About You. You are comfortable being accountable to targets. You would rather commit to a pipeline number and be measured against it than be evaluated on activity. You lead breadth well. You can move from an ABM account review to an SDR pipeline call to an event budget conversation in the same morning and add something useful in each. You are direct about what is not working, and you say so plainly rather than letting a program run out the year. You build strong partnerships with Sales. You are in their forecast calls, you know their territories, and you are treated as part of the revenue team rather than as a supplier to it. You hire well and develop people generously, and you have a track record of promoting leaders out of your organization. You are genuinely curious about AI and have already woven it into how you and your teams work - not as a talking point, but as a tool that changes what is possible.. . title: Electrical & Controls/Automation Engineer
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. . A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary. . Job Summary. 

 Position Summary. The Electrical & Controls/Automation Engineer is an individual contributor and technical subject matter expert responsible for providing enterprise-level technical leadership across electrical, controls, industrial networking, PLC, SCADA, and automation systems. This position serves as one of Engineering's highest technical authorities for complex automation and electrical systems. The Electrical & Controls/Automation Engineer is expected to personally solve the organization's most difficult technical problems while establishing technical standards, mentoring engineering and technician resources, and improving the reliability, maintainability, and performance of automated manufacturing equipment.. Travel Requirement: NONE. Key Responsibilities:. Technical Leadership & Troubleshooting. Serve as technical escalation point for complex electrical, controls, PLC, SCADA, networking, and automation issues across manufacturing operations. Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of difficult or recurring equipment failures that cannot be resolved through normal maintenance and engineering escalation paths. Diagnose complex interactions between electrical systems, PLC logic, industrial networks, drives, motion systems, instrumentation, safety systems, SCADA, and equipment controls. Use a structured, data-driven troubleshooting methodology to identify root causes rather than relying on component replacement or trial-and-error troubleshooting. Provide hands-on technical support during critical equipment failures and high-impact production events. Identify systemic technical weaknesses and develop permanent corrective actions that improve equipment reliability and reduce repeat failures.. PLC & Controls Systems. Serve as a technical resource for industrial electrical systems and machine-control hardware. Troubleshoot complex electrical problems involving control power, power distribution, motors, VFDs, servo systems, safety circuits, sensors, instrumentation, grounding, noise, and communication systems. Troubleshoot, modify, optimize, and validate complex PLC programs and machine-control architectures.. Industrial Networking. Serve as a technical authority for industrial networking and OT communications. Troubleshoot complex network and communication failures involving PLCs, SCADA systems, HMIs, drives, remote I/O, vision systems, instrumentation, servers, and manufacturing equipment. Demonstrate expert-level understanding of Ethernet/IP, industrial Ethernet, TCP/IP, VLANs, managed switches, network segmentation, routing fundamentals, addressing, communication diagnostics, and industrial network architecture. Work collaboratively with IT and cybersecurity teams to maintain secure, reliable connectivity between operational technology and enterprise systems.. SCADA, HMI & Manufacturing Systems. Provide technical leadership for SCADA and HMI architecture, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration. Troubleshoot communication and data-flow issues between equipment controls, SCADA, historians, databases, and manufacturing information systems. Support development of standardized approaches for equipment connectivity, tag structures, alarms, data collection, and system integration. Partner with Digital Transformation and Manufacturing Intelligence resources to enable reliable acquisition and use of equipment data.. Reliability & Root Cause Engineering. Partner with Reliability Engineering and factory engineering teams to identify recurring failure modes using downtime, alarm, maintenance, and equipment-performance data. Develop engineered solutions that eliminate failure modes rather than repeatedly restoring equipment to operation. Identify opportunities for condition monitoring, predictive diagnostics, improved alarming, and automated fault detection.. Technical Mentorship. Serve as a technical mentor to Controls Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Controls Technicians, Engineering Technicians, and other engineering resources. Develop the troubleshooting capabilities of plant engineering teams through structured coaching and hands-on problem solving. Transfer knowledge from complex troubleshooting events into documented standards, troubleshooting guides, and lessons learned. Help establish technical competency expectations and training requirements for controls and electrical disciplines. Promote disciplined engineering practices and a culture of technical excellence.. Qualifications:. Education. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls or Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or mechanical Engineering with demonstrated competencies strongly preferred. Equivalent combination of education and extensive demonstrated industrial controls expertise may be considered. Experience. Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, electrical engineering, or related manufacturing engineering disciplines. Extensive hands-on experience supporting highly automated manufacturing equipment. Demonstrated history of personally resolving complex controls, electrical, networking, and automation problems. Experience serving as a technical authority, Staff Engineer, or equivalent technical SME strongly preferred. Experience in high-volume, highly automated manufacturing environments such as medical device, electronics, pharmaceutical, automotive, packaging, or food & beverage manufacturing preferred.. Preferred Technical Experience:. Experience with the following is highly desirable:. Rockwell, Siemens and Beckhoff controls platforms. Industrial Ethernet and Ethernet/IP. Industrial network architecture and troubleshooting. Grafana and Power BI visualization platforms. VMware or virtualized automation infrastructure. Vision systems. Robotics. Advanced motion and servo systems. Manufacturing historians and data acquisition (SQL and industrial data architecture). Machine safety circuits and safety PLC concepts. Electrical troubleshooting, schematics and machine-control systems. VFDs, motors, and motor-control systems. Automation-system backup, recovery, and lifecycle management. Integration of PLC/OT systems with higher-level manufacturing systems. Leadership Expectations:. The Electrical & Controls/Automation Engineer is expected to demonstrate significant technical leadership and must be capable of entering a difficult manufacturing situation, rapidly understanding the system, bring technical resources together, establish a logical troubleshooting strategy, and drive the team toward root cause and permanent resolution. The Electrical & Controls/Automation Engineer should be recognized throughout the entire Engineering organization as a trusted technical authority-someone engineers and technicians seek out when conventional troubleshooting has failed. Just as importantly, the Electrical & Controls/Automation Engineer must develop the capabilities of others. The objective is not to become the person who fixes every problem, but to raise the technical capability of the entire Engineering organization while personally leading resolution of its most difficult problems.. JT05. AA01. MS14. CC11. . What you'll receive for the great work you provide:. Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans. Life Insurance. Short-term and Long-term Disability. Reporting to the Finance Director the Sr Controller will be responsible for the total finance and accounting function of a site(s), lead and manage the finance team to ensure accounting and financial processes and procedures are in accordance with corporate and legislative requirements. This position is an integral member of the management team, acting as a critical business partner to the General Manager. What a typical day looks like:. . Proactively drive actions to improve profitability, cashflow and long-term performance. description:

 To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we're looking to add a n Associate Production Supervisor located in Milpitas, CA. . . Reporting to the manager the potential candidate would be in charge of directing the manufacturing operations performed in a shift or group of production lines, ensuring they reach volume, quality and cost goals. . Shift Hours: 6 am PST - 2 pm PST (Monday - Friday). . . What a typical day looks like:. . Leads the production of several processes/lines in a highly technical environment and responsible for the line's success. . Evaluates daily/regularly plant operating performance and advises on changes in operating conditions that will improve efficiencies and quality. . Lead a team of individual professionals (e.g., engineers/officers) to meet quality, cost, delivery and responsiveness requirements. . Troubleshoot and analyze operational problems and advise on their resolution. Guide regular discussions with operators to coach performance and improve operational understanding and capability. . Solicits and evaluates ideas for plant improvements and collaborates with qualified engineers to develop project proposals. . . Provides technical and operational advice to project teams. . May act as principal interface between the operation team and the maintenance function. . Engage in training and coaching of junior operators. . Prioritizes production schedules based on product introduction, equipment efficiency, and materials supply in order to meet customer requirements. . Initiate and participate in process development and cost improvement projects. . Assist in department budget planning and management of department expenses. . Maintains safe and clean work environment by educating and directing individuals on the use of all control points, equipment, and resources; maintaining compliance with established policies and procedures. . Ensures compliance to manufacturing standards. . . The experience we're looking to add to our team:. . . Typically requires a bachelor degree or equivalent experience in addition to 3 + year of operations experience. . Demonstrates operations and technical skills and understanding of Flex functional standards. Demonstrates a general knowledge of functional concepts and a rudimentary understanding of Flex policies and procedures. Has awareness of the functional impact upon work processes and other functions. Ability to operate telephones, data entry, office software including, word processing, spreadsheets, presentation packages and data base systems. . Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients and customers. . Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. . Ability to define and solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to collect data, establish facts, interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form, and draw valid conclusions. . . Scope / Impact. . Impacts the immediate (daily or weekly) operational success of the function. Executes and may provide input to functional processes or technologies. Assist in achieving section/sub-function objectives for a functional area. Carries out functional initiatives. . . Decision Making / Discretion. . Facilitates team in making group decisions. Approves and/or Makes decisions for sections/sub-functions. Decisions may affect sections/sub-functions. . . Supervision / Leadership. . Closely supervised; normally receives detailed instructions on all work. Identifies own development needs and works toward them. Supports Flex values. . . Work Environment:. . The employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts, work that requires repetitive motion, toxic or caustic chemicals, and risk of electrical shock. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. . . Physical Demands : Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. . While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand and walk. The employee is occasionally required to sit, handle small components, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job includes close vision. . description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. . A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary. . Job Summary. Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, Axiom, with the spin planned for Q1 2027. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support Axiom, a company focused on critical digital infrastructure and delivering end-to-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission-critical applications.

 To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we're looking to add a Site Installation Technician in Dallas, TX.. Reporting to the Field Install Supervisor, the Site Installation Technician, is responsible for working in the field to install our pre-fabricated enclosure buildings using an array of tools and equipment.. Please Note: This position will require 90% of overnight travel across the United States via company vehicle and/or airplane. Must have valid identification for air travel in accordance with TSA regulations. . Shift Schedule (while not travelling): Monday - Friday, 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM. What a typical day looks like:. Review, analyze, and follow various blueprints, diagrams, drawing, procedures, and work instructions to complete assemblies for enclosure buildings. Assemble and install electrical components including panel boards, HVAC units, battery systems, electrical devices, and bending conduit. Uses various power tools and hand tools (ex. Drills, impacts, screwdrivers, grinders, etc.) to accomplish assigned tasks. Conduct quality assurance checks to confirm that assembled products meet specifications and quality standards. Identify any product defects; record and report them accordingly. Monitor and maintain inventory of necessary product for each job. Interfaces with project management, clients and site personnel. Maintain a clean and safe work area. Perform all other duties as assigned. The experience we're looking to add to our team:. High school diploma or equivalent required. Experience in wiring and installing electrical control/relay panels or mechanical assembly. Experience working with a manufacturing or construction environment preferred. OSHA 10 Construction Certification preferred or must be obtained within the first 30 days of employment. Current Driver's License and ability to pass an MVR to operate company vehicles. Strong attention to detail and ability to perform work accurately. Knowledge of manufacturing, equipment maintenance, and safety management. Reading comprehension skills with the ability to interpret and follow written directions, blueprints, and engineering diagrams. Basic math skills to meet technical specifications and measurements. Basic understanding of tools (ex. Tape measure, impact drill, etc.). Ability to maintain a tactful, orderly working relationship with others.. What the physical requirements are :. Must be able to traverse all areas of jobsite in all types of weather; this may include walking, climbing, reaching, bending, crawling, or stretching. Prolonged periods of standing and performing repetitive tasks. Must be able to lift up to 35 pounds at a time. Must have manual dexterity in order to assemble products or machines as directed. Must have excellent hand-eye coordination. Ability to differentiate between colored wires, tabs, and electronic components. Must wear PPE, such as gloves, safety glasses, hard hat, and ear protection, while working on the production floor and at job sites. What you'll receive for the great work you provide:. Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans. Life Insurance. Short-term and Long-term Disability. Matching 401(k) Contributions. Vacation and Paid Sick Time. Tuition Reimbursement.

Reporting to the Quality Manager the Quality / Calibration Technician role in charge of performing product inspection and/or audits of quality control programs, first article inspections and calibration, inspecting flat blank layouts, out of box audit (OBA) and sampling and testing of incoming components and raw materials. Purge material. Ensures raw materials, in process and finished products meet company standards. General documentations updated (Quality alerts).. What a typical day looks like:. . Responsibilities:. Audits processes, tests and inspects products and/or develops, compiles and evaluates statistical data to define and maintain quality and reliability of products. Working from engineering drawings, specifications, schematics, diagrams, written descriptions, layouts or defined plans to perform complex engineering testing, checkout, First Article Inspection, root cause research, internal corrective actions and supplier correction actions. Interprets engineering drawings, schematic diagrams or formulas and confers with management or engineering staff to define quality and reliability standards. Selects processes to be audited from primarily the manufacturing areas and checks for a variety of features, including ESD (electro-static discharge) and handling practices, documentation, training and process integrity. Selects products for audits at specified stages in the production or post-production process, and tests products for variety of qualities such as dimensions, performance and mechanical, electrical or cosmetic characteristics. Records audit data, applying statistical quality control procedures. Evaluates data and writes reports to validate or indicate deviations from existing standards. Recommends modifications of existing quality or production standards, programs or reports to achieve optimum quality within limits of equipment capability. Perform calibration on inspection tools e.g. micrometers, calipers height gages etc. Maintain gage track program, print list of gages due for calibration in the beginning of each month and follow up with calibration. Send gages out for calibration, maintain calibration records. Prepares graphs or charts of data or enters data into computer for research data. Download quality information from quality system to be used for QA reports. Research for engineering test results and implements process changes to resolve problems. Performs out of box audits (OBA) as required. Provides factory hold up to identify and resolve issues associated with purchased parts, materials and manufacturing. May be required to perform receiving inspection. Review at the beginning of the shift the Quality Auditors assistance and validated the Check List. Scrap disposition at MRB in less than 24 hours. Assure that the Customer implementation activities are in place. Meet the SSYMA requirements (boats, goggles, gloves, ear plugs). Review the SPC data and confirm the actions are effective. Experience with machine offsets, tooling selection, speeds and feeds, and basic CNC program editing. . Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. . Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies. . Computer proficiency and ability to accurately complete production and quality documentation. . Your Skills & Experience :. Since this role sits directly at the intersection of payroll delivery and global process optimization, it requires an elevated transformation skillset. description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . The Team and Role:. You will have a broad, dynamic remit overseeing global cash management, FX exposure, credit rating agency administration, equity/stock administration interface, and corporate risk insurance.. Cross-Functional Influence: The ability to move out of the Treasury silo and speak the language of Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, and HR to align financial strategy with business realities. Proven track record of managing multi-currency cash flows and corporate hedging programs in a multinational corporation. Experience managing or supporting corporate insurance renewals and broker relationships. Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to present complex financial concepts clearly to non-treasury executives.. Education:. description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . The Role:. (3) Compliance, making sure systems are set up inline with Logitech IT security standards, data privacy governance and inline with international standards such as ISO or SOCII. . The ideal candidate has a strong background in Lenel OnGuard electronic access control and Milestone XProtect video management, paired with practical experience writing SQL queries against system databases and working with REST APIs to move data between platforms. Data Exchange / SQL View Maintenance. . Support in conjunction with the Global Security Operations team in Milestone XProtect maintenance, including camera onboarding, recording servers, retention and storage policies. Support in conjunction with the Global Security Operations team on device onboarding, firmware and software updates, and lifecycle management for controllers, readers, cameras, encoders, and associated security hardware. Monitor operational security systems for errors, alerts, and overall system health, proactively resolving issues before they affect end users. Support IP network configuration and connectivity troubleshooting for security devices, including multicast, bandwidth management, and video stream optimisation. Ensure security platforms integrate cleanly with IT-managed infrastructure, directory services, and cloud-hosted platforms. Maintain and update technical documentation, including system diagrams, configuration standards, troubleshooting steps, and support playbooks. Prepare and manage system updates, meeting best practices for downtime and redundancy. . Focus Area 2: Data, Reporting, Automation & Integration. Write and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures against OnGuard and XProtect databases to support operational and management reporting. Build and maintain dashboards and scheduled reports covering access activity, alarm volumes, device availability, badge and cardholder data quality, and system health metrics. Develop integrations using platform APIs and SDKs (OpenAccess, DataConduIT, Milestone MIP/REST) to connect security systems with HR, identity, ticketing, workplace, and business intelligence platforms. Automate recurring administrative tasks such as cardholder provisioning and deprovisioning, access level assignment, audit exports, and system reconciliation between source-of-truth systems. Design and support automated workflows that reduce manual effort for operators and site teams, including alarm enrichment, event-driven notifications, and ticket creation. Establish and maintain data quality controls, reconciliation routines, and audit-ready reporting to support compliance and internal review requirements. Serve as the main point of contact for reports, ensuring compliance with privacy and legal requirements are met for all outbound requests. Evaluate and pilot new tooling, scripts, and integration approaches, documenting use cases and demonstrating capability to internal stakeholders. . Focus Area 3: Compliance and governance. Make compliance part of every day workflows. Tracks potential issues with mitigating actions to demonstrate ongoing compliance. Supports continuous improvement to enhance the work environment. Use technology to help Logitec adapt to changing regulations and evolving risks. Support the H&S team across the organisation to prevent accidents. Gatekeep and maintain resilient standardised processes, documentation, and audits. Streamline integrations, which supports collaboration and data-driven decision making. . Cross-Functional & Project Responsibilities. . Act as the technical liaison between Workplace Digital, IT, security operations, and site leadership, ensuring consistent system performance and clear escalation paths. Participate in incident response workflows, troubleshooting and escalating security system issues that impact operations. Manage overarching security technology projects, such as platform upgrades, camera and reader refreshes, integration rollouts, new ventures and reporting initiatives. Work with integrators, vendors, and internal teams to scope, deliver, and validate technology changes on schedule. Support project stakeholders by ensuring access control and video systems not only meet standards, but continue to push business interests forward and are installed and configured properly across all locations; with a set audit trail and maintenance schedule preplanned. . Key Qualifications:. For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:. . At least 4 years of verifiable hands-on experience administering Lenel OnGuard and Milestone XProtect in an enterprise environment. Working SQL proficiency, including joins, aggregation, and query optimisation against production databases. Experience consuming and building against REST APIs or platform SDKs. Basic understanding of IP networking as it applies to security devices and video transport. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Must be able to work with and protect highly confidential information. Experience managing data request workflows & proper data sanitization strategies. Strong knowledge of ISO 27001 Controls and Risk Management Framework. Experience with OSHA framework and processes. . In addition, preferable skills and behaviors include:. . Scripting experience (PowerShell, Python) for automation and data handling. Experience with a BI or reporting tool (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). Familiarity with identity and HR systems as sources of truth for access provisioning. Experience directly integrating HR systems as a custom solution is a major plus. . Manufacturer certifications in OnGuard and/or XProtect. Experience supporting a 24/7 operational environment. Excellent organization, analytical, and communication skills. Rapport and influence building skills. Excellent customer service. Ability to learn quickly and to multitask; be adaptable and flexible. Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment, while paying strict attention to detail. Ability to adhere to timelines and deadlines with effective time management skills. Strong decision-making ability during emergencies. Demonstrated ability to drive organizational change, change management. Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional and cross-regional teams to drive collaboration and strategic outcomes for business. Who We're Looking For:. Willing and eager to learn new technologies and adapt to current workplace platforms. Comfortable working with others, sharing ideas, and asking questions when needed. Comfortable working across timezones. Motivated to contribute positively-no previous specialist experience needed, just a desire to learn and grow!. . . Location:. This position will be based out of Dallas, Texas area working hybrid out of our Dallas office, Only candidates who are able to work from Dallas Office location will be given preference for this role..
