title: Lead, Inbound Destination Operations (Dallas)
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . Position Summary. We are seeking an experienced Lead, Inbound Destination Operations based in our Dallas, TX office to oversee and drive global inbound logistics efficiency across all global Distribution Centers (DCs). While this is an individual contributor role without direct reports, high-impact leadership, ownership, and end-to-end accountability are paramount. This role carries direct responsibility for high-complexity regions, specifically 2 AMR FTZ (Foreign Trade Zone) DCs and 3 LATAM DCs, managing necessary changes in logistics operations following trade compliance policy adjustments, importation complexity, and destination container security. Working closely with our 4PL control tower teams in Asia and Mexico and 3PL partners globally, you will serve as the primary escalation point for internal and external stakeholders, building robust cross-functional trust and credibility across our end-to-end supply chain network. The ideal candidate seamlessly balances deep, hands-on operational execution in US and LATAM inbound processes with acting as a confident ambassador and representative for Logitech-balancing service quality and cost efficiency, upholding compliance and process integrity, and continuously driving operational excellence for all inbound containers into global DCs.. . Key Responsibilities. Inbound & Control Tower Operations: Oversee inbound logistics operations into AMR FTZ DCs and LATAM DCs, ensuring strict adherence to trade compliance, importation rules, and destination container security standards. Collaborate closely with 4PL control tower teams in Asia and Mexico, serving as the primary escalation lead for internal and external stakeholders. Practical Business Analysis & Analytics: Perform hands-on, practical business analysis to translate complex logistics data into actionable operational strategies. Leverage advanced analytics using Asana, AI tools, and Power BI dashboards to evaluate network performance, maintain EDI data quality, improve ETA accuracy, and support strategic decision-making. Partner & Stakeholder Representation: Lead the comprehensive review and updating of international freight Statement of Work (SOW) documents (including Ocean, Air and all other ship modes) prior to contract reviews with Freight Forwarders (FFs). Drive vendor performance evaluations, scorecard reviews (MBR/QBR), onboarding, SLA compliance, and service improvements. Cultivate trust, influence, and peer credibility through strong execution and deep domain expertise. Risk & Exception Management: Design and enforce strict escalation and remediation processes for any operation disruptions, like critical in-transit issues, including severe delays, missing seals, theft cases, or severe cargo discrepancies requiring documentation revisions for Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) receipts. Maintain cargo security frameworks and risk mitigation strategies across all active transportation networks. Project Execution & Process Innovation: Lead inbound supply chain optimization initiatives (network design, lead time reduction, container utilization, and landed cost control) to maximize operational efficiency and achieve cost targets. Direct logistics projects using tools like Asana to track milestones and status. Drive long-term process optimization beyond daily operational firefighting while fostering strong teamwork and fresh perspectives. . . Required Qualifications. Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in global logistics or transportation management, with extensive hands-on expertise in US & LATAM inbound logistics operations, FTZ procedures, customs/trade compliance. Proven experience operating within or leading an end-to-end logistics control tower. Deep expertise and hands-on operational experience with the Global logistics market, including carrier networks, customs, and regulatory landscapes. Strong hands-on business analysis capabilities, with proven proficiency in building actionable dashboards/reports (e.g., Asana) and leveraging quantitative data to solve logistics challenges. Track record of driving mid-term and long-term process optimization and strategic CIPs rather than focusing strictly on daily operational firefighting. Demonstrated individual leadership, strong sense of ownership, and personal accountability to drive operational success without needing direct reports. Exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, with a track record of building cross-functional trust, influence, and credibility among peers and external partners while representing Logitech professionally. Solid financial acumen with experience in budget management, landed cost modeling, and freight audit support. . Preferred Qualifications. Experience with the practical application of AI in supply chain management or logistics. Proficiency in Project Management: PMP certified and project software skill user, specifically Asana. Master's degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., CSCP). Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume global organization. description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . The Team and Role:. Position at Logitech PWS (Personal Workspace solution) engineering group. . The Personal Workspace Solution group from Logitech is committed to help people create and communicate their passion and work to the world, anytime anywhere. Putting users front and center, we strive to innovate and elevate their experiences. This is more than computer mice, keyboards, webcams and presentation remotes - it's about enabling the future beyond today's tools and in a sustainable way. Everything goes through great design and exceptional user experience conveyed in great hardware and elevated by software. . Within PWS, the Optical Engineering team is responsible for the definition, design, qualification, and optimization of optical systems for video products. The team works closely with cross-functional engineering teams, external suppliers, design partners, and factories to deliver products with strong performance, quality, manufacturability, and user experience. . We are looking for a Lead Optical Engineer to play a key role in the development of new camera-based products. This role will complement existing team capability with deeper strength in camera module integration, optical root cause analysis, supplier design review, IR image quality performance, and validation/test result verification. You will support both new product development and ongoing production, with particular focus on projects involving new camera modules, new sensors, new lenses, external camera modules and lens design partners. The role will cover end to end product development from specification definition to product validation and mass production. . Your Contribution:. Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you'll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:. Drive Hands-On Optical Simulation & Modeling: Perform in-house optical design, geometric/non-sequential ray tracing, tolerance analysis, and stray light/flare simulations using standard design packages (Zemax, Code V, LightTools, etc.) to evaluate feasibility and validate performance prior to tooling release. Lead Optical Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Apply structured, data-backed troubleshooting methodologies to systematically diagnose and resolve complex optical anomalies-such as relative illumination/shading, Chief Ray Angle (CRA) mismatch, stray light, flare, tilt artifacts, and thermal/assembly degradation-across various sensor architectures (RGB, IR, depth/ToF) and lens configurations. Audit & Verify ODM / Supplier Designs: Serve as the technical authority reviewing external ODM and supplier optical designs, tolerance stack-ups, thermal behavior, validation plans, and reported measurement results to ensure uncompromising quality. Co-Develop Next-Gen Camera Modules: Collaborate closely with specialized camera module and lens design partners to build custom modules from the ground up, ensuring seamless physical, optical, and electrical integration between new image sensors and lens assemblies. Integrate Active Optical & Auto-Focus Systems: Drive the hardware integration of active optical systems, including Voice Coil Motor (VCM) selection, actuator control mechanisms, and the interaction between lens optics and Auto-Focus (AF) search algorithms in collaboration with firmware and ISP engineering teams. Ensure Methodological & Analytical Rigor: Analyze large-scale empirical test datasets from internal labs, cross-site teams, and manufacturing lines. Distinguish true optical behavior from measurement setup artifacts to produce 100% reliable, error-free engineering conclusions. Optimize Production & Test Architecture: Define optical test specifications, acceptance criteria, test charts, and guardbands. Establish robust correlation between engineering validation labs and factory test stations during development and production bring-up. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware, quality, and program management teams to align optical specifications with overall product cost, schedule, and user experience goals. . Key Qualifications:. For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:. Hands-On Simulation Expertise: Advanced proficiency in optical design and simulation tools (Zemax, Code V, LightTools, TracePro, or equivalent) with demonstrated ability to run tolerance, sensitivity, stray light, and thermal simulations independently. Advanced Optical Diagnostic & RCA Skills: Proven track record of conducting rigorous root cause analysis on optical anomalies across diverse sensor types (RGB, IR, depth/ToF) and lens constructions. Third-Party Design Auditing: Strong capability to critically review, challenge, and verify external ODM/supplier optical designs, tolerance budgets, and reported test data. Mechatronic & Active Optical Integration: Solid understanding of active optical systems, including VCM/actuator selection, lens movement mechanics, and Auto-Focus (AF) algorithm interaction. Camera Module Co-Development: Hands-on experience integrating image sensors with optics, including Chief Ray Angle (CRA) matching, spatial layout constraints, and module packaging considerations. Data-Driven Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to translate complex, multi-variable optical test data into clear, reliable engineering decisions and actionable recommendations. 3D CAD Proficiency: Working knowledge of 3D modeling software (Creo/ProE, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for optical-mechanical integration reviews. Cross-Functional System View: Strong understanding of how optics interact with mechanical structures, sensor performance, electrical interfaces, and embedded firmware/ISP pipelines. Quality & Engineering Tools: Advanced knowledge of DFMEA, DFMA, PSS, and optical tolerance stack-up analysis. Multitasking & Flexibility: Ability to manage multiple parallel streams, balancing rigorous ODM oversight on one project with deep hands-on co-development on another. Travel: Ability to travel internationally as required.. Preferred Qualifications:. Minimum 7 years of engineering experience in consumer imaging, video collaboration, security cameras, or automotive vision products. Direct experience in NPI builds, factory optical test bring-up, and lab-to-factory correlation studies. Practical experience working within multi-site and cross-regional engineering models. With design-led, software-enabled hardware, Logitech's mission is to extend human potential in work and play, in ways that are better for people and planet. Logitech's award-winning Creative and Design (C&D) team is at the heart of delivering on the company mission. The C&D Creative Project Manager (CPM) is an expert in navigating C&D processes, creative workflows, and deliverables. Operating at the intersection of creative vision and operational rigor, you will take the baton from Design Project Managers (DPMs) at key New Product Introductions (NPI) design gates to shepherd the creative toolkits and campaigns for product launches and brand activations. Acting as an organizer, critical thinker, and proactive problem solver, the CPM goes beyond simple task tracking. You will be the link between business, creative, and content teams-making sure projects move forward smoothly and everyone stays informed through planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and ensuring global resource allocation is executed flawlessly, bringing marketing campaigns to life. Your Behaviors. Foster trust through transparent communication, embrace change and AI-driven innovation, maintain accountability for dependable outcomes, and lead through continuous learning and shared achievement. These are the behaviors and values you'll need for success within the C&D PM Team at Logitech. Key Responsibilities. Project Management Excellence & Workflow Execution Schedule Management for Brand & Creative Deliverables: Seamlessly handle the hand-off from Design PMs into the Creative campaign schedules. Build and maintain project schedules in Asana, integrating asset production schedules provided by Creative Producers to ensure all marketing deliverables ladder up to BG PR, on-shelf, and launch dates. Scope & Workflow Intake: Manage Brand & Creative (B&C) intake and briefs, adjusting project workflows based on deliverable types (video, stills, CG/AI, or ad-hoc assets). Risk & Scope Control: Track timelines and project drift, maintain Change Logs with Producers and Brand Activation, and lead proactive risk escalations. Continuous Improvement: Facilitate post-campaign retrospectives to capture key learnings and refine C&D operational workflows. Workflow Optimization: Continuously map and refine project management processes to align with organizational goals and evolving strategic needs. Operational Coordination & Review Cadence. Review Facilitation: Schedule and lead internal C&D creative reviews (ensuring Strategy and Creative Director sign-off) and Business Group milestone review meetings. Documentation & Asset Handoff: Record and distribute actionable notes and decisions within 24 hours of all reviews/ team meetings. Maintain structured Google Drive repositories, manage toolkit delivery, and partner with Asset Management for final upload of toolkits in our Brand Portal. Communication Rhythm: Set up project Slack channels with structured bookmarks, meeting registers, etc. Run daily/weekly C&D team stand-ups, publish weekly One-Pagers, and co-lead BG status meetings alongside Producers and Brand Activation Leads. . Strategic Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Cross-Discipline Alignment: Align workflows across Creative, Strategy, Brand Activation, Content Production and BG Marketing Teams. Key Responsibilities. 开发面向产线和职能部门的内部应用 ：在指导下承接边界清晰的功能模块，完成从数据模型设计、后端接口、前端页面到联调测试的开发工作，交付后与使用者一起在真实场景中验证并修复问题。. 把手工流程自动化 ：工厂里存在大量靠人工导出、核对、汇总 Excel 的重复流程。你会识别并改造其中一部分，用 Python 脚本或定时任务替代人工操作，处理好数据清洗、异常情况和结果核对。. 支撑数据处理与系统集成 ：编写系统间的数据同步与对账脚本、日志解析工具和异常告警，协助排查接口和数据一致性问题，逐步理解 ERP、MES、WMS 之间的数据是怎么流动的。. 参与团队的工程实践 ：按照 Git 工作流提交代码并接受代码评审，为自己写的功能补充自动化测试，整理部署与使用文档。你会在真实项目里习得这些做法，而不只是听说过它们。. Qualifications. Required. 计算机、软件工程或相关专业在读 。能够连续实习 6 个月及以上，每周到岗 4 天及以上，工作地点为罗技苏州工厂。. 扎实的编程能力。 能独立写出可运行、结构清晰的程序，熟悉常用数据结构、文件与数据处理、异常处理。编程语言不限，Python、Java、C#、C++、Go 等均可；我们的自研应用以 Python 为主，已经能熟练使用 Python 的更佳，其他语言背景则需要能在短期内迁移过来。. 关系型数据库与 SQL 能力。 能设计基本的表结构，熟练编写多表 JOIN、分组聚合和子查询，理解索引、事务和基本的性能问题。在 MySQL、PostgreSQL 或同类数据库上有实际使用经验。. Web 应用开发经验。 使用 Django 完成过后端接口开发，理解 HTTP 与 REST API 的基本概念；能使用 Vue 编写可交互的前端页面。有 Flask、FastAPI、Spring Boot、React 等同类技术栈经验，并能快速迁移到 Django + Vue 的，同样欢迎。. 至少一个你真正做出来过的项目。 课程设计、竞赛作品、个人项目或实习成果均可，但它应当是一个能够实际运行、由你本人主导完成的东西，而不是停留在文档和设想里的构思。投递时请附上代码仓库链接或压缩包。 我们看重"做出来过"，不看重项目的规模和话题的前沿程度 。. Git 的基本使用能力。 理解分支、提交、合并与冲突解决。. 使用 AI 编程工具的意愿和判断力。 我们在日常开发中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具，也鼓励你使用。但你要对提交的每一行代码负责：能解释它做了什么、为什么这么写，并能识别出 AI 给出的错误或不合适的方案。只会复制粘贴而无法判断对错的，不适合这个岗位。. 沟通意愿与责任心。 需求不清楚时主动问，遇到卡点及时暴露，对交付的功能负责到底。. title: Sourcing Transformation Analyst – Data & AI Systems
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . The Role:. As we scale our transformation agenda, speed of execution has become a competitive lever in its own right. The teams that win are the ones that can go from insight to working tool in weeks, not quarters. We're building that capability directly into the transformation function - a dedicated builder who can turn our sourcing and supply chain problems into deployed data and AI systems, so good ideas convert into operating advantage instead of staying on a whiteboard. This is not a data-reporting role, and it's not a traditional business-analyst role. This is a builder who also understands the business well enough to know what's worth building, and can defend it in front of leadership. . . Your Contribution:. Build, not just analyze. Design and build data analytics systems, dashboards, and AI-enabled tools/agents that solve real supply chain and operational problems - using modern platforms and AI tooling (LLM-based tools, automation platforms, low-code/no-code + custom scripting as needed) to move quickly on transformation priorities. Own edge/new-system builds. Prototype and stand up new systems or workflows at the "edge" of existing infrastructure - solutions built fast, tested against real problems, and refined based on what actually proves valuable. Learn the domain fast. Understand supply chain processes deeply enough to spot where data/AI can remove friction. We don't expect a supply chain veteran on day one - we expect someone sharp enough to get there in weeks, not years. Do real due diligence on projects. Evaluate proposed transformation initiatives critically - feasibility, data readiness, ROI, risk - and separate what's genuinely valuable from what's just exciting. Build sharp business cases. Translate technical possibility into a business case leadership can approve in one meeting: clear problem, clear solution, clear numbers, clear risk. Present and influence. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. This includes pushing back diplomatically when an idea doesn't hold up. . . Your Qualifications and Skills:. Must-Have. Proven hands-on ability to build things - not just query/report on data. Comfortable with SQL, Python (or similar), and modern AI/LLM tooling for building analytics or automation solutions. Track record of taking a project from ambiguous problem statement to working prototype/solution with minimal hand-holding. Strong analytical rigor - can evaluate a project's business case and poke holes in weak logic (yours or someone else's). Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to present confidently to senior stakeholders. High learning agility - genuinely excited to pick up domain knowledge (supply chain) quickly rather than needing it spoon-fed. Bias toward action and ownership; comfortable working independently and building end-to-end, since this role carries direct build responsibility rather than routing execution through a separate development team. Nice-to-Have. Prior exposure to supply chain, manufacturing, or operations environments. Experience with cloud data platforms and/or workflow automation tools. Experience building and shipping AI agents/copilots for internal business use cases (not just experimenting with them). . . The Kind of Problems You'll Own. We manage production through a network of contract manufacturers and a multi-tier component supply base. Examples of the problem space (not an exhaustive list - we expect you to find more):. Component risk automation (single-source/EOL flagging, PCN tracking). Contract manufacturer risk visibility (financial health, capacity, concentration risk). Should-cost modeling for components and assemblies. Demand-capacity signal matching across CMs. NPI sourcing readiness tracking. Alternate/second-source qualification tracking. Landed cost and tariff exposure modeling. Supplier and CM performance scorecarding. You won't be handed a finished spec for these - part of the job is scoping which of these (or which adjacent problems) are worth solving first, and making that case. . What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months). At least one of the sourcing problems above (or a comparable one) taken from a rough idea to a working system in active use. The transformation team can point to project decisions ("we killed X, we prioritized Y") backed by this person's due diligence and business case work. Leadership trusts this person's judgment on technical feasibility and business impact, and brings them into project reviews as a default, not an exception. . . #LI-KS1. /104. . This Regional Category Manager role is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end category management of video collaboration solutions & PWS for business portfolio including hardware, accessories and services across Great China Region. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, NPI launch, GTM strategy, Pricing strategy and cross-functional execution, aligning with global category vision while driving regional revenue & profit growth as well as market competitiveness.. Reporting to the Regional Category Management Director, you will own the full lifecycle of the video collaboration category & Personal Work Solution for business - from market analysis, strategy formulation, to product portfolio optimization, pricing governance, and sales enablement. You will collaborate closely with global teams, regional sales, marketing, GTM, sales engineering, and key alliance partners to deliver cutting-edge collaboration solutions that meet enterprise, SMB, and institutional customer demands. This role is critical to scaling our video conferencing product ecosystem and solidifying our market position in the regional video collaboration (VC) industry.. . Key Responsibilities. . 1. Category Strategy & Business Planning. . - Develop and execute regional category strategies for video conferencing systems & PWS for business portfolio, aligned with global business objectives, revenue targets, and profitability goals.. - Conduct in-depth market research, competitive analysis, industry trend tracking, and customer demand analysis to identify growth opportunities, gaps in the product portfolio, and emerging technologies. - Create and manage annual regional category business plans, including sales forecasts, budget allocation, ROI analysis, and KPI tracking (revenue, gross margin, market share, product adoption rate, customer satisfaction). - Define product portfolio roadmap, prioritize product launches, updates, and end-of-life (EOL) planning for video collaboration products to ensure portfolio relevance and competitiveness.. 2. Product Portfolio & Pricing Management. . - Own regional product assortment optimization, including SKU rationalization, new product introduction (NPI), and obsolete product phase-out, balancing product breadth, profitability, and inventory efficiency.. - Develop and implement regional pricing strategies, discount frameworks, and promotional plans, monitoring market pricing dynamics and competitor moves to maintain margin targets and market competitiveness. - Work with sales and marketing teams to define product positioning, value propositions, and sales enablement tools, driving cross-selling and upselling opportunities.. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution. . - Partner with regional sales teams to provide category expertise, product training, and sales support, helping close key enterprise deals and expand channel partnerships.. - Collaborate with supply chain teams to ensure stable inventory supply, optimize lead times, and reduce operational costs. - Align with marketing teams to develop regional marketing campaigns, product launch activities, and thought leadership content to boost brand awareness and product adoption. - Liaise with Global Business Group teams to provide regional customer feedback and market insights, guiding product improvement and innovation for regional market needs.. 4. Performance Tracking & Reporting. . - Monitor and analyze category performance metrics on a regular basis, preparing detailed reports for senior management on revenue, margin, market share, supplier performance, and strategy execution progress.. - Identify risks and opportunities in the category, propose data-driven improvement plans, and adjust strategies dynamically to adapt to market changes and customer needs. - Ensure compliance with global corporate policies, regional regulatory requirements, and industry standards for respective categories.. Required Qualifications & Skills. . Education. . - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree (MBA/MSc) is a strong plus.. . Professional Experience. . - 5+ years of progressive category management, product management, or strategic procurement experience in the unified communication, video conferencing, or enterprise collaboration technology industry; direct experience with Poly, Yeelink, or similar UC hardware brands is highly preferred.. - Proven track record of developing and executing category strategies, driving revenue growth, margin improvement, and market share gains in a regional or global role. - Hands-on experience managing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, and optimizing product portfolios for B2B technology products.. Core Competencies. . - Deep expertise in video conferencing systems, collaboration hardware, UC solutions, and industry trends (hybrid work, AI integration, cloud-based conferencing, room systems).. - Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to translate market insights into actionable category plans. - Excellent data analysis and financial modeling skills, proficient in forecasting, budget management, and KPI-driven performance tracking. - Outstanding cross-functional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global and regional teams at all levels. - Fluency in English (written and verbal);. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and business intelligence tools; experience with ERP, CRM, or category management software is preferred.. Soft Skills. . - Results-oriented with a focus on execution and accountability.. - Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities in a fast-paced, dynamic tech environment. - Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines. - Customer-centric mindset, with a passion for delivering innovative collaboration solutions. - Ability to travel regionally as needed (up to 20-25% annually).. Preferred Qualifications. . - Prior experience working in a multinational corporation (MNC) with a global matrix organization structure.. - Direct experience launching new video conferencing products or managing enterprise-level UC solution portfolios. - Established network of suppliers and partners in the global video conferencing and collaboration technology industry. - Knowledge of regional regulatory standards and compliance requirements for electronic and communication products.. #LI-ET1. description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . The Role:. As the Senior Financial Analyst for the Logitech for Business (L4B) FP&A team, you will act as the lead financial strategist and P&L owner for our B2B organization. In this highly collaborative role, you will hold full ownership of the P&L-from Direct Customer Sales down to Contribution Margin. You will serve as the financial compass for the L4B team, aligning closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the globe to decode P&L dynamics, drive strategic decision-making, and fuel our long-term growth. If you are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, innovative environment and loves transforming complex data into actionable business strategies, we want you on our team. Your Contribution:. Master the P&L : Take full ownership of the L4B P&L from top-line sales down to Contribution Margin, partnering across functions to deeply understand and influence the drivers of our financial performance. . Drive Long-Term Financial Planning (LTFP): Own and evolve the LTFP model. You will coordinate inputs from key stakeholders (including Services, Category Marketing, and Operations), dynamically update the model to reflect near-term planning cycles, and proactively highlight performance gaps and opportunities. . Lead Regional Target Setting & Tracking: Act as the vital bridge between Global HQ and Regional finance partners. You will cascade HQ targets to the regions, establish key performance metrics, and track ongoing regional execution against our strategic goals. . Empower Category Marketing & Pricing: Provide robust financial oversight for Category Marketing. You will lead global pricing analytics, scenario modeling, and performance tracking to optimize our competitive positioning and profitability. . Manage Financial Forecasting: Own and execute HQ-level forecast adjustments, ensuring high accuracy, agility, and alignment with broader corporate objectives. . Deliver Strategic Support: Act as a trusted financial advisor to category and product management leaders. You will provide advanced financial modeling and strategic business casing for special initiatives, product launches, and new business opportunities. . Your Qualifications and Skills:. . Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Finance, FP&A, or Investment Banking. Prior experience supporting a B2B, hardware, or technology business is highly preferred. . Financial Modeling Expertise: Exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills. You can build complex, dynamic models from scratch and synthesize large datasets into clear, actionable business insights. . Financial Planning and CRM System Experience: expertise in using various financial analytics tools such as OneStream, Hyperion Essbase, Analplan and Salesforce. . Education:. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field. . Compensation:. This position offers an annual base salary typically between $100,000 and $125,000. In certain circumstances, higher compensation will be considered based on the business need, candidate experience, and skills. title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . Senior DevOps Engineer. The Role. Logitech is the world's leading provider of personal peripherals that connect people in a natural, intuitive way to the digital experiences they care about. Our product design group strives at developing products with a powerful blend of artistic design, surprising science, and innovation driven by consumer insight. Focused on innovation and quality, we want to change the way people use our peripherals by offering a more comfortable, fun, productive, convenient, delightful and seamless experience with the digital world!. A fundamental part of our strategy is building scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native platforms that power these experiences. Our engineering organization is actively looking for a talented Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and evolve our infrastructure and CI/CD ecosystems across global environments. You will be responsible for building highly automated, scalable, and resilient platforms across multi-cloud environments including AWS and Alibaba Cloud. You will be a critical member of a team that includes software engineering, QA, security, and platform architecture. . Who you are:. . You have practical knowledge and demonstrable success in building and managing cloud infrastructure and DevOps platforms at scale. You enjoy working with distributed systems and solving complex infrastructure and deployment challenges. You are able, with limited supervision, to design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation. You possess strong troubleshooting skills and can quickly identify and resolve issues across infrastructure, application, and network layers. You are able to design and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud environments. You are passionate about improving developer productivity through automation and platform engineering. You actively mentor peers and drive adoption of DevOps best practices across teams. You are a team-first type of colleague. You do not shy away from writing code or scripts using Python, Bash, or other automation tools to improve efficiency. . Your Contribution:. . Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across AWS and Alibaba Cloud. Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab CI/CD and Jenkins to support rapid and reliable software delivery. Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or similar frameworks. Drive automation across build, deployment, monitoring, and incident response workflows. Collaborate with development, QA, and security teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of applications. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure high availability and performance of services. Ensure system reliability through proactive performance tuning, capacity planning, and incident management. Drive DevOps best practices including continuous integration, continuous delivery, and continuous improvement. Establish standards for environment consistency, security compliance, and operational excellence. Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies to improve platform efficiency and developer experience. Periodically report platform performance, reliability metrics, and DevOps maturity improvements to stakeholders. . Key Qualifications. . For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:. A minimum of 3+ years of experience in a DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineering role. Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services and Alibaba Cloud. Extensive experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD and Jenkins. Proficiency in configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible. Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar tools preferred). Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Solid scripting/programming skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages. Strong understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud architecture. Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.). Hands-on experience with version control systems like Git. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across distributed systems. . Preferable skills:. . Experience working in multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments. Experience with cost optimization and cloud governance practices. Exposure to security and compliance frameworks in cloud environments. Experience with blue-green deployments, canary releases, and progressive delivery techniques. Familiarity with service mesh and microservices architecture. Experience supporting globally distributed systems. . Education. . B.E/M.E in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. . Based on site in our San Jose Office. . The Role and Team. . We are looking for an enthusiastic, experienced, adaptable, and highly organized Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive support to the General Manager of Team Workspace Solutions (TWS), the TWS Leadership Team, and the broader TWS organization. . This is a high-trust, highly visible role at the center of a fast-moving, global business. The successful candidate will be an exceptional Executive Assistant as well as a proactive problem solver and team enabler-someone who anticipates needs, connects the dots, navigates complexity, and helps the organization operate effectively. No job is too big or too small. On any given day, you may be coordinating a complex international itinerary for the GM, planning a Leadership Team offsite, organizing an event for 250 employees, helping resolve an urgent shipment stuck in customs, or figuring out how to get a product order to the right person in the right country. You are comfortable moving seamlessly between strategic, highly confidential executive support and the practical details that keep a global team moving. Strong bias for action and a demonstrated ability to take ownership of an issue and drive it through resolution. Exceptional resourcefulness and problem-solving ability. Strong judgment and corporate maturity, including the ability to determine what requires escalation and what can be handled independently. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact comfortably with senior executives, employees, customers, partners, and vendors. Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and adapt quickly when plans or priorities change. Collaborative, approachable, and service-oriented, while confident enough to push back, clarify priorities, and solve problems independently. Experience planning meetings, offsites, and larger employee events strongly preferred. Comfortable navigating technology, internal systems, and administrative processes and learning new tools quickly. title: Lead Android Platform  Engineer
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . The Role:. . We are looking for a highly experienced Android Systems Engineer with deep expertise in building Android-based appliance products. This role is focused on the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of purpose-built Android devices where reliability, performance, security, and hardware/software integration are critical. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience across the Android software stack, including Linux kernel development, device drivers, Android HAL, Android framework services, and system-level debugging. The candidate should also have deep domain knowledge in at least one major Android subsystem such as the Camera Framework, Display Framework, or Audio Framework , with the ability to work across multiple subsystems as needed. . This role is well suited for an engineer who can operate from low-level hardware bring-up through Android framework integration and production software delivery. The successful candidate will be someone who can move comfortably between architecture and hands-on debugging. They should be able to understand a product requirement, trace it through the Android framework, HAL, kernel, driver, and hardware layers, and identify the right solution. This person should bring strong engineering judgment, deep Android system knowledge, and the ability to deliver reliable appliance software in a complex hardware/software environment. They should be comfortable working directly with internal teams, external technology partners, and executive stakeholders when needed. . Your Contribution. In this role, you will help. Architect, develop, and deliver Android-based appliance platforms for advanced video collaboration and embedded systems products. You will work closely with hardware, firmware, platform software, application, QA, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams to ensure the complete system works reliably from bootloader and kernel through Android services and user-facing functionality. You will be expected to solve complex system integration issues, guide technical decisions, review platform architecture, and contribute directly to high-quality production software. . Key Responsibilities. Android Platform and Appliance Development. Develop and integrate Android-based software platforms for purpose-built appliance devices. Customize and optimize Android system behavior for dedicated appliance use cases, including kiosk-style operation, controlled user experience, device management, security, and reliability. Work across Android framework, native services, HAL layers, kernel, and device-specific software components. Support Android platform bring-up on new SoC platforms and hardware designs. Integrate BSP releases from SoC vendors, ODMs, JDMs, and technology partners. Drive platform stability, boot performance, recovery behavior, update mechanisms, and production readiness. Kernel, Driver, and Low-Level System Development. Develop, debug, and maintain Linux kernel components for Android-based products. Work on device drivers for camera, audio, display, touch, USB, I2C, SPI, GPIO, Ethernet, power management, and other hardware interfaces. Debug low-level system issues involving interrupts, memory, DMA, device tree, clocks, power rails, and peripheral initialization. Analyze kernel logs, tombstones, traces, crash dumps, and other diagnostic data to isolate complex system failures. Collaborate with hardware engineers to validate board-level behavior and resolve hardware/software integration issues. Optimize kernel and driver performance for system latency, throughput, power, and reliability. Android Camera, Display, and Audio Framework Integration. . Provide deep technical leadership in one or more Android multimedia subsystems, including:. Android Camera Framework. Camera HAL, camera provider, camera service, capture pipeline, sensor integration, ISP interaction, metadata, stream configuration, multi-camera use cases, image quality tuning support, and camera performance optimization. Android Display Framework. SurfaceFlinger, Hardware Composer, display HAL, graphics buffers, composition, HDMI/display output, resolution handling, refresh behavior, EDID handling, and display performance. Android Audio Framework. Audio HAL, AudioFlinger, audio policy, routing, capture/playback paths, microphone arrays, speakers, echo cancellation integration, latency optimization, and audio device bring-up. Work with application and product teams to ensure camera, display, and audio features meet real-world product requirements. Debug cross-subsystem issues involving camera preview, video encode/decode, display output, audio capture/playback, synchronization, and system performance. Android HAL and Framework Services. Design, develop, and debug Android HAL implementations and vendor services. Work with AIDL/HIDL interfaces, native daemons, Binder IPC, SELinux policies, and Android system services. Integrate vendor-specific functionality into the Android framework while maintaining platform stability and upgradeability. title: AI Agent 应用工程师（语音与新型人机交互方向）
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . 我们正在寻找一位具有架构师视野的创客（Super Builder），成为连接大模型智能与实体硬件交互的枢纽，主导构建具备自主决策能力的 AI Agent 系统，推动下一代人机交互（HCI）的落地。. 岗位职责. 业务需求转化为交互能力： 深入洞察用户在桌面端与硬件端的交互痛点，将模糊的使用场景与用户意图，抽象为可执行的 Agent 决策逻辑与工具调用链路，确保技术方案能有效解决实际交互难题。. . 下一代交互原型开发： 构建"硬件端 -> 实时语音 -> 系统自动化"的全新人机交互原型，推动用户体验从物理操作向自然语言交互平滑过渡。. . 工业级任务编排（Orchestration）： 针对复杂、多步骤的系统级及硬件控制任务，设计高鲁棒性的有状态多智能体协同系统（Stateful Multi-Agent System），解决长链路任务中的分支、重试与无限循环死锁问题。. . 闭环长期记忆系统搭建： 负责设计与落地 Agent 长期记忆架构，攻克"记忆漂移"与上下文污染难点，实现情节记忆与程序记忆的动态融合与智能衰减。. . 统一软硬件上下文协议： 利用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 及 Agent Skills 等最新标准与框架，打通硬件状态、本地应用上下文与云端大模型之间的无缝连接。. . 安全控制与确认门禁： 在任务编排中设计严格的确定性安全边界，确保涉及隐私及关键系统操作时的回滚机制与用户人工确认机制（Human-in-the-Loop）。. . 任职要求. 核心能力要求（Core Qualifications）. 扎实的软件工程基础： 5 年以上软件开发经验，精通 Python，并对 C/C++、Go 或 Rust 有实际工程经验（用于处理底层硬件通信与高性能音频流）。. . 高阶 Agent 系统构建： 具备 1 年以上生产环境 Agent 系统设计经验，深刻理解并解决过 Agent 在复杂任务编排中的状态丢失、非确定性行为控制问题。. . 深入理解 Agent 核心推理范式： 掌握 ReAct、Plan-and-Solve、Reflection 等主流推理架构，具备针对复杂任务场景设计多轮推理与自我修正链路的实战经验。. . Agent Skills 与任务编排： 具备 Agent Skills 开发与优化经验，能设计高质量工具集以提升执行效率；具备使用 LangGraph、Temporal、CrewAI 等主流工具（或类似工具）的实际工程经验，能灵活设计有状态的、异步事件驱动的复杂图结构（DAG/Cyclic Graph）。. . 多模态与语音工程： 熟悉实时音频流处理（WebSockets/WebRTC）、端到端语音模型、STT/TTS 技术的工程化缝合，有处理高并发、低延迟音频交互经验。. . 记忆与上下文工程： 熟悉现代 Agent 长期记忆架构（情节与程序记忆的动态融合）及记忆工程，能熟练运用向量/图数据库进行数据持久化；熟练掌握 MCP 协议及上下文工程（如 Token 压缩）。. . 系统级交互与认知： 具备深厚的系统级交互认知，熟悉操作系统底层接口（Windows/macOS API、RPA逻辑）及硬件通信协议，能够打通硬件、本地应用与云端大模型。. . 3. 软实力与极客精神. 敏捷迭代与安全边界： 具备极强的原型开发与敏捷迭代能力，同时对系统安全边界保持敬畏；在追求创新效率的同时，确保关键系统交互的鲁棒性与稳定性。. . 卓越的跨界协作： 能够将前沿的 AI 算法需求高效转化为硬件工程师可理解的工程指标，在 AI 与硬件系统之间建立通畅的沟通桥梁。. . 工程闭环与责任意识： 具备极强的交付责任心，能够通过系统化的测试、监控与验证手段，确保 Agent 在真实物理交互场景下的表现可度量、可复盘，对交付效果负责。. . 主动探索与自驱力： 面对前沿领域模糊的课题，能够通过主动钻研技术前沿并快速构建验证方案（PoC），表现出极高的技术好奇心与解决复杂问题的韧性。. . 加分项. 拥有软硬件结合项目（如物联网、机器人、智能穿戴或 DIY 智能硬件）的成功交付经验。. . 在 GitHub 上有高 Star 且涉及多智能体协同、自动化控制或 MCP Server 相关开源项目。. . 参加过知名黑客马拉松（Hackathon）并获奖或有完整作品交付。. . #LI-LZ1/51SZ/LP. title: Product Security Architect
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . About the Role. Logitech's product ecosystem spans embedded hardware, desktop software, and cloud services, and the security of everything we build sits at the heart of what this team does. As a Product Security Architect , you will work across Logitech's full portfolio of internally built and self-hosted applications, providing security architecture guidance, threat modeling expertise, and hands-on consultancy to engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle. Your scope will deliberately span both product and enterprise software. Whether you are reviewing the secure design of a companion desktop application or advising on the authentication architecture of an internal enterprise service, you will be the security voice that engineering teams turn to before problems emerge. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and fellow security team members, using a combination of deep technical expertise and modern AI-assisted tooling to embed security early and at scale across Logitech's engineering organization. What You Will Do. Secure Architecture & Design. Define and own the secure architecture standards across Logitech's in-house built and self-hosted applications, spanning product ecosystems and enterprise services. . Design secure communication pathways, trust boundaries, authentication frameworks, and cryptographic standards across our full software stack. . Establish reusable, scalable security patterns that engineering teams can adopt without slowing down delivery. . Threat Modeling & Risk Advisory. Lead threat modeling exercises across new and existing products, leveraging AI models to accelerate baseline generation and focusing your expertise on complex, Logitech-specific attack vectors. . Identify architectural risks early in the SDLC and translate them into clear, prioritized, and actionable engineering requirements. . Maintain a living view of our internal threat landscape and evolving attack surfaces, including AI-integrated product features. . Internal Security Consultancy. Serve as the trusted security partner for Product Managers, Lead Engineers, and Engineering Directors during ideation and design phases. . Drive security reviews and design consultations across multiple product squads simultaneously, ensuring security remains an accelerator rather than a blocker. . Define testing scopes and critical attack paths to guide offensive security and validation efforts. . AI Feature & Integration Security. Act as the primary security authority for AI features being embedded into Logitech products and services - including on-device ML models, cloud-hosted LLM integrations, and AI data pipelines. . Define security guardrails for generative AI integrations, covering risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, and training data exposure. . What You Bring. Experience. 6+ years in Application Security, Product Security, or Security Architecture roles covering a diverse and complex software portfolio. . Demonstrated experience designing secure architectures across both product-facing and enterprise internal applications. . Track record of influencing engineering culture and embedding security practices early in the development lifecycle. . Technical Skills. Deep expertise in threat modeling methodologies. . Strong command of modern authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC) and secure API design principles. . Solid understanding of cryptographic fundamentals and their practical application in software systems. . Familiarity with cloud-native security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and self-hosted infrastructure security. . Working knowledge of secure SDLC frameworks (OWASP SAMM or equivalent). . AI & Modern Security Practices. Practical experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate threat modeling, architecture reviews, or security research. . Understanding of AI/ML security risks, including adversarial inputs, model extraction, prompt injection, and data pipeline security. . Soft Skills. Exceptional communication skills - you can speak to a firmware engineer and a VP of Engineering in the same day and be equally effective with both. . Strong consultancy mindset: you influence without authority and build long-term trust with engineering teams. . Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. Principal Industrial Designer - Mouse Design Team | Cork, Ireland. . *Hybrid role - base 3 days a week on site*. . THE ROLE. Logitech is seeking a Principal Industrial Designer to join our Mouse Design Team in Cork. This is a senior-level position for a recognised expert who balances world-class craft with strategic foresight - a thinker and a doer. You will work on complex design assignments, solving unique challenges that have a broad impact on our product portfolio and the future direction of our businesses. Based in our Cork office, you will be a key member of a team dedicated to excellence in handheld products, leading the creation of mice that are as comfortable, ergonomically superior as they are visually groundbreaking. . WHY IS THIS ROLE IMPORTANT FOR LOGITECH?. The mouse is at the core of Logitech's product portfolio. We design the tools people reach for every day - products where form, material, ergonomics, and engineering precision must coexist seamlessly and where world class design quality is non-negotiable. At the Principal level, you will be shaping the future of one of our most competitive and scrutinised product categories. We prototype to learn, design to inspire, and ship real products that people enthuse about and love to use. . YOUR CONTRIBUTION. Move fast. Speak up. Decide and own. Drive change. Visionary Craft & Innovation: Lead the design and development of future-forward mouse experiences, transforming complex human problems into polished, intuitive, and beautiful design solutions. Strategic Influence: Partner with senior leadership to shape the long-term direction of the Mouse Design Team, ensuring design strategy aligns with emerging trends and business objectives. Design Excellence: Manage key design processes and projects from brief through to production builds, maintaining an unrelenting focus on quality, detail, and creative confidence. Mentorship & Leadership: Provide guidance and thought leadership to the broader design team. Mentor other designers and foster a culture of curiosity and exceptional craftsmanship. Collaborative Networking: Build strong relationships with engineering, product marketing, and business stakeholders to drive design quality and change across a multidisciplinary environment. . title: Intern, Engineering, Software & Gaming
description: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.. . 创新工程实习生 - 软件 & 游戏方向. 部门： C4C 硬件工程. 工作地点： 中国苏州（现场办公）. 工作类型： 实习（全职，4-6 个月）. . 团队介绍. Inno Panel 是罗技 C4C 硬件工程团队中的一支创新小组，专注于探索面向办公与游戏场景的下一代用户体验--通过快速迭代的 PoC（概念验证），把用户尚未被满足的需求转化为可验证的原型。. 我们以周为节奏推进项目，而不是以季度衡量进度。我们专注、被信任，去创造下一个未来。. . 岗位介绍. 你将同时扮演两个角色：一名真实的罗技用户（因为你本身就是游戏玩家），以及原型软件部分的动手开发者。你将主要基于 Logitech 创新快速原型平台（Logitech Innovation Quick Prototyping Platform）进行开发--这是我们内部使用的工具集，可在几周而非几个月内搭出可运行的 PoC。你的游戏直觉决定我们要做什么；你的代码帮助我们把它做出来。. 你将会：. 被问到 "什么是对的感觉" 的次数，与被问到 "技术上能做什么" 一样多. . 编写 原型代码 来验证一个概念，验证完就投入下一个想法. . 看到真实用户体验你参与做出来的东西--并把他们的反馈带回到下一轮迭代. . 主要职责. 做用户. 把真实玩家的视角带入团队讨论--覆盖 多个游戏品类，其中 FPS《三角洲行动》（Delta Force）是必备 --讲清楚现有外设做对了什么、做错了什么、以及不同玩法下"配置"到底意味着什么. . 协助 UX 负责人在真实的中国游戏场景中识别并梳理 未被满足的需求 （必须覆盖 FPS；优选 MOBA、MMO、赛车/模拟、手游、主机游戏等品类）. . 参与用户测试--既作为测试的执行者，有时也作为被测试的用户. . 搭建原型 - 软件部分. 基于 Logitech 创新快速原型平台搭建每个 PoC 的软件部分 --熟悉平台的组件模块，需要时进行扩展，快速交付可运行的原型. . 与 SW + AI 工程师协作开发原型软件--桌面应用、主机端工具、AI Agent 集成、演示脚本. . 用 JavaScript 编写简洁可运行的代码，把原型硬件包装成用户真正能上手体验的东西. . 协助为 PoC 加入数据采集--日志、埋点、简易仪表盘. . 快速迭代. 把用户测试中的观察转化为下一版原型--尽量在同一周内完成. . 记录什么有效、什么无效，让团队的认知持续累积. . 协助维护一个可复用的原型组件库，团队成员都能调用. . 跨学科协作. 与硬件工程师（固件、电子、结构）每天紧密协作，让软件在真实的原型板上跑起来. . 与 UX 专家共同设计与观察用户测试. . 任职要求. 在读 计算机科学、软件工程、电子工程、游戏设计或相关专业的本科或硕士--寻求入职前实习机会的在校生. . 软件开发能力（必备） --能够独立用 JavaScript 编写、调试并交付可运行的代码. . AI 辅助编程（必备） --你已经在主动使用 AI 编程工具加速自己的工作。你知道如何写好 prompt、什么时候该相信输出、什么时候要质疑、以及如何把 AI 生成的代码整合进自己的项目。本团队的迭代速度依赖于此. . 多品类深度玩家（必备） --你长期游玩 多个游戏品类，《三角洲行动》（Delta Force）是必玩 ，最好还涉及 MOBA、MMO、赛车/模拟、格斗或沙盒等品类。 广度 很重要. . 对游戏外设充满热情（必备） --你对游戏鼠标、键盘、耳机、手柄等外设有大量上手经验和明确观点；能清楚表达一款设备在特定品类中"对"或"不对"的原因. . 可在 苏州 现场办公 4-6 个月 ，最好能全职出勤（每周至少 4 天）. . 充满好奇心、行动迅速、敢于交付"粗糙但能跑"的东西 --我们看重学习速度，胜过对成品的打磨程度. . 加分项. 拥有以下任意一项都会让你脱颖而出--都不是必须，但每一项都是有力加分：. 游戏开发经验 --哪怕只是 Unity、Unreal、Godot 或自研引擎上的小项目. . AI 折腾经验 --你用大语言模型 API 做过东西（聊天机器人、Agent、RAG、语音助手），训练或微调过小模型，或在项目中集成过计算机视觉. . 硬件折腾经验 --Arduino、树莓派、ESP32、客制化键盘或类似的 Maker 项目. . 竞技或直播背景 --天梯排位、电竞战队、Twitch/B 站直播、Mod 社区贡献等. . 开源活跃度 --有公开的 GitHub 个人项目，哪怕规模不大. . 多外设使用经验 --你横向对比过不同品牌、不同价位的鼠标、键盘、耳机、手柄，并能清楚说明每款想改进的地方. . 中英双语能力 --中英文读、写、说均流利. . Performance Tracking & Reporting. - Monitor and analyze category performance metrics on a regular basis, preparing detailed reports for senior management on revenue, margin, market share, supplier performance, and strategy execution progress. - Identify risks and opportunities in the category, propose data-driven improvement plans, and adjust strategies dynamically to adapt to market changes and customer needs. - Ensure compliance with global corporate policies, regional regulatory requirements, and industry standards for video conferencing products.. description: Job Description:. . At Piper Sandler, we connect capital with opportunity to build a better future.. We are seeking a Data Security Specialist to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) group in Minneapolis, MN or New York, NY.. This key position will report to the Director of Information Security and be responsible for defining and enforcing data governance policies and standards, with a primary focus on the discovery, classification and protection of unstructured data. Beyond strategic leadership, the Data Governance Specialist will possess hands-on technical expertise to manage, maintain and optimize the platforms, technologies, and solutions that underpin our data governance and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) programs. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation, helping establish a culture of data protection, accountability, and trust.. Responsibilities. Develop and maintain a comprehensive data governance framework, including policies, standards, and processes for data classification, data privacy, data security, data retention, data handling, information lifecycle management with a focus on unstructured data. Set the standard for data governance and data protection and formalize best practices for adoption across business lines and corporate functions. Own and manage the firm's DLP platform, including the deployment and tuning of DLP policies that serve as the enforcement mechanism for the IRM program. Provide data governance expertise to strategic projects, business initiatives and operational changes. Identify and shape continuous improvement opportunities and recommendations that enable data to better serve the growing business while reducing information risk. Provide thought leadership for data governance, data protection, and data health with business lines. Act as a primary point of contact for data governance, information classification, DLP, and data protection-related inquiries. Lead data remediation efforts working with data owners and technical teams to resolve data exposure, improper handling, retention, classification, and policy compliance issues. About the role:. Staying a step ahead of fraudsters takes an inquisitive mind, an appetite to dig deeper, and the imagination to shed new light on how we fight fraud - and here, it all starts with data. As an Analyst on Enova's Fraud Analytics team, you'll be the quantitative engine of our fraud prevention effort. You'll develop, enhance, and test the models and pattern-recognition pipelines that surface emerging fraud trends across our lending products - then work hand-in-hand with our Fraud Operations team, who investigate the individual applications your models flag. Write customized programs in Python for meaningful data analysis and predictive modeling, and query large, complex datasets in SQL. Partner closely with Fraud Operations through the full detection loop - pulling data together, surfacing suspicious patterns, and incorporating their investigation results to refine features and reduce false positives/negatives. Conduct ad hoc analysis on large, complex datasets to scope new or changing fraud trends and recommend risk, verification, and operational strategies. Communicate findings clearly to cross-functional partners, provide requirements, and support implementation. Help improve underwriting and verification processes from a fraud-risk perspective. Conduct ad hoc analysis on large, complex datasets to scope new or changing fraud trends and recommend risk, verification, and operational strategies. Communicate findings clearly to cross-functional partners, provide requirements, and support implementation. Help improve underwriting and verification processes from a fraud-risk perspective. title: Senior Associate, Paid Search (Hybrid)
description: About the role:. We are looking for a strategic, self-directed marketing expert to own the growth and trajectory of our search and affiliate strategy for Enova's Small Business division. This role reports to the Head of Acquisition, SMB and sits at the center of how paid search (SEM) and affiliate marketing drive new customer acquisition and profitable growth. This is not an execution-only seat. We need an owner - someone who treats the performance of these channels as if it were their own business, sets the strategy, and drives the results. You will still be close enough to the levers to be hands-on in the platforms, but your primary mandate is to define where the strategy goes next and to connect the dots between analytics, reporting, channel performance, and the bottom line. You'll be the person who anticipates where performance is headed, not waiting for a report to tell you something changed. You'll use AI to surface signals, generate ideas, and pressure-test decisions - not the one waiting for a report to tell you something changed. Responsibilities:. Own the search strategy. Set the vision, roadmap, and growth trajectory for SEM and channels - from budget allocation and bid strategy to partner mix and testing agenda - and be accountable for the performance and efficiency over time. Build and manage the affiliate partner portfolio. Recruit, vet, and onboard partners and networks; structure and negotiate commission and payout models; run relationship and performance reviews; and monitor for brand bidding, lead-quality issues, and fraud - ensuring third-party promotion of our products meets the same standards as our owned channels. Bridge data science, analytics, and performance. Work hand-in-hand with the Data Scientist who owns the model and with internal and external analytics and reporting/BI teams - building enough fluency in the model to translate its inputs and outputs, keep everyone working from the same numbers, and turn insight into channel decisions that improve performance. Connect performance to the P&L. Translate channel decisions into their impact on acquisition volume, efficiency, cost, and profitability. Understand and clearly articulate how spend and optimization choices flow through to unit economics and the P&Ls bottom line. Lead with AI. Actively adopt and champion AI tools across the search and affiliate workflow - using them to accelerate research, analysis, creative, reporting, and optimization - and continually find new ways to apply AI to extend the channel's reach, efficiency, and workflow. Let AI do the heavy lifting on research and analysis while the final call stays yours. Find growth before it's asked for. Proactively identify new opportunities, channels, and partner relationships that extend our reach and capture via the Search model and keep us ahead of the market. Run and optimize the channels hands-on. Own day-to-day execution across the SEM and Affiliate portfolio - campaign builds, bid and budget management, keyword and audience strategy, affiliate partner management, and landing pages - and drive the testing and optimization agenda end to end: design and prioritize high-impact experiments across creative, bidding, and partners, measure rigorously, and scale what works. Own compliance and brand integrity in-channel. Ensure all paid search and affiliate activity - including ad copy, landing pages, and affiliate promotion - meets Enova's regulatory, legal, and compliance requirements, partnering closely with Legal and Compliance to keep the channel audit-ready as it scales. Communicate cross-functionally. Partner with Analytics, Finance, Creative, Product Marketing Legal, and Compliance to align on measurement, messaging, and reporting, and to present clear recommendations and results to leadership. What Success Looks Like:. In this role, you don't just report on what the channels did - you decide where they go, and you use AI to get there faster and with sharper judgment. A strong quarter is one where you spotted a shift in search or affiliate performance early - often with AI surfacing the signal before a standard report would - understood its bottom line implications, aligned analytics and model enhancements around a shared view, and moved budget decisively to protect and grow profitable acquisition - with a clear, well-communicated, data-backed rationale that leadership and cross-functional partners could get behind. Requirements:. 7+ years of experience in performance marketing, specifically paid search / SEM, affiliate marketing and a proven track record of driving online conversions and customer acquisition. A strategic, ownership mindset - a history of identifying opportunities and problems and driving solutions without being prompted. Proven proficiency with AI tools and a track record of using them to drive real marketing outcomes - applying AI across analysis, reporting, creative, testing, and decision support to work faster and at greater scale. Hands-on fluency across paid search, AI/LLM and affiliate platforms - Google Ads and Microsoft (Bing) Ads, a bid-management/search platform such as Search Ads 360 or Marin, and affiliate networks/tracking platforms - with the technical comfort to stay in the tools when needed. Strong analytical skills - comfort working with data in performance reporting, web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics / GA4, Adobe Analytics), and SQL/BI tools to identify trends and make informed decisions. The ability to connect channel performance to business and P&L outcomes and to explain that story simply to non-technical stakeholders. Exceptional communication and project management skills, with a track record of aligning cross-functional teams (analytics, reporting, finance, creative, compliance) and delivering on timelines. A self-starter, action-oriented approach - you operate as an owner and treat the P&L as your own. Compensation:. The budgeted annual salary range for this position is $90,000 to $120,000. title: Senior Manager, Partnership Account Management (Hybrid)
description: About the role:. The Senior Manager of Partnership Account Management owns the full lifecycle of OnDeck's live partner relationships - from go-live through expansion, tier upgrade, and renewal. Reporting to the Direct P&L Head, this role is the operational engine of the Strategic Partners (SP) channel's revenue retention and growth. You will directly manage the SP Account management function and serve as the senior commercial point of contact for the highest-value and highest-complexity live accounts. You are expected to spend approximately 60% of your time on account management strategy, playbook development, and team leadership and 40% directly engaged with key partner relationships. This is a player-coach role with a clear mandate: build the system first, then run it. The SP channel will scale to 10, 20, 50 live partners. The Senior Manager is building the infrastructure that makes that scale manageable and profitable. Responsibilities:. Lead and develop the Account Management team: Set priorities, run weekly account health reviews, coach on expansion conversations, and define the team's operating cadence and performance standards. Build the hiring and onboarding plan for future AMs. Build and own the Partner Growth Playbook: Within 90 days, audit every live partner (actual vs. potential volume) and produce a tiered framework of sequenced actions to close the gap across volume, product tier, integration depth and co-marketing. Run the QBR program and Partner Health Scorecard: Standardize QBRs, track post-meeting actions, and maintain a living scorecard with green/yellow/red intervention protocols so underperformance is caught early. Drive upsell and cross-sell: For example, moving Marketplace partners to White Label or adding Term Loan alongside LOC. Report quarterly on incremental volume, tier upgrades and NRR. Manage senior relationships: Be the commercial lead for the top 20-30% of partners. Present expansion proposals as business cases, lead renewals starting 90+ days out, and coordinate co-marketing with SP Marketing. Own onboarding: Run partner launch from contract to go-live, with a documented 30/60/90-day ramp plan agreed at signing. Be the voice of the partner: Turn account feedback into clear asks for Product, Marketing and leadership, and deliver accurate account-level origination forecasts. What Great Looks Like:. You are a growth architect who can spot the sequenced steps to close a partner's gap, a systems builder who creates the playbook before you need it, and a data-first operator who is never surprised by a number. You are credible with a partner's VP or CFO, and you are a team multiplier whom Product, Marketing, S&O, Analytics and Finance trust. How success is measured: NRR, origination volume vs. target, tier upgrade rate, QBR completion and action close rate, time-to-live for new partners, scorecard coverage, co-marketing volume, and AM team retention and performance. Requirements:. 6-10+ years in account management, partner success or strategic partnerships, with a record of growing revenue in an existing book. Experience building or owning an account growth framework, expansion playbook or QBR program, with evidence of its impact. Experience managing or coaching account managers (formal direct reports preferred). Strong commercial instincts and the ability to present business cases to senior partner stakeholders. Fintech, SaaS or payments experience. Comfort building from scratch, since you will write the first version of the playbook. Strongly Preferred:. Embedded finance, white-label lending or API-driven financial product experience. Familiarity with vertical SaaS, ERP, accounting, payroll or payments ecosystems. Experience with revenue-share or performance-based structures. Understanding of SMB lending economics. A background that blends account management and new business development. What We Offer:. A growing book in a channel that is adding partners and products. An embedded solution that lets partners' SMB customers get automated pre-approved offers without leaving the partner's ecosystem. A motivated team to develop and a direct line to strategy through Product and Marketing. Compensation:. The budgeted annual salary range for this position is $150,000 to $185,000. description: Position Overview. Apollo Capital Solutions (ACS) is building the foundational infrastructure for the private credit market. Public and private markets are converging and private credit is scaling rapidly, yet the data, settlement and workflow infrastructure underpinning the asset classes remain manual and fragmented. This individual will be responsible for building and institutionalizing cash flow modeling, credit and prepayment analytics, and risk assessment capabilities across Apollo's consumer finance investment strategies. The role spans the full breadth of consumer asset classes, including Auto ABS, Credit Card ABS, Student Loan ABS, Personal Loan ABS, consumer whole loans, marketplace lending, and buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) platforms.. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of quantitative analytics and consumer credit investing, embedded within a centralized investment capability that serves Apollo's broader credit platform. The successful candidate will partner directly with investment teams, portfolio risk, and senior leadership to deliver scalable, code-based modeling frameworks that support pricing, structuring, collateral performance analytics, and risk management across both securitized and unsecuritized consumer finance products.. The Role:. As a Principal within Global Investment Insights, this individual will serve as the domain expert for consumer finance, owning the end-to-end quantitative framework for modeling consumer loan pools-both in securitized structures and as whole loan portfolios. The role demands deep technical fluency in consumer credit modeling (default, loss severity, prepayment, and delinquency dynamics), deal waterfall mechanics, and collateral surveillance, combined with the ability to operate as a strategic partner to investment professionals and build durable, enterprise-grade analytics. Consistent with Global Investment Insights' vision of embedding analytics and AI directly into investment workflows, the successful candidate will be expected to actively explore and integrate machine learning and AI techniques-such as borrower-level credit scoring, alternative data integration, and automated collateral surveillance-into the consumer finance analytical toolkit.. Primary Responsibilities:. Collateral Credit, Prepayment & Loss Modeling. Construct and maintain loan-level and cohort-level default, loss severity, prepayment, and delinquency roll-rate models calibrated to borrower characteristics (FICO, DTI, LTV, vintage, geography) and macroeconomic variables (unemployment, interest rates, HPI).. Develop scenario and stress testing frameworks to assess the sensitivity of collateral performance and tranche economics to adverse credit and macro environments.. Build collateral surveillance tools that enable systematic monitoring of pool performance trends-including delinquency migration, cumulative net loss curves, and prepayment speeds-across both seasoned portfolios and new originations.. Develop standardized tools to leverage internal, loan-level collateral credit models to analyze public ABS deals.. Analyze emerging consumer credit segments (marketplace lending, BNPL, fintech-originated loans) and develop bespoke modeling approaches that capture their unique risk profiles, including limited performance histories and non-traditional underwriting criteria.. . Cash Flow & Structure Modeling. Design, build, and maintain cash flow models for consumer finance transactions across Auto ABS, Credit Card ABS, Student Loan ABS, Personal Loan ABS, marketplace lending securitizations, and BNPL structures.. Develop standardized, code-based waterfall engines that model deal structures including credit enhancement, excess spread mechanics, early amortization triggers, reserve accounts, and tranche-level loss allocation.. Build flexible modeling frameworks that accommodate both term (amortizing) and revolving master trust structures, reflecting the distinct cash flow dynamics of each.. Support structuring decisions by modeling alternative capital structures, credit enhancement levels, and risk/return trade-offs for both primary issuance and secondary market opportunities.. . Investment Support & Platform. Partner with investment teams to provide quantitative analytics in support of new deal evaluation, pricing, and relative value assessment across consumer finance products-both securitized and whole loan.. Contribute to the development of Global Investment Insights' firmwide quantitative infrastructure by integrating consumer finance models into Apollo's centralized analytics platform, supporting real-time portfolio risk reporting and regulatory capital stress analytics.. Identify and implement opportunities to apply machine learning and AI techniques to consumer finance workflows-including borrower-level credit scoring and segmentation, alternative data integration, automated loan tape analysis, early warning systems for portfolio deterioration, and prepayment/default prediction-ensuring applied AI is grounded in the analytical infrastructure that supports how the firm invests.. Benchmark and adopt leading modeling practices and technologies from peer institutions, ensuring Apollo's consumer finance capabilities remain best-in-class.. Collaborate with technology and data teams to establish robust data pipelines, model governance, and version control practices for all consumer finance analytics.. Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior quantitative professionals supporting the consumer finance effort.. . Qualifications & Experience. Significant experience in consumer credit analytics, securitized products, or quantitative consumer finance, with deep domain expertise across one or more of: Auto ABS, Credit Card ABS, Student Loan ABS, Personal Loan ABS, consumer whole loans, marketplace lending, and/or BNPL.. Demonstrated ability to build production-quality cash flow models for consumer finance transactions, including collateral performance modeling (default, prepayment, loss severity) and deal waterfall engines.. Strong understanding of consumer credit fundamentals: borrower-level underwriting metrics, credit scoring methodologies, delinquency migration, recovery dynamics, and vintage analysis.. Proficiency in programming languages and quantitative tools commonly used in structured finance and consumer credit modeling (e.g., Python, SQL, R, or equivalent).. Familiarity with industry-standard structured finance cash flow modeling platforms (e.g., Intex, dv01, etc.) and consumer credit data providers is expected.. Experience with securitization deal structures, credit enhancement mechanics, rating agency methodologies, and regulatory capital frameworks (Basel III / SCR) is strongly preferred.. Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex quantitative concepts into actionable investment insights for senior stakeholders.. Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline (finance, mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, or related field) preferred.. Genuine conviction in the application of AI and machine learning to investment workflows. Experience applying ML techniques (e.g., gradient-boosted models, NLP for document extraction, deep learning for time series forecasting, alternative data analysis) to consumer credit or structured finance problems is a strong differentiator.. A collaborative, "roll up your sleeves" mentality with a commitment to building scalable, institutional-grade analytics.. Experience processing big loan-level dataset (fluency with SAS preferred).. Ability to program in C# and/or C++ to support model implementation.. . About Apollo:. Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. Interview Process:. We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native. Backend: Golang. Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch. DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes. Version Control: Git. CI/CD: Gitlab. Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:. At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
